@interface LadybirdWindowControlOffsetObserver : NSObject
{
    int m_x_offset;
    int m_y_offset;
    NSButton* m_buttons[3];
    NSPoint m_target_origins[3];
    bool m_update_scheduled;
    bool m_is_applying_offset;
}

- (instancetype)initWithWindow:(NSWindow*)window xOffset:(int)x_offset yOffset:(int)y_offset;
- (void)applyWindowControlOffsets;
- (void)updateTargetOriginForButton:(NSButton*)button;
- (void)scheduleWindowControlOffsetUpdate:(NSButton*)button;
- (void)windowControlFrameDidChange:(NSNotification*)notification;
- (void)windowDidResize:(NSNotification*)notification;

@end

@implementation LadybirdWindowControlOffsetObserver

- (instancetype)initWithWindow:(NSWindow*)window xOffset:(int)x_offset yOffset:(int)y_offset
{
    self = [super init];
    if (!self)
        return nil;

    m_x_offset = x_offset;
    m_y_offset = y_offset;

    [NSNotificationCenter.defaultCenter addObserver:self selector:@selector(windowDidResize:) name:NSWindowDidResizeNotification object:window];

    // NB: Lay out the title bar now, so the controls are in their default place to offset them from, and move them
    //     right away. Before a window is first shown, this keeps it from ever appearing with its controls unmoved.
    [window.contentView.superview layoutSubtreeIfNeeded];

    constexpr NSWindowButton button_types[] = { NSWindowCloseButton, NSWindowMiniaturizeButton, NSWindowZoomButton };
    for (size_t i = 0; i < std::size(button_types); ++i) {
        auto* button = [window standardWindowButton:button_types[i]];
        m_buttons[i] = [button retain];
        button.postsFrameChangedNotifications = YES;
        [NSNotificationCenter.defaultCenter addObserver:self selector:@selector(windowControlFrameDidChange:) name:NSViewFrameDidChangeNotification object:button];
        [self updateTargetOriginForButton:button];
    }
    [self applyWindowControlOffsets];

    return self;
}

- (void)dealloc
{
    [NSNotificationCenter.defaultCenter removeObserver:self];
    for (auto* button : m_buttons)
        [button release];
    [super dealloc];
}

- (void)applyWindowControlOffsets
{
    m_is_applying_offset = true;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < std::size(m_buttons); ++i)
        [m_buttons[i] setFrameOrigin:m_target_origins[i]];
    [m_buttons[0].superview updateTrackingAreas];
    m_is_applying_offset = false;
    m_update_scheduled = false;
}

- (void)updateTargetOriginForButton:(NSButton*)button
{
    for (size_t i = 0; i < std::size(m_buttons); ++i) {
        if (m_buttons[i] != button)
            continue;

        auto origin = button.frame.origin;
        origin.x += m_x_offset;
        origin.y -= m_y_offset;
        m_target_origins[i] = origin;
        break;
    }
}

- (void)scheduleWindowControlOffsetUpdate:(NSButton*)button
{
    [self updateTargetOriginForButton:button];

    if (m_update_scheduled)
        return;

    // NB: AppKit ignores frame changes made while its titlebar layout is in progress.
    //     Apply the offset after that layout pass returns to the main event loop.
    m_update_scheduled = true;
    dispatch_async(dispatch_get_main_queue(), ^{
        [self applyWindowControlOffsets];
    });
}

- (void)windowControlFrameDidChange:(NSNotification*)notification
{
    if (m_is_applying_offset)
        return;
    [self scheduleWindowControlOffsetUpdate:notification.object];
}

- (void)windowDidResize:(NSNotification*)notification
{
    [self applyWindowControlOffsets];
}

@end

@interface LadybirdShadowView : NSView
@end

@implementation LadybirdShadowView

- (NSView*)hitTest:(NSPoint)point
{
    return nil;
}

@end

namespace Ladybird {

static NSEvent* s_latest_window_drag_event;
static NSInteger s_last_pressure_stage;

static bool is_window_drag_on_gesture_enabled()
{
    return [[NSUserDefaults standardUserDefaults] boolForKey:@"NSWindowShouldDragOnGesture"];
}

static bool is_appkit_event_type(QByteArray const& event_type)
{
    return event_type == QByteArrayLiteral("NSEvent")
        || event_type == QByteArrayLiteral("mac_generic_NSEvent");
}

static bool is_window_drag_event(NSEvent* event)
{
    if (!event)
        return false;

    switch (event.type) {
    case NSEventTypeLeftMouseDown:
    case NSEventTypeLeftMouseDragged:
        return true;
    default:
        return false;
    }
}

static bool should_start_window_drag_for_gesture(NSEvent* event)
{
    if (!event || event.type != NSEventTypeLeftMouseDown)
        return false;

    if (!is_window_drag_on_gesture_enabled())
        return false;

    auto modifier_flags = event.modifierFlags & NSEventModifierFlagDeviceIndependentFlagsMask;
    if ((modifier_flags & (NSEventModifierFlagCommand | NSEventModifierFlagControl)) != (NSEventModifierFlagCommand | NSEventModifierFlagControl))
        return false;

    auto* window = event.window;
    if (!window || !window.isMovable || (window.styleMask & NSWindowStyleMaskFullScreen))
        return false;

    return true;
}

static NSPoint widget_position_to_ns_point(QWidget& widget, Gfx::IntPoint position)
{
    auto* view = reinterpret_cast<NSView*>(widget.winId());
    if (!view)
        return {};

    auto device_pixel_ratio = widget.devicePixelRatioF();
    auto point = NSMakePoint(position.x() / device_pixel_ratio, position.y() / device_pixel_ratio);
    if (![view isFlipped])
        point.y = NSHeight(view.bounds) - point.y;
    return point;
}

static Optional<QPointF> widget_point_for_appkit_event(QWidget& widget, NSEvent* event)
{
    auto* view = reinterpret_cast<NSView*>(widget.winId());
    if (!view || !event.window)
        return {};

    auto point = [view convertPoint:event.locationInWindow fromView:nil];
    if (![view isFlipped])
        point.y = NSHeight(view.bounds) - point.y;
    return QPointF { point.x, point.y };
}

static Optional<Gfx::IntPoint> widget_position_for_appkit_event(QWidget& widget, NSEvent* event)
{
    auto point = widget_point_for_appkit_event(widget, event);
    if (!point.has_value())
        return {};

    auto device_pixel_ratio = widget.devicePixelRatioF();
    return Gfx::IntPoint {
        static_cast<int>(point->x() * device_pixel_ratio),
        static_cast<int>(point->y() * device_pixel_ratio),
    };
}

static WebContentView* web_content_view_for_appkit_event(NSEvent* event)
{
    if (!event.window)
        return nullptr;

    auto* content_view = event.window.contentView;
    if (!content_view)
        return nullptr;

    auto point = [content_view convertPoint:event.locationInWindow fromView:nil];
    for (auto* view = [content_view hitTest:point]; view; view = view.superview) {
        auto* widget = QWidget::find(reinterpret_cast<WId>(view));
        if (!widget)
            continue;
        if (auto* web_content_view = qobject_cast<WebContentView*>(widget))
            return web_content_view;
    }

    return nullptr;
}

static bool should_perform_dictionary_lookup_for_event(NSEvent* event)
{
    if (!event)
        return false;

    switch (event.type) {
    case NSEventTypeQuickLook:
        return true;
    case NSEventTypePressure: {
        auto stage = event.stage;
        auto should_lookup = s_last_pressure_stage == 1
            && stage == 2
            && [[NSUserDefaults standardUserDefaults] integerForKey:@"com.apple.trackpad.forceClick"] == 1;
        s_last_pressure_stage = stage;
        return should_lookup;
    }
    default:
        return false;
    }
}

static bool perform_dictionary_lookup_for_event(NSEvent* event)
{
    if (!should_perform_dictionary_lookup_for_event(event))
        return false;

    auto* view = web_content_view_for_appkit_event(event);
    if (!view)
        return false;

    auto position = widget_position_for_appkit_event(*view, event);
    if (!position.has_value())
        return false;

    return view->look_up_selected_text_at(*position);
}

static QPointer<WebContentView> s_view_following_mouse_while_inactive;

// Qt ignores mouse movement while Ladybird is inactive, so it is passed on here to a view that follows it anyway.
static void follow_mouse_while_inactive(NSEvent* event)
{
    if (!event || NSApp.active)
        return;

    if (event.type == NSEventTypeMouseExited) {
        auto view = s_view_following_mouse_while_inactive;
        if (!view || event.window != reinterpret_cast<NSView*>(view->winId()).window)
            return;
        s_view_following_mouse_while_inactive = nullptr;
        QEvent leave_event { QEvent::Leave };
        QCoreApplication::sendEvent(view, &leave_event);
        return;
    }

    if (event.type != NSEventTypeMouseMoved)
        return;

    auto* view = web_content_view_for_appkit_event(event);
    if (!view || !view->follows_mouse_while_inactive())
        return;
    auto point = widget_point_for_appkit_event(*view, event);
    if (!point.has_value())
        return;

    s_view_following_mouse_while_inactive = view;
    QMouseEvent move_event { QEvent::MouseMove, *point, view->mapToGlobal(*point), Qt::NoButton, Qt::NoButton, Qt::NoModifier };
    QCoreApplication::sendEvent(view, &move_event);
}

// AppKit reports no more than whether a scroll event ends the fingers' part of a gesture, but the HID event behind it
// says whether momentum follows. The functions that read it are private, so they are looked up rather than linked.
static bool appkit_scroll_momentum_will_begin(NSEvent* event)
{
    using CopyIOHIDEventFunction = CFTypeRef (*)(CGEventRef);
    using GetScrollMomentumFunction = u8 (*)(CFTypeRef);
    static auto copy_iohid_event = reinterpret_cast<CopyIOHIDEventFunction>(dlsym(RTLD_DEFAULT, "CGEventCopyIOHIDEvent"));
    static auto get_scroll_momentum = reinterpret_cast<GetScrollMomentumFunction>(dlsym(RTLD_DEFAULT, "IOHIDEventGetScrollMomentum"));
    static constexpr u8 scroll_momentum_will_begin = 1 << 3;

    if (!copy_iohid_event || !get_scroll_momentum || !event.CGEvent)
        return false;
    auto iohid_event = copy_iohid_event(event.CGEvent);
    if (!iohid_event)
        return false;
    ScopeGuard release_iohid_event = [&] { CFRelease(iohid_event); };
    return (get_scroll_momentum(iohid_event) & scroll_momentum_will_begin) != 0;
}

struct RecordedAppKitScrollMomentumTransition {
    u64 timestamp_in_milliseconds { 0 };
    AppKitScrollMomentumTransition transition;
};
static Vector<RecordedAppKitScrollMomentumTransition> s_recorded_appkit_scroll_momentum_transitions;

// Qt delivers a wheel event after AppKit dispatched the scroll event it came from, and stamps it with that event's
// time in milliseconds.
static u64 qt_timestamp_for_appkit_event(NSEvent* event)
{
    return static_cast<u64>(event.timestamp * 1000);
}

static void record_appkit_scroll_momentum_transition(NSEvent* event)
{
    if (event.type != NSEventTypeScrollWheel)
        return;

    Optional<AppKitScrollMomentumTransition> transition;
    if (event.momentumPhase == NSEventPhaseBegan)
        transition = AppKitScrollMomentumTransition::Began;
    else if (event.phase == NSEventPhaseEnded && event.momentumPhase == NSEventPhaseNone && appkit_scroll_momentum_will_begin(event))
        transition = AppKitScrollMomentumTransition::WillBegin;
    if (!transition.has_value())
        return;

    static constexpr size_t maximum_recorded_transitions = 8;
    if (s_recorded_appkit_scroll_momentum_transitions.size() == maximum_recorded_transitions)
        s_recorded_appkit_scroll_momentum_transitions.remove(0);
    s_recorded_appkit_scroll_momentum_transitions.append({
        .timestamp_in_milliseconds = qt_timestamp_for_appkit_event(event),
        .transition = transition.value(),
    });
}

// Qt makes a ScrollEnd of the lift, unless it saw the momentum coming, and a ScrollBegin of the momentum's first event,
// unless it did. The fingers' last step can share the lift's millisecond, and takes neither.
static bool qt_wheel_event_is_made_of(QWheelEvent const& wheel_event, AppKitScrollMomentumTransition transition)
{
    switch (transition) {
    case AppKitScrollMomentumTransition::WillBegin:
        return wheel_event.phase() == Qt::ScrollEnd;
    case AppKitScrollMomentumTransition::Began:
        return wheel_event.phase() == Qt::ScrollBegin;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

Optional<AppKitScrollMomentumTransition> take_appkit_scroll_momentum_transition_for(QWheelEvent const& wheel_event)
{
    // The transitions recorded before this one went to other windows, or were dropped by Qt.
    auto timestamp = static_cast<u64>(wheel_event.timestamp());
    while (!s_recorded_appkit_scroll_momentum_transitions.is_empty() && s_recorded_appkit_scroll_momentum_transitions.first().timestamp_in_milliseconds < timestamp)
        s_recorded_appkit_scroll_momentum_transitions.remove(0);
    for (size_t index = 0; index < s_recorded_appkit_scroll_momentum_transitions.size(); index++) {
        auto const& recorded = s_recorded_appkit_scroll_momentum_transitions[index];
        if (recorded.timestamp_in_milliseconds > timestamp)
            break;
        if (!qt_wheel_event_is_made_of(wheel_event, recorded.transition))
            continue;
        auto transition = recorded.transition;
        s_recorded_appkit_scroll_momentum_transitions.remove(index);
        return transition;
    }
    return {};
}

class LadybirdAppKitEventCaptureFilter final : public QAbstractNativeEventFilter {
public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    virtual bool nativeEventFilter(QByteArray const& event_type, void* message, qintptr*) override
    {
        if (!is_appkit_event_type(event_type))
            return false;

        auto* event = static_cast<NSEvent*>(message);
        follow_mouse_while_inactive(event);
        record_appkit_scroll_momentum_transition(event);

        if (perform_dictionary_lookup_for_event(event))
            return true;

        if (should_start_window_drag_for_gesture(event)) {
            [event.window performWindowDragWithEvent:event];
            return true;
        }

        if (!is_window_drag_event(event))
            return false;

        [s_latest_window_drag_event release];
        s_latest_window_drag_event = [event copy];
        return false;
    }
};

void install_appkit_event_capture()
{
    static auto* filter = new LadybirdAppKitEventCaptureFilter;
    static bool installed = false;
    if (installed)
        return;

    if (auto* application = QCoreApplication::instance()) {
        application->installNativeEventFilter(filter);
        installed = true;
    }
}

static NSWindow* appkit_window_for(QWidget& widget)
{
    if (QGuiApplication::platformName() != "cocoa")
        return nil;
    auto* view = reinterpret_cast<NSView*>(widget.internalWinId());
    return view.window;
}

// A popup is a window of its own, placed by what it hangs from when it opens. Dragging that window by its title bar
// never reaches the popup as a press outside it, so the popup would stay open where it was while the window moved away.
// The popup's window is a child window of the window it hangs from while it is shown, so AppKit moves it along. On
// other platforms, starting to move a window is a press outside the popup, which closes it.
class LadybirdAppKitPopupAttachmentFilter final : public QObject {
public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    virtual bool eventFilter(QObject* watched, QEvent* event) override
    {
        if (event->type() != QEvent::Show && event->type() != QEvent::Hide)
            return false;
        if (!watched->isWidgetType())
            return false;
        auto& popup = static_cast<QWidget&>(*watched);
        if (popup.windowType() != Qt::Popup || !popup.parentWidget())
            return false;

        if (event->type() == QEvent::Hide) {
            auto* popup_window = appkit_window_for(popup);
            if (auto* parent_window = popup_window.parentWindow)
                [parent_window removeChildWindow:popup_window];
            return false;
        }

        // Qt sends the Show event before applying the popup's geometry to its native window. Attaching it during
        // that event can expose the window with its initial geometry.
        // The menus that every window shares have a parent that is never shown. Its window would appear along with a
        // child window that is pressed, so such a menu hangs from the popup that opened it.
        // NB: Qt sends the Show event before the popup becomes the active one.
        QPointer<QWidget> anchor = popup.parentWidget()->window();
        if (!anchor->isVisible())
            anchor = QApplication::activePopupWidget();

        auto attach_popup = [&popup, anchor] {
            if (!popup.isVisible() || !anchor || !anchor->isVisible())
                return;
            auto* popup_window = appkit_window_for(popup);
            if (!popup_window)
                return;

            // A window can be dragged by its content with a gesture, which would take the popup away from its anchor.
            popup_window.movable = NO;

            auto* parent_window = appkit_window_for(*anchor);
            if (!parent_window || parent_window == popup_window || popup_window.parentWindow == parent_window)
                return;

            if (auto* previous_parent_window = popup_window.parentWindow)
                [previous_parent_window removeChildWindow:popup_window];
            [parent_window addChildWindow:popup_window ordered:NSWindowAbove];
        };

        QMetaObject::invokeMethod(&popup, attach_popup, Qt::QueuedConnection);
        return false;
    }
};

void install_appkit_popup_attachment()
{
    static bool installed = false;
    if (installed)
        return;
    if (auto* application = QCoreApplication::instance()) {
        application->installEventFilter(new LadybirdAppKitPopupAttachmentFilter);
        installed = true;
    }
}

static NSScreen* appkit_screen_of_window(QWidget& widget)
{
    NSScreen* screen = nil;
    // winId() would create the native window, so only a window that already has one is asked for its screen.
    if (auto* window_widget = widget.window(); window_widget && window_widget->windowHandle()) {
        if (auto* view = reinterpret_cast<NSView*>(window_widget->winId()))
            screen = view.window.screen;
    }
    if (screen == nil)
        screen = NSScreen.mainScreen;
    return screen;
}

bool appkit_window_screen_shows_high_dynamic_range(QWidget& widget)
{
    auto* screen = appkit_screen_of_window(widget);
    return screen != nil && screen.maximumPotentialExtendedDynamicRangeColorComponentValue > 1.0;
}

Optional<u64> appkit_display_id_for_window(QWidget& widget)
{
    auto* screen = appkit_screen_of_window(widget);
    if (screen == nil)
        return {};

    NSNumber* screen_number = screen.deviceDescription[@"NSScreenNumber"];
    if (screen_number == nil)
        return {};
    return static_cast<u64>(screen_number.unsignedLongLongValue);
}

void hide_appkit_window_title(QWidget& widget)
{
    auto* view = reinterpret_cast<NSView*>(widget.winId());
    if (!view)
        return;

    auto* window = view.window;
    if (!window)
        return;

    window.titleVisibility = NSWindowTitleHidden;
}

void make_appkit_window_resizable(QWidget& widget)
{
    auto* view = reinterpret_cast<NSView*>(widget.winId());
    if (!view || !view.window)
        return;
    view.window.styleMask |= NSWindowStyleMaskResizable;
}

void keep_appkit_window_visible_while_inactive(QWidget& widget)
{
    auto* view = reinterpret_cast<NSView*>(widget.winId());
    if (!view || !view.window)
        return;
    view.window.hidesOnDeactivate = NO;
}

void disable_appkit_window_animations(QWidget& widget)
{
    if (QGuiApplication::platformName() != "cocoa")
        return;
    auto* view = reinterpret_cast<NSView*>(widget.winId());
    if (!view || !view.window)
        return;
    view.window.animationBehavior = NSWindowAnimationBehaviorNone;
}

void ensure_appkit_window_is_exposed(QWidget& widget)
{
    auto* window = widget.windowHandle();
    if (!widget.isVisible() || !window || !window->isVisible() || window->isExposed())
        return;

    // Qt restores a native view's exposed state from its content layer's display callback. A view whose backing layer
    // is already clean can remain unexposed after being shown or raised, causing Qt to route hover events below it.
    // Display the content layer directly: marking the NSView as needing display can leave that callback uncalled.
    auto* layer = static_cast<CALayer*>(appkit_content_layer(widget));
    [layer setNeedsDisplay];
    [layer displayIfNeeded];
}

void set_appkit_window_content_aspect_ratio(QWidget& widget, Gfx::IntSize aspect_ratio)
{
    auto* view = reinterpret_cast<NSView*>(widget.winId());
    if (!view || !view.window)
        return;
    view.window.contentAspectRatio = NSMakeSize(aspect_ratio.width(), aspect_ratio.height());
}

static char s_window_control_offset_observer_key;

void offset_appkit_window_controls(QWidget& widget, int x_offset, int y_offset)
{
    auto* view = reinterpret_cast<NSView*>(widget.winId());
    if (!view)
        return;

    auto* window = view.window;
    if (!window)
        return;
    if (objc_getAssociatedObject(window, &s_window_control_offset_observer_key))
        return;

    auto* observer = [[LadybirdWindowControlOffsetObserver alloc] initWithWindow:window xOffset:x_offset yOffset:y_offset];
    objc_setAssociatedObject(window, &s_window_control_offset_observer_key, observer, OBJC_ASSOCIATION_RETAIN_NONATOMIC);
    [observer release];
}

void reapply_appkit_window_control_offsets(QWidget& widget)
{
    auto* view = reinterpret_cast<NSView*>(widget.internalWinId());
    if (!view || !view.window)
        return;

    LadybirdWindowControlOffsetObserver* observer = objc_getAssociatedObject(view.window, &s_window_control_offset_observer_key);
    [observer applyWindowControlOffsets];
}

bool start_appkit_window_drag(QWidget& widget)
{
    auto* window_widget = widget.window();
    if (!window_widget)
        return false;

    auto* view = reinterpret_cast<NSView*>(window_widget->winId());
    if (!view)
        return false;

    auto* window = view.window;
    if (!window)
        return false;

    auto* current_event = NSApp.currentEvent;
    auto current_event_is_valid = is_window_drag_event(current_event);
    auto current_event_window_matches = current_event_is_valid && current_event.window == window;

    auto* event = current_event_window_matches ? current_event : s_latest_window_drag_event;
    if (!is_window_drag_event(event) || event.window != window)
        return false;

    [window performWindowDragWithEvent:event];
    return true;
}

Qt::DropAction execute_appkit_tab_drag(QWidget& widget, QDrag& drag)
{
    if (QGuiApplication::platformName() != "cocoa")
        return drag.exec(Qt::MoveAction, Qt::MoveAction);

    auto* view = reinterpret_cast<NSView*>(widget.window()->winId());
    auto* window = view.window;
    if (!window)
        return drag.exec(Qt::MoveAction, Qt::MoveAction);

    // Qt's Cocoa backend calls this synchronous AppKit API with slideBack:YES. Dropping outside a tab strip is
    // rejected by AppKit, so exec() waits for the slide-back animation before we can create the detached window.
    // Override only the source window's class, and restore it as soon as this tab drag finishes.
    auto window_class = object_getClass(window);
    auto* selector = @selector(dragImage:at:offset:event:pasteboard:source:slideBack:);
    auto* method = class_getInstanceMethod(window_class, selector);
    if (!method)
        return drag.exec(Qt::MoveAction, Qt::MoveAction);

    // Add an override if the method is inherited, so we don't replace NSWindow's implementation globally.
    class_addMethod(window_class, selector, method_getImplementation(method), method_getTypeEncoding(method));
    method = class_getInstanceMethod(window_class, selector);

    auto original_implementation = method_getImplementation(method);
    auto original_drag_image = reinterpret_cast<void (*)(id, SEL, NSImage*, NSPoint, NSSize, NSEvent*, NSPasteboard*, id, BOOL)>(original_implementation);
    auto implementation = imp_implementationWithBlock(^(NSWindow* receiver, NSImage* image, NSPoint location, NSSize offset, NSEvent* event, NSPasteboard* pasteboard, id source, BOOL slide_back) {
        original_drag_image(receiver, selector, image, location, offset, event, pasteboard, source, receiver == window ? NO : slide_back);
    });
    method_setImplementation(method, implementation);
    ScopeGuard restore_implementation = [&]() {
        method_setImplementation(method, original_implementation);
        imp_removeBlock(implementation);
    };

    return drag.exec(Qt::MoveAction, Qt::MoveAction);
}

void show_appkit_dictionary_lookup(QWidget& widget, WebView::DictionaryLookup const& lookup, Gfx::IntPoint position)
{
    auto* view = reinterpret_cast<NSView*>(widget.winId());
    show_dictionary_lookup(view, lookup, widget_position_to_ns_point(widget, position));
}

void* appkit_content_layer(QWidget& widget)
{
    auto* window_handle = widget.windowHandle();
    auto* cocoa_window = window_handle ? window_handle->nativeInterface<QNativeInterface::Private::QCocoaWindow>() : nullptr;
    return cocoa_window ? cocoa_window->contentLayer() : nullptr;
}

static IOSurfaceRef create_chrome_snapshot_surface(IOSurfaceRef window_surface, size_t height)
{
    auto* properties = @{
        (__bridge NSString*)kIOSurfaceWidth : @(IOSurfaceGetWidth(window_surface)),
        (__bridge NSString*)kIOSurfaceHeight : @(height),
        (__bridge NSString*)kIOSurfaceBytesPerRow : @(IOSurfaceGetBytesPerRow(window_surface)),
        (__bridge NSString*)kIOSurfaceBytesPerElement : @(IOSurfaceGetBytesPerElement(window_surface)),
        (__bridge NSString*)kIOSurfacePixelFormat : @(IOSurfaceGetPixelFormat(window_surface)),
    };
    auto* surface = IOSurfaceCreate((__bridge CFDictionaryRef)properties);
    if (!surface)
        return nullptr;

    auto color_space_key = CFSTR("IOSurfaceColorSpace");
    if (auto color_space = IOSurfaceCopyValue(window_surface, color_space_key)) {
        IOSurfaceSetValue(surface, color_space_key, color_space);
        CFRelease(color_space);
    }
    return surface;
}

static bool copy_top_rows_of_surface(IOSurfaceRef from, IOSurfaceRef to, size_t height)
{
    if (IOSurfaceLock(from, kIOSurfaceLockReadOnly, nullptr) != kIOReturnSuccess)
        return false;
    auto locked_to = IOSurfaceLock(to, 0, nullptr) == kIOReturnSuccess;
    if (locked_to) {
        memcpy(IOSurfaceGetBaseAddress(to), IOSurfaceGetBaseAddress(from), min(IOSurfaceGetBytesPerRow(from), IOSurfaceGetBytesPerRow(to)) * height);
        IOSurfaceUnlock(to, 0, nullptr);
    }
    IOSurfaceUnlock(from, kIOSurfaceLockReadOnly, nullptr);
    return locked_to;
}

AppKitWindowChromeSnapshots::AppKitWindowChromeSnapshots(QWidget& window, Function<int()> chrome_height)
    : m_window(window)
    , m_chrome_height(move(chrome_height))
{
    auto* layer = [[CALayer alloc] init];
    layer.opaque = YES;
    m_layer = layer;

    // NB: Core Animation commits at order 2000000, so a repaint normally reaches the screen in one commit with its
    //     snapshot. Core Animation can also ask Qt for a repaint during that commit. Only the second observer then
    //     sees the repaint before the run loop sleeps.
    static constexpr Array<CFIndex, 2> orders { 1999999, 2000001 };
    for (size_t i = 0; i < orders.size(); ++i) {
        auto* observer = CFRunLoopObserverCreateWithHandler(kCFAllocatorDefault, kCFRunLoopBeforeWaiting | kCFRunLoopExit, true, orders[i], ^(CFRunLoopObserverRef, CFRunLoopActivity) {
            update();
        });
        CFRunLoopAddObserver(CFRunLoopGetMain(), observer, kCFRunLoopCommonModes);
        m_run_loop_observers[i] = observer;
    }
}

AppKitWindowChromeSnapshots::~AppKitWindowChromeSnapshots()
{
    for (auto* observer : m_run_loop_observers) {
        CFRunLoopObserverInvalidate(static_cast<CFRunLoopObserverRef>(observer));
        CFRelease(observer);
    }
    auto* layer = static_cast<CALayer*>(m_layer);
    [layer removeFromSuperlayer];
    [layer release];
    for (auto* surface : { m_shown_surface, m_spare_surface }) {
        if (surface)
            CFRelease(surface);
    }
}

void AppKitWindowChromeSnapshots::update()
{
    auto* window_layer = static_cast<CALayer*>(appkit_content_layer(m_window));
    id contents = window_layer.contents;
    if (!contents || CFGetTypeID((__bridge CFTypeRef)contents) != IOSurfaceGetTypeID())
        return;

    // NB: Qt does not always set the layer's contents after a repaint, as the layer already has the one surface it
    //     paints into. The surface's seed changes with each repaint.
    auto* window_surface = (__bridge IOSurfaceRef)contents;
    auto window_surface_id = IOSurfaceGetID(window_surface);
    auto window_surface_seed = IOSurfaceGetSeed(window_surface);
    auto scale = window_layer.contentsScale;
    auto height = min(static_cast<size_t>(max(m_chrome_height(), 0) * scale), IOSurfaceGetHeight(window_surface));
    if (window_surface_id == m_window_surface_id && window_surface_seed == m_window_surface_seed && height == m_height)
        return;

    auto* layer = static_cast<CALayer*>(m_layer);
    if (height > 0) {
        // NB: The window server may still be reading the spare surface, and a surface in use is never written to.
        auto* surface = static_cast<IOSurfaceRef>(m_spare_surface);
        if (!surface || IOSurfaceGetWidth(surface) != IOSurfaceGetWidth(window_surface) || IOSurfaceGetHeight(surface) != height || IOSurfaceIsInUse(surface)) {
            if (surface)
                CFRelease(surface);
            m_spare_surface = surface = create_chrome_snapshot_surface(window_surface, height);
        }
        if (!surface || !copy_top_rows_of_surface(window_surface, surface, height))
            return;
        swap(m_shown_surface, m_spare_surface);
    }
    m_window_surface_id = window_surface_id;
    m_window_surface_seed = window_surface_seed;
    m_height = height;

    [CATransaction begin];
    [CATransaction setDisableActions:YES];
    if (layer.superlayer != window_layer)
        [window_layer addSublayer:layer];
    layer.hidden = height == 0;
    layer.frame = CGRectMake(0, 0, IOSurfaceGetWidth(window_surface) / scale, height / scale);
    layer.contentsScale = scale;
    layer.contents = height > 0 ? (__bridge id)m_shown_surface : nil;

    // NB: Qt skips its flush for a surface that is on screen, so this tells the window server of the repaint instead.
    window_layer.contents = nil;
    window_layer.contents = contents;
    [CATransaction commit];

    reinterpret_cast<NSView*>(m_window.winId()).window.viewsNeedDisplay = YES;
}

void round_appkit_view_corners(QWidget& widget, qreal radius, QColor const& border_color)
{
    auto* view = reinterpret_cast<NSView*>(widget.winId());
    if (!view)
        return;
    view.wantsLayer = YES;
    auto* layer = view.layer;
    layer.cornerRadius = radius;
    layer.cornerCurve = kCACornerCurveContinuous;
    layer.masksToBounds = YES;
    layer.borderWidth = 1;
    auto* color = CGColorCreateSRGB(border_color.redF(), border_color.greenF(), border_color.blueF(), border_color.alphaF());
    layer.borderColor = color;
    CGColorRelease(color);
}

void round_appkit_view_bottom_corners(QWidget& widget, qreal radius)
{
    if (QGuiApplication::platformName() != "cocoa")
        return;
    auto* view = reinterpret_cast<NSView*>(widget.winId());
    if (!view)
        return;
    view.wantsLayer = YES;
    auto* layer = view.layer;
    layer.cornerRadius = radius;
    layer.cornerCurve = kCACornerCurveContinuous;
    // NB: Qt's views are flipped, so the bottom of the view is at its layer's largest y.
    layer.maskedCorners = view.isFlipped ? (kCALayerMinXMaxYCorner | kCALayerMaxXMaxYCorner) : (kCALayerMinXMinYCorner | kCALayerMaxXMinYCorner);
    layer.masksToBounds = YES;
}

AppKitViewShadow::AppKitViewShadow()
{
    auto* view = [[LadybirdShadowView alloc] initWithFrame:NSZeroRect];
    view.wantsLayer = YES;
    view.layer.masksToBounds = YES;
    view.hidden = YES;
    auto* caster = [[CALayer alloc] init];
    [view.layer addSublayer:caster];
    auto* focus_edge = [[CALayer alloc] init];
    auto* focus_ring = [[CALayer alloc] init];
    for (CALayer* layer in @[ focus_edge, focus_ring ]) {
        layer.cornerCurve = kCACornerCurveContinuous;
        layer.hidden = YES;
        [view.layer addSublayer:layer];
    }
    m_view = view;
    m_caster = caster;
    m_focus_edge = focus_edge;
    m_focus_ring = focus_ring;
}

AppKitViewShadow::~AppKitViewShadow()
{
    auto* view = static_cast<NSView*>(m_view);
    [view removeFromSuperview];
    [view release];
    [static_cast<CALayer*>(m_caster) release];
    [static_cast<CALayer*>(m_focus_edge) release];
    [static_cast<CALayer*>(m_focus_ring) release];
}

void AppKitViewShadow::follow(QWidget& widget, QMargins const& room, qreal corner_radius, qreal blur_radius, qreal y_offset, QColor const& shadow_color, QColor const& fill_color, Optional<AppKitViewFocusRing> const& focus_ring)
{
    if (QGuiApplication::platformName() != "cocoa")
        return;
    auto* surface = reinterpret_cast<NSView*>(widget.winId());
    if (!surface || !surface.superview)
        return;
    auto* view = static_cast<NSView*>(m_view);
    auto* caster = static_cast<CALayer*>(m_caster);

    [CATransaction begin];
    [CATransaction setDisableActions:YES];

    auto surface_frame = surface.frame;
    auto room_at_origin = surface.superview.isFlipped ? room.top() : room.bottom();
    view.frame = NSMakeRect(surface_frame.origin.x - room.left(), surface_frame.origin.y - room_at_origin,
        surface_frame.size.width + room.left() + room.right(), surface_frame.size.height + room.top() + room.bottom());
    [surface.superview addSubview:view positioned:NSWindowBelow relativeTo:surface];
    view.hidden = NO;

    // NB: This view is not flipped, unlike Qt's, so the bottom of the room comes first and a shadow falls to lower y.
    auto caster_frame = CGRectMake(room.left(), room.bottom(), surface_frame.size.width, surface_frame.size.height);
    caster.frame = caster_frame;
    caster.cornerRadius = corner_radius;
    auto* fill = CGColorCreateSRGB(fill_color.redF(), fill_color.greenF(), fill_color.blueF(), fill_color.alphaF());
    caster.backgroundColor = fill;
    CGColorRelease(fill);
    auto* shadow = CGColorCreateSRGB(shadow_color.redF(), shadow_color.greenF(), shadow_color.blueF(), shadow_color.alphaF());
    caster.shadowColor = shadow;
    CGColorRelease(shadow);
    caster.shadowOpacity = 1;
    caster.shadowRadius = blur_radius;
    caster.shadowOffset = CGSizeMake(0, -y_offset);
    auto* shadow_path = CGPathCreateWithRoundedRect(CGRectMake(0, 0, caster_frame.size.width, caster_frame.size.height), corner_radius, corner_radius, nullptr);
    caster.shadowPath = shadow_path;
    CGPathRelease(shadow_path);

    // NB: Both parts of the ring are borders, around the surface that covers what is inside them.
    auto* focus_edge = static_cast<CALayer*>(m_focus_edge);
    auto* focus_ring_layer = static_cast<CALayer*>(m_focus_ring);
    focus_edge.hidden = !focus_ring.has_value();
    focus_ring_layer.hidden = !focus_ring.has_value();
    if (focus_ring.has_value()) {
        auto set_ring_part = [&](CALayer* layer, qreal outset, qreal width, QColor const& color) {
            layer.frame = CGRectInset(caster_frame, -outset, -outset);
            layer.cornerRadius = corner_radius + outset;
            layer.borderWidth = width;
            auto* border_color = CGColorCreateSRGB(color.redF(), color.greenF(), color.blueF(), color.alphaF());
            layer.borderColor = border_color;
            CGColorRelease(border_color);
        };
        set_ring_part(focus_edge, 1, 1, focus_ring->edge_color);
        set_ring_part(focus_ring_layer, 1 + focus_ring->ring_width, focus_ring->ring_width, focus_ring->ring_color);
    }

    [CATransaction commit];
}

void AppKitViewShadow::hide()
{
    static_cast<NSView*>(m_view).hidden = YES;
}

void AppKitViewShadow::set_opacity(qreal opacity)
{
    static_cast<NSView*>(m_view).alphaValue = opacity;
}

void set_appkit_view_opacity(QWidget& widget, qreal opacity)
{
    if (QGuiApplication::platformName() != "cocoa")
        return;
    auto* view = reinterpret_cast<NSView*>(widget.winId());
    if (!view)
        return;
    view.alphaValue = opacity;
}

#include <UI/Qt/MacWindow.h>

namespace Ladybird {

void make_appkit_window_first_responder(QWidget& widget)
{
    if (QGuiApplication::platformName() != "cocoa")
        return;
    auto* window_widget = widget.window();
    if (!window_widget)
        return;

    auto* view = reinterpret_cast<NSView*>(window_widget->winId());
    if (!view)
        return;

    auto* window = view.window;
    if (!window)
        return;

    [window makeFirstResponder:view];
}

#include <LibCore/BrowserVersion.h>
#include <LibCore/GeolocationProvider.h>
#include <LibCore/System.h>
#include <LibMain/Main.h>
#include <LibWebView/Application.h>
#include <LibWebView/URL.h>
#include <LibWebView/Utilities.h>
#include <UI/Qt/Application.h>
#include <UI/Qt/BrowserWindow.h>
#include <UI/Qt/ChromeStyle.h>
#include <UI/Qt/HubConnection.h>
#include <UI/Qt/SystemAppearance.h>
#if defined(LADYBIRD_QT_HAVE_POSITIONING)
#    include <UI/Qt/GeolocationProviderQt.h>
#endif
#include <UI/Qt/WebContentView.h>

#include <QCoreApplication>
#include <QFile>
#include <QFileInfo>
#include <QStyleHints>
#include <QtGlobal>

#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
#    include <QColorSpace>
#    include <QSurfaceFormat>
#    include <UI/Qt/MacWindow.h>
#endif

ErrorOr<int> ladybird_main(Main::Arguments arguments)
{
    AK::set_rich_debug_enabled(true);

#ifdef LADYBIRD_HUB_IN_OWN_PROCESS
    // Headless mode has no use for a UI, so the Hub takes over this process.
    if (any_of(arguments.strings, [](auto argument) { return argument.starts_with("--headless"sv); })) {
        auto hub_path = TRY(Ladybird::Application::hub_executable_path());
        execv(hub_path.characters(), arguments.argv);
        return Error::from_syscall("execv"sv, errno);
    }
#endif

#ifdef LADYBIRD_QT_PLUGINS_PATH
    // Qt ignores the path when it is absent, so the build tree still uses vcpkg's plugins.
    if (auto executable_path = Core::System::current_executable_path(); !executable_path.is_error()) {
        auto executable_dir = QFileInfo(QFile::decodeName(executable_path.value().characters())).absolutePath();
        QCoreApplication::addLibraryPath(executable_dir + QStringLiteral("/" LADYBIRD_QT_PLUGINS_PATH));
    }
#endif

    // The web content view is presented in a native child window. Without this attribute, a widget
    // gaining a native window would force every other widget in the browser window to become native
    // as well.
    QCoreApplication::setAttribute(Qt::AA_DontCreateNativeWidgetSiblings);

#ifdef AK_OS_MACOS
    auto surface_format = QSurfaceFormat::defaultFormat();
    surface_format.setColorSpace(QColorSpace::SRgb);
    QSurfaceFormat::setDefaultFormat(surface_format);
#endif

#if defined(LADYBIRD_QT_HAVE_POSITIONING)
    // Only fall back to Qt on platforms that have no geolocation provider of their own.
    if (!Core::GeolocationProvider::is_available())
        Ladybird::install_qt_geolocation_provider();
#endif

    OwnPtr<Ladybird::Application> app = TRY(Ladybird::Application::create(arguments));
    if (auto exit_status = app->exit_status_if_done(); exit_status.has_value())
        return *exit_status;

    Ladybird::ChromeStyle::install_application_style();

    if (auto const& browser_options = Ladybird::Application::browser_options(); !browser_options.headless_mode.has_value()) {
        Ladybird::SystemAppearance::the().apply_interface_theme(Ladybird::Application::settings().appearance().interface_theme);
        Ladybird::SystemAppearance::the().apply_color_theme(Ladybird::Application::settings().appearance().color_theme);

        app->on_open_file = [&](auto const& file_url) {
            if (auto* window = app->non_private_window_if_any()) {
                auto& tab = window->new_tab_from_url(file_url, Web::HTML::ActivateTab::Yes, Ladybird::BrowserWindow::TabLocation::end());
                tab.set_url_is_hidden(false);
                auto& view = tab.view();
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
                Ladybird::make_appkit_window_first_responder(view);
#endif
                view.setFocus();
                window->show();
                window->activateWindow();
                window->raise();
                return;
            }
            app->new_window({ file_url });
        };

        // NB: URLs from outside the browser, such as a link clicked in another app, never open in a private window.
        app->on_new_tab = [&](auto const& urls) {
            auto* non_private_window = app->non_private_window_if_any();
            if (!non_private_window) {
                app->new_window(urls);
                return;
            }

            auto& window = *non_private_window;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < urls.size(); ++i) {
                window.new_tab_from_url(urls[i], (i == 0) ? Web::HTML::ActivateTab::Yes : Web::HTML::ActivateTab::No, Ladybird::BrowserWindow::TabLocation::end());
            }
            window.show();
            window.activateWindow();
            window.raise();
        };

        app->on_new_window = [&](auto const& urls) {
            app->new_window(urls, app->configuration_for_new_window());
        };

        auto configuration = app->configuration_for_new_window();
        if (auto* restored_window = app->restore_previous_session(configuration)) {
            // A whole restored session replaces the usual startup tab, so only the URLs the user passed open with it.
            // With only pinned tabs restored, the usual startup tabs open after them. A restart passes on the URLs
            // that the browser was started with, which are among the restored tabs already.
            auto follows_restart = Ladybird::Application::session_store(WebView::IsPrivate::No).follows_restart();
            auto restored_everything = app->launch_restore_policy() == Ladybird::SessionLaunchPolicy::Everything;
            if (!follows_restart && (!restored_everything || !browser_options.raw_urls.is_empty()))
                app->open_startup_tabs(*restored_window, browser_options.urls);
            app->offer_to_restore_unexpectedly_closed_tabs(*restored_window);
        } else {
            auto& window = app->new_window(browser_options.urls, configuration);
            window.setWindowTitle(BROWSER_PRODUCT_NAME);
            app->offer_to_restore_unexpectedly_closed_tabs(window);
        }
    }

    // NB: Messages to the Hub arrive in order, so this comes after whatever these windows have asked to show.
    if (auto* hub = Ladybird::HubConnection::the_if_connected())
        hub->async_ui_did_start();

    auto exit_status = TRY(app->execute());
    auto restart = app->take_restart_command();
    app = nullptr;
    if (restart.has_value())
        TRY(restart->run());
    return exit_status;
}

static constexpr auto DYNAMIC_HISTORY_MENU_ITEM_PROPERTY = "LadybirdDynamicHistoryMenuItem";
static constexpr auto HISTORY_NAVIGATION_SEPARATOR_PROPERTY = "LadybirdHistoryNavigationSeparator";
static constexpr size_t RECENT_HISTORY_MENU_ITEM_LIMIT = 15;

static void set_action_shortcuts(QAction&, ActionID);

class ActionObserver final : public Action::Observer {
public:
    static NonnullOwnPtr<ActionObserver> create(Action& action, QAction& qaction, IncludeActionIcon include_action_icon)
    {
        return adopt_own(*new ActionObserver(action, qaction, include_action_icon));
    }

    virtual ~ActionObserver() override
    {
        QObject::disconnect(m_triggered_connection);
        QObject::disconnect(m_destroyed_connection);
    }

    virtual void on_text_changed(Action& action) override
    {
        if (m_action)
            m_action->setText(qstring_from_ak_string(action.text()));
    }

    virtual void on_tooltip_changed(Action& action) override
    {
        if (m_action)
            m_action->setToolTip(qstring_from_ak_string(action.tooltip()));
    }

    virtual void on_enabled_state_changed(Action& action) override
    {
        if (m_action)
            m_action->setEnabled(action.enabled());
    }

    virtual void on_visible_state_changed(Action& action) override
    {
        if (m_action) {
            m_action->setVisible(action.visible());

            for (auto* object : m_action->associatedObjects()) {
                if (auto* tool_button = as_if<QToolButton>(object))
                    tool_button->setVisible(action.visible());
            }
        }
    }

    virtual void on_engaged_state_changed(Action& action) override
    {
        if (m_include_action_icon == IncludeActionIcon::No)
            return;

        if (!m_action)
            return;

        switch (action.id()) {
        case ActionID::ToggleVerticalTabsExpanded:
            if (auto* parent = as_if<QWidget>(m_action->parent())) {
                auto const& tab_settings = Application::settings().tab_settings();
                auto icon = tab_settings.vertical_tabs_position == WebView::VerticalTabsPosition::Right ? ChromeIcon::SidebarRight : ChromeIcon::Sidebar;
                m_action->setIcon(create_chrome_icon(icon, parent->palette()));
            }
            break;

        case ActionID::ToggleBookmark:
        case ActionID::ToggleBookmarkViaToolbar:
            // A bookmarked page's star is filled in.
            if (auto* parent = as_if<QWidget>(m_action->parent())) {
                auto icon = action.engaged() ? ChromeIcon::StarFilled : ChromeIcon::Star;
                m_action->setIcon(create_chrome_icon(icon, parent->palette()));
            }
            break;

        case ActionID::TranslatePage:
            if (auto* parent = as_if<QWidget>(m_action->parent()))
                m_action->setIcon(create_translate_icon(parent->palette(), action.engaged()));
            break;

        default:
            break;
        }
    }

    virtual void on_checked_state_changed(Action& action) override
    {
        if (m_action)
            m_action->setChecked(action.checked());
    }

    // QAction has no busy state, so it's a property, and the buttons that show it learn of a change as of any other.
    virtual void on_busy_state_changed(Action& action) override
    {
        if (!m_action || m_action->property(BUSY_ACTION_PROPERTY).toBool() == action.busy())
            return;
        m_action->setProperty(BUSY_ACTION_PROPERTY, action.busy());
        Q_EMIT m_action->changed();
    }

    virtual void on_shortcut_hint_changed(Action& action) override
    {
        if (!m_action)
            return;

        auto hint = action.shortcut_hint();
        set_action_shortcuts(*m_action, hint.value_or(action.id()));

        // A hint leaves the window shortcut with the action that owns it.
        m_action->setShortcutContext(hint.has_value() ? Qt::WidgetShortcut : Qt::WindowShortcut);
    }

private:
    ActionObserver(Action& action, QAction& qaction, IncludeActionIcon include_action_icon)
        : m_action(&qaction)
        , m_include_action_icon(include_action_icon)
    {
        m_triggered_connection = QObject::connect(m_action, &QAction::triggered, [weak_action = action.make_weak_ptr()](bool checked) {
            if (auto action = weak_action.strong_ref()) {
                if (action->is_checkable())
                    action->set_checked(checked);
                action->activate();

                if (first_is_one_of(action->id(), ActionID::BookmarkItem, ActionID::Reload, ActionID::ReloadBypassingCache)) {
                    if (auto* active_tab = Application::the().active_tab())
                        active_tab->view().setFocus();
                }
            }
        });
        m_destroyed_connection = QObject::connect(&qaction, &QObject::destroyed, [this, weak_action = action.make_weak_ptr()]() {
            if (auto action = weak_action.strong_ref())
                action->remove_observer(*this);
        });
    }

    QPointer<QAction> m_action;
    IncludeActionIcon m_include_action_icon { IncludeActionIcon::Yes };
    QMetaObject::Connection m_triggered_connection;
    QMetaObject::Connection m_destroyed_connection;
};

class MenuObserver final : public Menu::Observer {
public:
    static NonnullOwnPtr<MenuObserver> create(Menu& menu, QMenu& qmenu)
    {
        return adopt_own(*new MenuObserver(menu, qmenu));
    }

    virtual void on_visible_state_changed(Menu& menu) override
    {
        if (m_menu && m_menu->menuAction())
            m_menu->menuAction()->setVisible(menu.visible());
    }

private:
    MenuObserver(Menu& menu, QMenu& qmenu)
        : m_menu(&qmenu)
    {
        QObject::connect(&qmenu, &QObject::destroyed, [this, weak_menu = menu.make_weak_ptr()]() {
            if (auto menu = weak_menu.strong_ref())
                menu->remove_observer(*this);
        });
    }

    QPointer<QMenu> m_menu;
};

template<typename T>
static void add_properties(QObject& object, T& menu_or_action)
{
    for (auto const& [key, value] : menu_or_action.properties())
        object.setProperty(key.to_byte_string().characters(), qstring_from_ak_string(value));
}

static void set_action_shortcuts(QAction& qaction, ActionID id)
{
    qaction.setShortcuts({});

    switch (id) {
    case ActionID::NavigateBack:
        qaction.setShortcuts(QKeySequence::keyBindings(QKeySequence::StandardKey::Back));
        break;
    case ActionID::NavigateForward:
        qaction.setShortcuts(QKeySequence::keyBindings(QKeySequence::StandardKey::Forward));
        break;
    case ActionID::Reload:
        qaction.setShortcuts({ QKeySequence(Qt::CTRL | Qt::Key_R), QKeySequence(Qt::Key_F5) });
        break;
    case ActionID::ReloadBypassingCache:
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
        qaction.setShortcuts({ QKeySequence(Qt::CTRL | Qt::ALT | Qt::Key_R), QKeySequence(Qt::CTRL | Qt::SHIFT | Qt::Key_R) });
#else
        qaction.setShortcuts({ QKeySequence(Qt::CTRL | Qt::SHIFT | Qt::Key_R), QKeySequence(Qt::CTRL | Qt::Key_F5) });
#endif
        break;
    case ActionID::ViewDownloads:
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
        qaction.setShortcut(QKeySequence(Qt::CTRL | Qt::ALT | Qt::Key_L));
#else
        qaction.setShortcut(QKeySequence(Qt::CTRL | Qt::Key_J));
#endif
        break;

    case ActionID::Undo:
        qaction.setShortcut(QKeySequence::StandardKey::Undo);
        break;
    case ActionID::Redo:
        qaction.setShortcuts(QKeySequence::keyBindings(QKeySequence::StandardKey::Redo));
        break;
    case ActionID::CopySelection:
        qaction.setShortcut(QKeySequence::StandardKey::Copy);
        break;
    case ActionID::CutSelection:
        qaction.setShortcut(QKeySequence::StandardKey::Cut);
        break;
    case ActionID::Paste:
        qaction.setShortcut(QKeySequence::StandardKey::Paste);
        break;
    case ActionID::PasteAndMatchStyle:
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
        qaction.setShortcuts({ QKeySequence(Qt::CTRL | Qt::ALT | Qt::SHIFT | Qt::Key_V), QKeySequence(Qt::CTRL | Qt::SHIFT | Qt::Key_V) });
#else
        qaction.setShortcut(QKeySequence(Qt::CTRL | Qt::SHIFT | Qt::Key_V));
#endif
        break;
    case ActionID::SelectAll:
        qaction.setShortcut(QKeySequence::StandardKey::SelectAll);
        break;

    case ActionID::ToggleBookmark:
        qaction.setShortcut(QKeySequence(Qt::CTRL | Qt::Key_D));
        break;
    case ActionID::ToggleBookmarksBar:
        qaction.setShortcut(QKeySequence(Qt::CTRL | Qt::SHIFT | Qt::Key_B));
        break;
    case ActionID::ToggleVerticalTabsExpanded:
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
        qaction.setShortcut(QKeySequence(Qt::CTRL | Qt::ALT | Qt::Key_S));
#else
        qaction.setShortcut(QKeySequence(Qt::CTRL | Qt::SHIFT | Qt::Key_S));
#endif
        break;
    case ActionID::AddBookmarkAllTabs:
        qaction.setShortcut(QKeySequence(Qt::CTRL | Qt::SHIFT | Qt::Key_D));
        break;
    case ActionID::ViewHistory:
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
        qaction.setShortcut(QKeySequence(Qt::CTRL | Qt::Key_Y));
#else
        qaction.setShortcut(QKeySequence(Qt::CTRL | Qt::Key_H));
#endif
        break;
    case ActionID::ManageBookmarks:
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
        qaction.setShortcut(QKeySequence(Qt::CTRL | Qt::ALT | Qt::Key_B));
#else
        qaction.setShortcut(QKeySequence(Qt::CTRL | Qt::SHIFT | Qt::Key_O));
#endif
        break;
    case ActionID::ClearBrowsingData:
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
        qaction.setShortcut(QKeySequence(Qt::CTRL | Qt::SHIFT | Qt::Key_Backspace));
#else
        qaction.setShortcut(QKeySequence(Qt::CTRL | Qt::SHIFT | Qt::Key_Delete));
#endif
        break;
    case ActionID::OpenTaskManager:
        qaction.setShortcut(QKeySequence(Qt::CTRL | Qt::SHIFT | Qt::Key_M));
        break;
    case ActionID::OpenSettingsPage:
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
        qaction.setShortcut(QKeySequence::StandardKey::Preferences);
#else
        qaction.setShortcut(QKeySequence(Qt::CTRL | Qt::Key_Comma));
#endif
        break;
    case ActionID::ToggleDevTools:
        qaction.setShortcuts({
            QKeySequence(Qt::CTRL | Qt::SHIFT | Qt::Key_I),
            QKeySequence(Qt::CTRL | Qt::SHIFT | Qt::Key_C),
            QKeySequence(Qt::Key_F12),
        });
        break;
    case ActionID::ViewSource:
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
        qaction.setShortcut(QKeySequence(Qt::CTRL | Qt::ALT | Qt::Key_U));
#else
        qaction.setShortcut(QKeySequence(Qt::CTRL | Qt::Key_U));
#endif
        break;

    case ActionID::ZoomIn: {
        auto zoom_in_shortcuts = QKeySequence::keyBindings(QKeySequence::StandardKey::ZoomIn);
        auto secondary_zoom_in_shortcut = QKeySequence(Qt::CTRL | Qt::Key_Equal);

        if (!zoom_in_shortcuts.contains(secondary_zoom_in_shortcut))
            zoom_in_shortcuts.append(move(secondary_zoom_in_shortcut));

        qaction.setShortcuts(zoom_in_shortcuts);
        break;
    }
    case ActionID::ZoomOut:
        qaction.setShortcut(QKeySequence::StandardKey::ZoomOut);
        break;
    case ActionID::ResetZoom:
        qaction.setShortcut(QKeySequence(Qt::CTRL | Qt::Key_0));
        break;

    default:
        break;
    }
}

static Action::Observer& initialize_native_control(Action& action, QAction& qaction, QPalette const& palette, IncludeActionIcon include_action_icon)
{
    static constexpr int const MENU_ICON_SIZE = 16;

    switch (action.id()) {
    case ActionID::NavigateBack:
        if (include_action_icon == IncludeActionIcon::Yes)
            qaction.setIcon(create_chrome_icon(ChromeIcon::Back, palette));
        break;
    case ActionID::NavigateForward:
        if (include_action_icon == IncludeActionIcon::Yes)
            qaction.setIcon(create_chrome_icon(ChromeIcon::Forward, palette));
        break;
    case ActionID::Reload:
        if (include_action_icon == IncludeActionIcon::Yes)
            qaction.setIcon(create_chrome_icon(ChromeIcon::Reload, palette));
        break;
    case ActionID::ViewDownloads:
        if (include_action_icon == IncludeActionIcon::Yes)
            qaction.setIcon(create_chrome_icon(ChromeIcon::Download, palette));
        break;
    case ActionID::ToggleBookmark:
    case ActionID::ToggleBookmarkViaToolbar:
        if (include_action_icon == IncludeActionIcon::Yes)
            qaction.setIcon(create_chrome_icon(action.engaged() ? ChromeIcon::StarFilled : ChromeIcon::Star, palette));
        break;
    case ActionID::TranslatePage:
        if (include_action_icon == IncludeActionIcon::Yes)
            qaction.setIcon(create_translate_icon(palette, action.engaged()));
        break;
    case ActionID::BookmarkItem:
        if (auto icon = action.png_icon(); icon.has_value())
            qaction.setIcon(favicon_from_png(icon->bytes(), MENU_ICON_SIZE));
        else
            qaction.setIcon(create_chrome_icon(ChromeIcon::Globe, palette));
        break;
    default:
        break;
    }

    qaction.setShortcutVisibleInContextMenu(true);

    if (action.is_checkable())
        qaction.setCheckable(true);

    auto observer = ActionObserver::create(action, qaction, include_action_icon);
    auto& observer_reference = *observer;
    action.add_observer(move(observer));
    add_properties(qaction, action);
    return observer_reference;
}

static void add_items_to_menu(QMenu& qmenu, Menu& menu)
{
    for (auto& menu_item : menu.items()) {
        menu_item.visit(
            [&](NonnullRefPtr<Action>& action) {
                auto* qaction = create_application_action(qmenu, action, IncludeActionIcon::No);
                qmenu.addAction(qaction);
            },
            [&](NonnullRefPtr<Menu> const& submenu) {
                auto* qsubmenu = create_application_menu(qmenu, submenu);

                if (submenu->render_group_icon())
                    qsubmenu->setIcon(create_chrome_icon(ChromeIcon::Folder, qmenu.palette()));

                qmenu.addMenu(qsubmenu);
            },
            [&](Separator) {
                qmenu.addSeparator();
            });
    }

#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
    enable_menu_icons(qmenu);
#endif
}

static QAction* create_session_history_traversal_menu_action(QMenu& menu, RemoteView::SessionHistoryTraversalMenuItem const& item)
{
    static constexpr int const MENU_ICON_SIZE = 16;

    auto* action = new QAction(qstring_from_ak_string(item.title), &menu);
    action->setToolTip(qstring_from_ak_string(item.url));
    if (item.favicon_png.has_value())
        action->setIcon(favicon_from_png(item.favicon_png->bytes(), MENU_ICON_SIZE));
    else
        action->setIcon(create_chrome_icon(ChromeIcon::Globe, menu.palette()));
    action->setData(item.step);
    return action;
}

static bool append_session_history_traversal_menu_items(QMenu& menu, WebContentView& view, int direction)
{
    auto items = view.session_history_traversal_menu_items(direction);
    if (items.is_empty())
        return false;

    for (auto const& item : items)
        menu.addAction(create_session_history_traversal_menu_action(menu, item));

#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
    enable_menu_icons(menu);
#endif

    return true;
}

void populate_session_history_traversal_menu(QMenu& menu, WebContentView& view, int direction)
{
    menu.clear();
    append_session_history_traversal_menu_items(menu, view, direction);
}

QMenu* create_application_menu(QWidget& parent, Menu& menu)
{
    auto* application_menu = new QMenu(qstring_from_ak_string(menu.title()), &parent);
    menu.add_observer(MenuObserver::create(menu, *application_menu));
    add_properties(*application_menu, menu);
    add_items_to_menu(*application_menu, menu);
    return application_menu;
}

QMenu& replace_context_menu(QPointer<QMenu>& shown_menu, QWidget& parent, Menu& menu)
{
    // NB: A menu is kept until another is shown in its place, as Cocoa delivers a native menu's choice through queued
    //     events after the menu closes.
    if (shown_menu)
        shown_menu->deleteLater();
    shown_menu = create_application_menu(parent, menu);
    return *shown_menu;
}

void execute_context_menu_later(QPointer<QMenu>& shown_menu, QWidget& parent, Menu& menu, QPoint const& global_position)
{
    auto& context_menu = replace_context_menu(shown_menu, parent, menu);

    // NB: Showing a menu runs a nested event loop, which may destroy whatever asked for the menu. So it runs with
    //     nothing of the caller's on the stack.
    QTimer::singleShot(0, &context_menu, [&context_menu, global_position] {
        execute_context_menu(context_menu, global_position);
    });
}

void repopulate_application_menu(QMenu& menu, Menu& source)
{
    // NB: A submenu's action belongs to the submenu, so clearing the menu only removes it.
    for (auto* action : menu.actions()) {
        if (auto* submenu = action->menu())
            submenu->deleteLater();
    }
    menu.clear();
    add_items_to_menu(menu, source);
}

static void insert_dynamic_history_action(QMenu& menu, QAction* before, QAction& action)
{
    action.setProperty(DYNAMIC_HISTORY_MENU_ITEM_PROPERTY, true);
    menu.insertAction(before, &action);
}

static QAction* create_dynamic_history_separator(QMenu& menu)
{
    auto* separator = new QAction(&menu);
    separator->setSeparator(true);
    return separator;
}

static QAction* create_recent_history_menu_action(QMenu& menu, WebContentView& view, WebView::HistoryEntry const& entry)
{
    static constexpr int const MENU_ICON_SIZE = 16;

    auto title = entry.title.has_value() && !entry.title->is_empty() ? *entry.title : entry.url;
    auto* action = new QAction(qstring_from_ak_string(title), &menu);
    action->setToolTip(qstring_from_ak_string(entry.url));
    if (entry.favicon_png.has_value())
        action->setIcon(favicon_from_png(entry.favicon_png->bytes(), MENU_ICON_SIZE));
    else
        action->setIcon(create_chrome_icon(ChromeIcon::Globe, menu.palette()));

    auto url = URL::Parser::basic_parse(entry.url);
    if (url.has_value()) {
        QObject::connect(action, &QAction::triggered, &view, [&view, url = url.release_value()] {
            view.load_from_user_input(url);
        });
    } else {
        action->setEnabled(false);
    }

    return action;
}

// NB: Back and Forward stay in the History menu at all times, so their shortcuts work before the menu is first shown.
void add_history_navigation_actions(QMenu& menu, QAction& back, QAction& forward)
{
    auto* first = menu.actions().isEmpty() ? nullptr : menu.actions().first();
    menu.insertAction(first, &back);
    menu.insertAction(first, &forward);
    menu.insertSeparator(first)->setProperty(HISTORY_NAVIGATION_SEPARATOR_PROPERTY, true);
}

void update_history_menu(QMenu& menu, WebContentView* view)
{
    for (auto* action : menu.actions()) {
        if (action->property(DYNAMIC_HISTORY_MENU_ITEM_PROPERTY).toBool()) {
            menu.removeAction(action);
            action->deleteLater();
        }
    }

    if (!view)
        return;

    // NB: The recent entries go after Back, Forward and the separator below them.
    QAction* insertion_point = nullptr;
    auto actions = menu.actions();
    for (qsizetype i = 0; i < actions.size(); ++i) {
        if (actions[i]->property(HISTORY_NAVIGATION_SEPARATOR_PROPERTY).toBool()) {
            insertion_point = i + 1 < actions.size() ? actions[i + 1] : nullptr;
            break;
        }
    }

    auto entries = view->recent_history_entries(RECENT_HISTORY_MENU_ITEM_LIMIT);
    for (auto const& entry : entries) {
        auto* action = create_recent_history_menu_action(menu, *view, entry);
        insert_dynamic_history_action(menu, insertion_point, *action);
    }

    if (!entries.is_empty())
        insert_dynamic_history_action(menu, insertion_point, *create_dynamic_history_separator(menu));

#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
    enable_menu_icons(menu);
#endif
}

QAction* create_application_action(QWidget& parent, Action& action, IncludeActionIcon include_action_icon)
{
    auto* qaction = new QAction(&parent);
    initialize_native_control(action, *qaction, parent.palette(), include_action_icon);
    return qaction;
}

// The menu's zoom row: its label like an item's, and the page's zoom level between buttons to zoom out and in.
MenuZoomRow::MenuZoomRow(QMenu& menu, QAction& zoom_out, QAction& reset_zoom, QAction& zoom_in, QAction& zoom_level)
    : QWidgetAction(&menu)
{
    auto* row = new QWidget(&menu);
    row->setObjectName("LadybirdMenuZoomRow");
    auto* layout = new QHBoxLayout(row);
    layout->setContentsMargins(10, 3, 10, 3);
    layout->setSpacing(2);
    layout->addWidget(new QLabel("Zoom", row), 1);

    auto add_button = [&](char const* object_name, QString const& tooltip, QAction& action) {
        auto* button = new QPushButton(row);
        button->setObjectName(object_name);
        button->setToolTip(tooltip);
        button->setAccessibleName(tooltip);
        button->setFocusPolicy(Qt::NoFocus);
        QObject::connect(button, &QPushButton::clicked, &action, &QAction::trigger);
        layout->addWidget(button);
        return button;
    };
    m_zoom_out = add_button("LadybirdMenuZoomButton", "Zoom Out", zoom_out);
    auto* level = add_button("LadybirdMenuZoomLevel", "Reset Zoom", reset_zoom);
    // NB: The level is drawn in figures of one width, so it doesn't shift as it changes.
    auto level_font = level->font();
    level_font.setFeature(QFont::Tag("tnum"), 1);
    level->setFont(level_font);
    m_zoom_in = add_button("LadybirdMenuZoomButton", "Zoom In", zoom_in);

    auto update_level = [&zoom_level, level] {
        // The address bar hides its zoom action at the default level and keeps its last text.
        level->setText(zoom_level.isVisible() && !zoom_level.text().isEmpty() ? zoom_level.text() : QStringLiteral("100%"));
    };
    QObject::connect(&zoom_level, &QAction::changed, level, update_level);
    update_level();

    setDefaultWidget(row);
    update_style();
}

void MenuZoomRow::update_style()
{
    defaultWidget()->setStyleSheet(ChromeStyle::menu_zoom_row_style_sheet());
    m_zoom_out->setIcon(create_chrome_icon(ChromeIcon::ZoomOut, Theme::panel().body));
    m_zoom_in->setIcon(create_chrome_icon(ChromeIcon::NewTab, Theme::panel().body));
}

ActionBinding::ActionBinding(QWidget& parent, IncludeActionIcon include_action_icon)
    : m_action(new QAction(&parent))
    , m_include_action_icon(include_action_icon)
{
}

void ActionBinding::bind(Action& action)
{
    if (m_bound_action.ptr() == &action)
        return;
    if (auto bound_action = m_bound_action.strong_ref())
        bound_action->remove_observer(*m_observer);

    m_bound_action = action;
    auto const& palette = static_cast<QWidget*>(m_action->parent())->palette();
    m_observer = &initialize_native_control(action, *m_action, palette, m_include_action_icon);
}

#if !defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
void execute_context_menu(QMenu& menu, QPoint const& global_position)
{
    menu.exec(global_position);
}
#endif

}

#include <UI/Qt/Menu.h>

#include <QAction>
#include <QApplication>
#include <QCursor>
#include <QMenu>
#include <QPointer>
#include <QWindow>
#include <qpa/qplatformmenu.h>
#include <qpa/qwindowsysteminterface.h>

#import <AppKit/AppKit.h>

namespace Ladybird {

void enable_menu_icons([[maybe_unused]] QMenu& menu)
{
#if __MAC_OS_X_VERSION_MAX_ALLOWED >= 270000
    if (@available(macOS 27, *)) {
        NSMenu* native_menu = menu.toNSMenu();

        for (NSMenuItem* item in [native_menu itemArray]) {
            [item setPreferredImageVisibility:NSMenuItemImageVisibilityVisible];
        }
    }
#endif
}

static void hide_native_context_menu_shortcuts(QMenu& menu)
{
    static constexpr auto property = "LadybirdHideNativeContextMenuShortcuts";
    if (menu.property(property).toBool() || !menu.toNSMenu())
        return;
    menu.setProperty(property, true);

    // Qt ignores QAction::isShortcutVisibleInContextMenu() for native menus, so the shortcuts of the actions that
    // don't show theirs are removed from the native items. Run after Qt's aboutToShow handling, which can update the
    // native items.
    QObject::connect(menu.platformMenu(), &QPlatformMenu::aboutToShow, &menu, [&menu] {
        auto actions = menu.actions();
        for (auto* action : actions) {
            if (auto* submenu = action->menu())
                hide_native_context_menu_shortcuts(*submenu);
        }

        // NB: The native menu has an item for each action, separators included, in the same order.
        NSArray<NSMenuItem*>* items = menu.toNSMenu().itemArray;
        for (NSUInteger index = 0; index < items.count; ++index) {
            if (index < static_cast<NSUInteger>(actions.size()) && actions[index]->isShortcutVisibleInContextMenu())
                continue;
            items[index].keyEquivalent = @"";
            items[index].keyEquivalentModifierMask = 0;
        }
    });
}

void execute_context_menu(QMenu& menu, QPoint const& global_position)
{
    auto* parent = menu.parentWidget();
    if (!parent) {
        menu.exec(global_position);
        return;
    }

    parent->window()->winId();

    // Page views have their own native window. Track the menu against the native widget under the popup position,
    // not always the top-level browser window.
    auto* source = QApplication::widgetAt(global_position);
    if (!source || source->window() != parent->window())
        source = parent;
    auto* window = source->windowHandle() ? source : source->nativeParentWidget();

    if (!menu.toNSMenu()) {
        menu.exec(global_position);
        return;
    }

    hide_native_context_menu_shortcuts(menu);

    // AppKit appends Services and Writing Tools items that act on the window's focused text input, which is not what
    // the menu was opened for.
    NSMenu* native_menu = menu.toNSMenu();
    native_menu.allowsContextMenuPlugIns = NO;
#if __MAC_OS_X_VERSION_MAX_ALLOWED >= 150200
    if (@available(macOS 15.2, *))
        native_menu.automaticallyInsertsWritingToolsItems = NO;
#endif

    // AppKit consumes the mouse release while tracking the menu. Use Qt's Cocoa popup implementation so its native
    // mouse-button state is reset afterwards.
    QPointer window_handle = window->windowHandle();
    menu.platformMenu()->showPopup(window_handle, QRect { window->mapFromGlobal(global_position), QSize {} }, nullptr);

    // Qt Widgets also keeps an implicit grab until it receives the last release. Send the releases swallowed by AppKit
    // through Qt's window-system interface to clear both that grab and QGuiApplication's cached mouse-button state.
    if (window_handle && NSEvent.pressedMouseButtons == 0) {
        auto buttons = QApplication::mouseButtons();
        auto position = QCursor::pos();

        for (unsigned bit = Qt::LeftButton; bit <= Qt::MaxMouseButton && window_handle; bit <<= 1) {
            auto button = static_cast<Qt::MouseButton>(bit);
            if (!buttons.testFlag(button))
                continue;
            buttons &= ~button;

            QWindowSystemInterface::handleMouseEvent<QWindowSystemInterface::SynchronousDelivery>(
                window_handle, window_handle->mapFromGlobal(position), position, buttons, button,
                QEvent::MouseButtonRelease, QApplication::queryKeyboardModifiers());
        }
    }
}

}

#pragma once

namespace Ladybird {

struct PendingMicrophoneRequests;

}

// The system asks the user on behalf of the process responsible for the browser: the app, or the terminal that ran it.
// The AudioServer that opens the device answers to the same one.
class MicrophoneAuthorizerMacOS final : public WebView::MicrophoneAuthorizer {
public:
    MicrophoneAuthorizerMacOS();
    virtual ~MicrophoneAuthorizerMacOS() override;

    virtual WebView::MicrophoneAuthorization authorization() const override;
    virtual void request_authorization(Function<void(WebView::MicrophoneAuthorization)> on_complete) override;
    virtual void open_system_settings() override;

private:
    NonnullRefPtr<Detail::PendingMicrophoneRequests> m_pending_requests;
};

}

FILE: UI/Qt/MicrophoneAuthorizerMacOS.mm
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <AK/AtomicRefCounted.h>
#include <AK/RefPtr.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibCore/EventLoop.h>
#include <UI/Qt/MicrophoneAuthorizerMacOS.h>

#import <AVFoundation/AVFoundation.h>
#import <CoreServices/CoreServices.h>

namespace Ladybird {

using WebView::MicrophoneAuthorization;

namespace Detail {

// The answer comes back on an arbitrary queue. The callbacks that take it stay on the main thread, so only this
// atomically counted holder crosses threads.
struct PendingMicrophoneRequests : public AtomicRefCounted<PendingMicrophoneRequests> {
    Vector<Function<void(MicrophoneAuthorization)>> callbacks;
};

}

MicrophoneAuthorizerMacOS::MicrophoneAuthorizerMacOS()
    : m_pending_requests(adopt_ref(*new Detail::PendingMicrophoneRequests))
{
}

MicrophoneAuthorizerMacOS::~MicrophoneAuthorizerMacOS() = default;

MicrophoneAuthorization MicrophoneAuthorizerMacOS::authorization() const
{
    switch ([AVCaptureDevice authorizationStatusForMediaType:AVMediaTypeAudio]) {
    case AVAuthorizationStatusNotDetermined:
        return MicrophoneAuthorization::NotDetermined;
    case AVAuthorizationStatusAuthorized:
        return MicrophoneAuthorization::Authorized;
    case AVAuthorizationStatusDenied:
    case AVAuthorizationStatusRestricted:
        return MicrophoneAuthorization::Denied;
    }
    return MicrophoneAuthorization::Denied;
}

void MicrophoneAuthorizerMacOS::request_authorization(Function<void(MicrophoneAuthorization)> on_complete)
{
    // Requests made while the system is asking share its answer.
    m_pending_requests->callbacks.append(move(on_complete));
    if (m_pending_requests->callbacks.size() > 1)
        return;

    RefPtr<Detail::PendingMicrophoneRequests> pending_requests = m_pending_requests;
    RefPtr<Core::WeakEventLoopReference> event_loop = Core::EventLoop::current_weak();
    [AVCaptureDevice requestAccessForMediaType:AVMediaTypeAudio
                             completionHandler:^(BOOL granted) {
                                 auto strong_event_loop = event_loop->take();
                                 if (!strong_event_loop)
                                     return;
                                 auto authorization = granted ? MicrophoneAuthorization::Authorized : MicrophoneAuthorization::Denied;
                                 strong_event_loop->deferred_invoke([pending_requests, authorization] {
                                     auto callbacks = move(pending_requests->callbacks);
                                     for (auto& callback : callbacks)
                                         callback(authorization);
                                 });
                             }];
}

void MicrophoneAuthorizerMacOS::open_system_settings()
{
    auto* url = [NSURL URLWithString:@"x-apple.systempreferences:com.apple.preference.security?Privacy_Microphone"];
    LSOpenCFURLRef((__bridge CFURLRef)url, nullptr);
}

}

FILE: UI/Qt/Motion.h
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#pragma once

#include <QEasingCurve>
#include <QPointF>

namespace Ladybird::Motion {

// The durations of the chrome's motion, in milliseconds.
// Hover out, and any state that must feel immediate.
constexpr inline int INSTANT = 0;
// Hover in, focus, menus, the active tab.
constexpr inline int FAST = 100;
// Tabs opening, closing and reordering.
constexpr inline int BASE = 160;
// The sidebar, and anything else that moves far.
constexpr inline int SLOW = 220;
// The way a menu or popover disappears.
constexpr inline int EXIT = 80;

inline QEasingCurve cubic_bezier(qreal x1, qreal y1, qreal x2, qreal y2)
{
    QEasingCurve curve(QEasingCurve::BezierSpline);
    curve.addCubicBezierSegment({ x1, y1 }, { x2, y2 }, { 1, 1 });
    return curve;
}

// For things that appear: fast at first, settling gently.
inline QEasingCurve enter_easing() { return cubic_bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); }
// For things that leave: slow at first, then gone.
inline QEasingCurve exit_easing() { return cubic_bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1); }
// For things that move from one place to another.
inline QEasingCurve move_easing() { return cubic_bezier(0.3, 0, 0.2, 1); }

// How far along a motion that goes from rest to a peak and back is, from 0 at rest to 1 at the peak. Each half is eased
// as things that appear are.
inline qreal there_and_back(qreal progress, qreal peak_at)
{
    static auto const easing = enter_easing();
    if (progress < peak_at)
        return easing.valueForProgress(progress / peak_at);
    return 1 - easing.valueForProgress((progress - peak_at) / (1 - peak_at));
}

}
