#include <LibCompositing/PictureInPictureControls.h>
#include <UI/Qt/PictureInPictureWindow.h>
#include <UI/Qt/WebContentView.h>
#include <UI/Qt/WindowScreenObserver.h>

#include <QApplication>
#include <QCloseEvent>
#include <QMouseEvent>
#include <QNativeGestureEvent>
#include <QResizeEvent>
#include <QScreen>
#include <QVBoxLayout>
#include <QWheelEvent>
#include <QWidget>
#include <QWindow>

#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
#    include <UI/Qt/MacWindow.h>
#endif

#if defined(AK_OS_WINDOWS)
#    include <AK/Windows.h>
#endif

#if defined(AK_OS_LINUX)
#    include <UI/Qt/X11Window.h>
#endif

namespace Ladybird {

static constexpr int screen_edge_margin = 16;
static constexpr int resize_margin = 6;

static Qt::WindowFlags window_flags()
{
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
    // A tool window is a panel on macOS, which never becomes the main window, so activating Ladybird brings a browser
    // window forward rather than this one.
    return Qt::Tool | Qt::WindowStaysOnTopHint | Qt::FramelessWindowHint;
#else
    return Qt::Window | Qt::WindowStaysOnTopHint | Qt::FramelessWindowHint;
#endif
}

// A frameless window, placed in the bottom-right corner of the screen it is opened from, that floats above other windows.
// It is moved by dragging anywhere on its page, and resized from its edges.
class PictureInPictureWindow final
    : public QWidget
    , public WebView::PictureInPictureWindow {
public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    PictureInPictureWindow(RemoteView const& owner_view, u64 view_id, Gfx::IntSize video_size)
        : QWidget(nullptr, window_flags())
    {
        // The window's native window and view are created for the screen of the browser window it is opened from.
        auto* screen = static_cast<WebContentView const&>(owner_view).screen();
        setScreen(screen);

        setAttribute(Qt::WA_ShowWithoutActivating);
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
        // NB: The window is clear outside its rounded corners.
        setAttribute(Qt::WA_TranslucentBackground);
#endif
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
        // A tool window otherwise hides whenever Ladybird is inactive. Qt's WA_MacAlwaysShowToolWindow would also make
        // it order every window to the front whenever Ladybird is activated, bringing browser windows forward too.
        keep_appkit_window_visible_while_inactive(*this);
#endif
        setWindowTitle("Picture-in-Picture");

        auto available = screen->availableGeometry();

        m_screen_observer = new WindowScreenObserver(*this);
        auto view_initial_state = WebContentViewInitialState {
            .is_private = owner_view.is_private(),
            .maximum_frames_per_second = m_screen_observer->refresh_rate(),
            .display_id = m_screen_observer->display_id(),
            .screen_shows_high_dynamic_range = m_screen_observer->screen_shows_high_dynamic_range(),
            .owner_view_id = owner_view.view_id(),
            .is_tab = false,
        };
        m_view = new WebContentView(this, view_id, view_initial_state);
        m_screen_observer->on_device_pixel_ratio_change = [this] {
            m_view->set_device_pixel_ratio(m_screen_observer->device_pixel_ratio());
        };
        m_screen_observer->on_display_metadata_change = [this] {
            m_view->set_display_metadata(m_screen_observer->display_id(), m_screen_observer->refresh_rate(), m_screen_observer->screen_shows_high_dynamic_range());
        };
        m_view->installEventFilter(this);
        // The window's controls, and its page's, show on hover, which works while Ladybird is in the background too.
        m_view->set_follows_mouse_while_inactive(true);
        m_view->on_finish_handling_mouse_event = [this](Web::MouseEvent const& event, Web::EventResult result) {
            if (event.type == Web::MouseEvent::Type::MouseDown)
                page_did_handle_press(result);
        };

        // The page lays out a new window size only once its main thread is free, so until then its last frame is
        // scaled to keep the video filling the window.
        m_view->set_scales_frames_to_fit(true);

        m_view->enable_picture_in_picture_controls();
        m_view->on_picture_in_picture_control_activated = [this, owner_view_id = owner_view.view_id()](auto control) {
            switch (control) {
            case Compositing::PictureInPictureControl::BackToTab:
                go_back_to_tab(owner_view_id);
                break;
            case Compositing::PictureInPictureControl::Close:
                if (on_close)
                    on_close(VideoKeepsPlaying::No);
                break;
            }
        };

        auto* layout = new QVBoxLayout(this);
        layout->setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0);
        layout->addWidget(m_view);

        auto size = initial_size(video_size, { available.width(), available.height() });
        resize(size.width(), size.height());
        move(available.right() - size.width() - screen_edge_margin, available.bottom() - size.height() - screen_edge_margin);
        show();

#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
        // A frameless window cannot be resized from its edges on macOS unless AppKit is told it is resizable.
        make_appkit_window_resizable(*this);
        // The window has the rounded corners and the faint edge of a floating video.
        round_appkit_view_corners(*this, 12, QColor(255, 255, 255, 20));
#endif
        set_size_limits(video_size);
        lock_aspect_ratio();

        // The maximum size depends on the screen, and on X11 Qt replaces the size hints when the window moves to a screen
        // with another scale factor.
        connect(windowHandle(), &QWindow::screenChanged, this, [this] {
            set_size_limits(m_aspect_ratio);
            lock_aspect_ratio();
        });
    }

    virtual Gfx::IntSize size() const override { return { width(), height() }; }
    virtual String handle() const override { return m_view->handle(); }
    virtual void hide() override { QWidget::hide(); }

    virtual void set_video_size(Gfx::IntSize video_size) override
    {
        // The limits change with the video's shape first, so that they allow the window's new size.
        set_size_limits(video_size);

        auto available = screen()->availableGeometry();
        auto size = size_for_video_size({ width(), height() }, video_size, { available.width(), available.height() });
        if (size != Gfx::IntSize { width(), height() }) {
            // The window stays in the corner of the screen it is nearest.
            auto old_geometry = geometry();
            QRect new_geometry { old_geometry.topLeft(), QSize { size.width(), size.height() } };
            if (old_geometry.center().x() > available.center().x())
                new_geometry.moveRight(old_geometry.right());
            if (old_geometry.center().y() > available.center().y())
                new_geometry.moveBottom(old_geometry.bottom());
            setGeometry(new_geometry);
        }

        lock_aspect_ratio();
    }

private:
    // A drag moves the window, unless the page claims the press that starts it, as the media controls do to scrub. Every
    // press off the window's controls reaches the page, and a drag waits until the page has handled its press rather than
    // guess while it is busy.
    virtual bool eventFilter(QObject* object, QEvent* event) override
    {
        if (object != m_view)
            return false;

        switch (event->type()) {
        case QEvent::MouseButtonPress: {
            auto* mouse_event = static_cast<QMouseEvent*>(event);
            if (mouse_event->button() != Qt::LeftButton)
                return false;
#if !defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
            if (auto edges = resize_edges_for(mouse_event->position().toPoint()); edges != Qt::Edges {}) {
                if (windowHandle()->startSystemResize(edges))
                    return true;
            }
#endif
            m_press = Press { .position = mouse_event->globalPosition().toPoint() };
            return false;
        }
        case QEvent::MouseMove: {
            if (!m_press.has_value())
                return false;
            if (m_press->is_moving_window)
                return true;
            if (m_press->claim != PressClaim::Window)
                return false;
            auto* mouse_event = static_cast<QMouseEvent*>(event);
            if ((mouse_event->globalPosition().toPoint() - m_press->position).manhattanLength() < QApplication::startDragDistance())
                return false;
            m_press->is_moving_window = true;
            // The window takes the press over, so the page sees it cancelled.
            m_view->cancel_mouse_press();
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
            if (start_appkit_window_drag(*this))
                return true;
#endif
            windowHandle()->startSystemMove();
            return true;
        }
        case QEvent::MouseButtonRelease: {
            // The page's press was cancelled once it moved the window, so the page does not see it end.
            auto press_moved_window = m_press.has_value() && m_press->is_moving_window;
            m_press.clear();
            return press_moved_window;
        }
        case QEvent::NativeGesture:
            // The window is sized to its video, so its page is never zoomed.
            return static_cast<QNativeGestureEvent*>(event)->gestureType() == Qt::ZoomNativeGesture;
        case QEvent::Wheel:
            return static_cast<QWheelEvent*>(event)->modifiers().testFlag(Qt::ControlModifier);
        default:
            return false;
        }
    }

    // The window belongs to the tab it was opened from, which comes forward along with its own window, even from being
    // minimized, to play the video there.
    void go_back_to_tab(u64 owner_view_id)
    {
        if (auto* owner = RemoteView::find(owner_view_id)) {
            auto* browser_window = static_cast<WebContentView&>(*owner).window();
            browser_window->setWindowState(browser_window->windowState() & ~Qt::WindowMinimized);
            browser_window->raise();
            browser_window->activateWindow();
            if (owner->on_activate_tab)
                owner->on_activate_tab();
        }
        if (on_close)
            on_close(VideoKeepsPlaying::Yes);
    }

    void page_did_handle_press(Web::EventResult result)
    {
        if (!m_press.has_value() || m_press->claim != PressClaim::Unknown)
            return;
        // A press that runs its default actions is handled too, so only one the page cancelled is claimed.
        m_press->claim = result == Web::EventResult::Cancelled ? PressClaim::Page : PressClaim::Window;
    }

    Qt::Edges resize_edges_for(QPoint position) const
    {
        Qt::Edges edges;
        if (position.x() < resize_margin)
            edges |= Qt::LeftEdge;
        if (position.x() >= width() - resize_margin)
            edges |= Qt::RightEdge;
        if (position.y() < resize_margin)
            edges |= Qt::TopEdge;
        if (position.y() >= height() - resize_margin)
            edges |= Qt::BottomEdge;
        return edges;
    }

    void set_size_limits(Gfx::IntSize video_size)
    {
        m_aspect_ratio = aspect_ratio(video_size);

        auto available = screen()->availableGeometry();
        auto minimum = minimum_size(m_aspect_ratio);
        auto maximum = maximum_size(m_aspect_ratio, { available.width(), available.height() });
        setMinimumSize(minimum.width(), minimum.height());
        setMaximumSize(maximum.width(), maximum.height());
    }

    // On X11, Qt replaces the window's size hints whenever it changes the window's geometry or size limits, so this runs
    // after those.
    void lock_aspect_ratio()
    {
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
        set_appkit_window_content_aspect_ratio(*this, m_aspect_ratio);
#elif defined(AK_OS_LINUX)
        set_x11_window_aspect_ratio(*this, m_aspect_ratio);
#endif
        // Wayland has no window hint for an aspect ratio, so there the window takes its video's shape only when it opens
        // or that shape changes.
    }

#if defined(AK_OS_WINDOWS)
    // Windows lets a window adjust the rect that each step of a resize from its edges would give it.
    virtual bool nativeEvent(QByteArray const& event_type, void* message, qintptr* result) override
    {
        auto* windows_message = static_cast<MSG*>(message);
        if (windows_message->message != WM_SIZING)
            return QWidget::nativeEvent(event_type, message, result);

        auto& rect = *reinterpret_cast<RECT*>(windows_message->lParam);
        auto width = rect.right - rect.left;
        auto height = rect.bottom - rect.top;

        // A top or bottom edge sets the height, and any other edge or corner sets the width. The other dimension then
        // moves the edge that is being dragged, or else the right or bottom edge.
        switch (windows_message->wParam) {
        case WMSZ_TOP:
        case WMSZ_BOTTOM:
            rect.right = rect.left + height * m_aspect_ratio.width() / m_aspect_ratio.height();
            break;
        case WMSZ_TOPLEFT:
        case WMSZ_TOPRIGHT:
            rect.top = rect.bottom - width * m_aspect_ratio.height() / m_aspect_ratio.width();
            break;
        default:
            rect.bottom = rect.top + width * m_aspect_ratio.height() / m_aspect_ratio.width();
            break;
        }

        *result = TRUE;
        return true;
    }
#endif

    virtual void resizeEvent(QResizeEvent* event) override
    {
        QWidget::resizeEvent(event);
        if (on_resize)
            on_resize(size());
    }

    virtual void closeEvent(QCloseEvent* event) override
    {
        // Closing only hides the window, which stays until its page has closed, as the manager asks for once the page's
        // video has exited.
        event->accept();
        if (on_close)
            on_close(VideoKeepsPlaying::No);
    }

    WebContentView* m_view { nullptr };
    WindowScreenObserver* m_screen_observer { nullptr };
    Gfx::IntSize m_aspect_ratio;

    enum class PressClaim : u8 {
        Unknown,
        Page,
        Window,
    };
    struct Press {
        QPoint position;
        PressClaim claim { PressClaim::Unknown };
        bool is_moving_window { false };
    };
    Optional<Press> m_press;
};

NonnullOwnPtr<WebView::PictureInPictureWindow> create_picture_in_picture_window(RemoteView const& owner_view, u64 view_id, Gfx::IntSize video_size)
{
    return make<PictureInPictureWindow>(owner_view, view_id, video_size);
}

}

#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/TypeCasts.h>
#include <UI/Qt/ChromeStyle.h>
#include <UI/Qt/PlainText.h>
#include <UI/Qt/TabBar.h>
#include <UI/Qt/Theme.h>

#include <QAbstractItemView>
#include <QBasicTimer>

namespace Ladybird {

// A page's tooltip can be as long as it likes, so this is what's laid out of it, whatever its length.
static constexpr qsizetype MAXIMUM_TEXT_LENGTH = 2048;
static constexpr int MAXIMUM_LINE_COUNT = 24;
static constexpr int MAXIMUM_TEXT_WIDTH = 480;

static constexpr int HORIZONTAL_TEXT_MARGIN = 6;
static constexpr int VERTICAL_TEXT_MARGIN = 3;

static constexpr int HIDE_DELAY_MS = 300;

static constexpr QChar ELLIPSIS { 0x2026 };

// How far from the point of interest a tooltip starts, to clear the mouse cursor, where its size isn't known.
static constexpr QPoint FALLBACK_CURSOR_OFFSET { 2, 24 };

static QString with_length_at_most(QString const& text, qsizetype length)
{
    if (length > 0 && length < text.length() && text[length].isLowSurrogate())
        --length;
    return text.left(length);
}

static QString tooltip_text_for_layout(QString const& text)
{
    auto result = text.length() > MAXIMUM_TEXT_LENGTH ? with_length_at_most(text, MAXIMUM_TEXT_LENGTH) + ELLIPSIS : text;
    result.replace(QStringLiteral("\r\n"), QStringLiteral("\n"));
    result.replace(QLatin1Char('\r'), QLatin1Char('\n'));
    // NB: A QTextLayout is a single paragraph, so that's what its line breaks have to be.
    result.replace(QLatin1Char('\n'), QChar::LineSeparator);
    return result;
}

static QScreen* screen_at(QPoint global_position, QWidget const& widget)
{
    auto* guess = widget.screen();
    auto* exact = guess->virtualSiblingAt(global_position);
    return exact ? exact : guess;
}

static QSize cursor_size_for_tooltip([[maybe_unused]] QWidget const& widget, [[maybe_unused]] QScreen const& screen)
{
#if defined(Q_OS_LINUX) && !defined(Q_OS_ANDROID)
    // X11 uses native pixels for both cursor pixmaps and XCURSOR_SIZE.
    auto const is_x11 = QGuiApplication::platformName() == "xcb";
    auto const* override_cursor = QGuiApplication::overrideCursor();
    auto cursor = override_cursor ? *override_cursor : widget.cursor();
    if (auto pixmap = cursor.pixmap(); !pixmap.isNull())
        return pixmap.size() / (is_x11 ? screen.devicePixelRatio() : pixmap.devicePixelRatio());

    if (auto size = qEnvironmentVariableIntValue("XCURSOR_SIZE"); size > 0)
        return QSize { size, size } / (is_x11 ? screen.devicePixelRatio() : 1);
#elif defined(LADYBIRD_QT_HAS_PLATFORM_CURSOR)
    if (auto const* platform_screen = screen.handle()) {
        auto const* cursor = platform_screen->cursor();
        return QHighDpi::fromNativePixels(cursor ? cursor->size() : QSize(16, 16), platform_screen);
    }
#endif

    return {};
}

static QPoint cursor_offset(QWidget const& widget, QScreen const& screen, int tooltip_height)
{
    auto cursor_size = cursor_size_for_tooltip(widget, screen);
    if (!cursor_size.isValid())
        return FALLBACK_CURSOR_OFFSET;

    // A very large cursor would push the tooltip far away, so it moves to the side of it instead.
    if (cursor_size.height() > 2 * tooltip_height)
        return { cursor_size.width() / 2, 0 };

    return { 2, cursor_size.height() };
}

class PlainTextToolTipWindow final : public QWidget {
public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    // NB: A window with a parent on Windows would raise that parent as it shows.
#if defined(Q_OS_WINDOWS)
    explicit PlainTextToolTipWindow(QWidget&)
        : QWidget(nullptr, Qt::ToolTip | Qt::BypassGraphicsProxyWidget)
#else
    explicit PlainTextToolTipWindow(QWidget& parent)
        : QWidget(&parent, Qt::ToolTip | Qt::BypassGraphicsProxyWidget)
#endif
    {
        setAttribute(Qt::WA_ShowWithoutActivating);
        setFont(QToolTip::font());
        setMouseTracking(true);
        ensurePolished();
        setWindowOpacity(style()->styleHint(QStyle::SH_ToolTipLabel_Opacity, nullptr, this) / 255.0);
    }

    QWidget const* widget() const { return m_widget; }

    bool shows(QString const& text, QPoint local_position) const
    {
        return m_source_text == text && (m_rect.isNull() || m_rect.contains(local_position));
    }

    void set_content(QString const& text, QPoint global_position, QWidget& widget, QRect rect, int display_time_ms)
    {
        m_source_text = text;
        m_widget = &widget;
        m_rect = rect;

        auto* screen = screen_at(global_position, widget);
        setScreen(screen);
        auto size = lay_out_text(tooltip_text_for_layout(text), *screen);
        setAccessibleName(m_layout.text());

        auto display_time = display_time_ms > 0 ? display_time_ms : 10000 + 40 * max(0, static_cast<int>(m_layout.text().length()) - 100);
        m_expire_timer.start(display_time, this);
        m_hide_timer.stop();

        // NB: This window can already be on screen with other text, so it changes in one step, and repaints even if
        //     its size stays the same.
        setGeometry({ position_for(global_position, size, widget, *screen), size });
        update();
    }

    void hide_soon()
    {
        if (!m_hide_timer.isActive())
            m_hide_timer.start(HIDE_DELAY_MS, this);
    }

    void cancel_hide()
    {
        m_hide_timer.stop();
    }

    void hide_now()
    {
        close();
        deleteLater();
    }

    void handle_application_event(QObject* object, QEvent* event)
    {
        switch (event->type()) {
        case QEvent::KeyPress:
        case QEvent::KeyRelease: {
            // Anything but keys such as the modifiers and caps lock.
            auto key = static_cast<QKeyEvent*>(event)->key();
            if (key < Qt::Key_Shift || key > Qt::Key_ScrollLock)
                hide_now();
            break;
        }
        case QEvent::Leave:
            hide_soon();
            break;
        case QEvent::WindowActivate:
        case QEvent::WindowDeactivate:
        case QEvent::FocusIn:
        case QEvent::FocusOut:
        case QEvent::MouseButtonPress:
        case QEvent::MouseButtonRelease:
        case QEvent::MouseButtonDblClick:
        case QEvent::Wheel:
            hide_now();
            break;
        case QEvent::MouseMove:
            if (object == m_widget && !m_rect.isNull() && !m_rect.contains(static_cast<QMouseEvent*>(event)->position().toPoint()))
                hide_soon();
            break;
        default:
            break;
        }
    }

private:
    int perform_layout(QString const& text, int text_width)
    {
        QTextOption option;
        option.setWrapMode(QTextOption::WrapAtWordBoundaryOrAnywhere);

        m_layout.setFont(font());
        m_layout.setText(text);
        m_layout.setTextOption(option);
        m_layout.setCacheEnabled(true);

        qreal height = 0;
        qreal natural_width = 0;
        m_layout.beginLayout();
        while (m_layout.lineCount() < MAXIMUM_LINE_COUNT) {
            auto line = m_layout.createLine();
            if (!line.isValid())
                break;
            line.setLineWidth(text_width);
            line.setPosition({ 0, height });
            height += line.height();
            natural_width = max(natural_width, line.naturalTextWidth());
        }
        m_layout.endLayout();

        m_text_size = { qCeil(natural_width), qCeil(height) };
        auto last_line = m_layout.lineAt(m_layout.lineCount() - 1);
        return last_line.textStart() + last_line.textLength();
    }

    // Text that takes more lines than a tooltip has ends with an ellipsis on the last of them. An ellipsis can be wider
    // than what it takes the place of, and would then wrap to a line that isn't there, so this cuts more until it fits.
    void lay_out_with_ellipsis(QString const& text, int laid_out_length, int last_line_start, int text_width)
    {
        static constexpr int MAXIMUM_ATTEMPTS = 6;

        auto length_to_cut = 2;
        for (auto attempt = 0; attempt < MAXIMUM_ATTEMPTS; ++attempt) {
            auto shortened_text = with_length_at_most(text, max(laid_out_length - length_to_cut, last_line_start)) + ELLIPSIS;
            if (perform_layout(shortened_text, text_width) >= shortened_text.length())
                return;
            length_to_cut *= 2;
        }

        // NB: The lines before the last stay as they are, so an ellipsis fits on the last line when it's alone there.
        perform_layout(with_length_at_most(text, last_line_start) + ELLIPSIS, text_width);
    }

    QSize lay_out_text(QString const& text, QScreen const& screen)
    {
        auto text_width = min(MAXIMUM_TEXT_WIDTH, screen.geometry().width() - 4 * HORIZONTAL_TEXT_MARGIN);
        auto laid_out_length = perform_layout(text, text_width);
        if (laid_out_length < text.length())
            lay_out_with_ellipsis(text, laid_out_length, m_layout.lineAt(m_layout.lineCount() - 1).textStart(), text_width);

        return m_text_size + QSize(2 * HORIZONTAL_TEXT_MARGIN, 2 * VERTICAL_TEXT_MARGIN);
    }

    static QPoint position_for(QPoint global_position, QSize size, QWidget const& widget, QScreen const& screen)
    {
        auto position = global_position + cursor_offset(widget, screen, size.height());

        auto screen_rect = screen.geometry();
        if (position.x() + size.width() > screen_rect.x() + screen_rect.width())
            position.rx() -= 4 + size.width();
        if (position.y() + size.height() > screen_rect.y() + screen_rect.height())
            position.setY(global_position.y() - size.height());
        position.setY(clamp(position.y(), screen_rect.y(), max(screen_rect.y(), screen_rect.y() + screen_rect.height() - size.height())));
        position.setX(clamp(position.x(), screen_rect.x(), max(screen_rect.x(), screen_rect.x() + screen_rect.width() - size.width())));
        return position;
    }

    virtual void paintEvent(QPaintEvent*) override
    {
        // NB: The palette of QToolTip doesn't follow the appearance on all platforms. On macOS it has black text on a
        //     translucent fill in dark mode, so this window looks like our other panels instead.
        auto const& panel = Theme::panel();
        QPainter painter(this);
        painter.fillRect(rect(), panel.surface);
        painter.setPen(ChromeStyle::opaque_panel_edge());
        painter.drawRect(rect().adjusted(0, 0, -1, -1));

        painter.setPen(panel.text);
        m_layout.draw(&painter, QPointF(HORIZONTAL_TEXT_MARGIN, VERTICAL_TEXT_MARGIN));
    }

    virtual void resizeEvent(QResizeEvent*) override
    {
        QStyleHintReturnMask frame_mask;
        QStyleOption option;
        option.initFrom(this);
        if (style()->styleHint(QStyle::SH_ToolTip_Mask, &option, this, &frame_mask))
            setMask(frame_mask.region);
    }

    virtual void mouseMoveEvent(QMouseEvent* event) override
    {
        if (!m_rect.isNull()) {
            auto position = event->globalPosition();
            if (m_widget)
                position = m_widget->mapFromGlobal(position);
            if (!m_rect.contains(position.toPoint()))
                hide_soon();
        }
    }

    virtual void timerEvent(QTimerEvent* event) override
    {
        if (event->timerId() == m_hide_timer.timerId() || event->timerId() == m_expire_timer.timerId()) {
            m_hide_timer.stop();
            m_expire_timer.stop();
            hide_now();
        }
    }

    QString m_source_text;
    QPointer<QWidget> m_widget;
    QRect m_rect;
    QTextLayout m_layout;
    QSize m_text_size;
    QBasicTimer m_hide_timer;
    QBasicTimer m_expire_timer;
};

static QPointer<PlainTextToolTipWindow> s_tooltip_window;

void show_tooltip(QPoint global_position, QString const& text, QWidget& widget, QRect rect, int display_time_ms)
{
    if (text.isEmpty()) {
        hide_tooltip();
        return;
    }

    // NB: A window that was closed is only waiting to be deleted, and it isn't visible, so it's never used again.
    if (s_tooltip_window && s_tooltip_window->isVisible() && s_tooltip_window->widget() == &widget) {
        if (s_tooltip_window->shows(text, widget.mapFromGlobal(global_position)))
            s_tooltip_window->cancel_hide();
        else
            s_tooltip_window->set_content(text, global_position, widget, rect, display_time_ms);
        return;
    }

    if (s_tooltip_window)
        s_tooltip_window->hide_now();

    s_tooltip_window = new PlainTextToolTipWindow(widget);
    s_tooltip_window->set_content(text, global_position, widget, rect, display_time_ms);
    s_tooltip_window->show();
}

void hide_tooltip()
{
    if (s_tooltip_window)
        s_tooltip_window->hide_soon();
}

static Optional<ToolTipContent> tooltip_at(QWidget& widget, QPoint position)
{
    if (auto* tab_bar = as_if<TabBar>(&widget)) {
        if (auto content = tab_bar->tooltip_at(position); content.has_value())
            return content;
    }

    // NB: Item views handle tooltips for their viewport, whose events go to the view by way of an event filter.
    if (auto* view = as_if<QAbstractItemView>(widget.parentWidget()); view && view->viewport() == &widget) {
        auto index = view->indexAt(position);
        if (auto text = index.data(Qt::ToolTipRole).toString(); !text.isEmpty())
            return ToolTipContent { .text = move(text), .rect = view->visualRect(index) };
    }

    // NB: A button with a default action has that action's tooltip here, or else the text of the action.
    if (auto text = widget.toolTip(); !text.isEmpty())
        return ToolTipContent { .text = move(text), .rect = {} };

    return {};
}

bool PlainTextEventFilter::eventFilter(QObject* object, QEvent* event)
{
    // NB: QLabel parses its text when it is first laid out or painted, and both polish the label first. This also
    //     covers the labels inside a QMessageBox, and the label of QToolTip, were anything to still reach it.
    if (event->type() == QEvent::Polish) {
        if (auto* label = as_if<QLabel>(object); label && label->textFormat() == Qt::AutoText)
            label->setTextFormat(Qt::PlainText);
        return false;
    }

    if (event->type() == QEvent::ToolTip) {
        auto* widget = as_if<QWidget>(object);
        if (!widget)
            return false;

        // NB: QApplication offers an ignored event to the parent of the widget, which also comes through here. So
        //     this takes every one of these events, and no widget can pass its tooltip to QToolTip.
        auto const& help_event = *static_cast<QHelpEvent*>(event);
        if (auto content = tooltip_at(*widget, help_event.pos()); content.has_value()) {
            if (!content->text.isEmpty())
                show_tooltip(help_event.globalPos(), content->text, *widget, content->rect, widget->toolTipDuration());
            event->accept();
        } else {
            event->ignore();
        }
        return true;
    }

    if (s_tooltip_window)
        s_tooltip_window->handle_application_event(object, event);
    return false;
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/kmalloc.h>

#include <QObject>
#include <QPoint>
#include <QRect>
#include <QString>

class QWidget;

namespace Ladybird {

// Tooltips and labels can hold text from web pages, and Qt treats any text that looks like rich text as rich text.
//
// So all tooltips are shown by this filter instead, as plain text in a window of ours: Widgets keep their tooltip text
// as it is, and no widget gets to see a QEvent::ToolTip. A tooltip that isn't found here is not shown.
//
// Labels become Qt::PlainText as they are polished, unless they explicitly ask for another format. A label that has its
// heightForWidth() called before it is polished has to set its format itself.
class PlainTextEventFilter final : public QObject {
    Q_OBJECT

public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    virtual bool eventFilter(QObject*, QEvent*) override;
};

struct ToolTipContent {
    QString text;
    QRect rect;
};

// If the rect isn't empty, the tooltip hides when the mouse leaves it. It is in the coordinates of the given widget.
void show_tooltip(QPoint global_position, QString const& text, QWidget& widget, QRect rect = {}, int display_time_ms = -1);
void hide_tooltip();

}

#include <AK/Math.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <UI/Qt/PlatformColors.h>

#import <AppKit/AppKit.h>

namespace Ladybird {

static Optional<Gfx::Color> color_in_appearance(NSColor* color, Web::CSS::PreferredColorScheme color_scheme)
{
    __block Optional<Gfx::Color> result;
    auto* appearance = [NSAppearance appearanceNamed:color_scheme == Web::CSS::PreferredColorScheme::Dark ? NSAppearanceNameDarkAqua : NSAppearanceNameAqua];
    [appearance performAsCurrentDrawingAppearance:^{
        auto* srgb_color = [color colorUsingColorSpace:[NSColorSpace sRGBColorSpace]];
        if (!srgb_color)
            return;
        auto channel = [](CGFloat value) { return static_cast<u8>(clamp(AK::round(value * 255), 0, 255)); };
        result = Gfx::Color(channel(srgb_color.redComponent), channel(srgb_color.greenComponent), channel(srgb_color.blueComponent),
            channel(srgb_color.alphaComponent));
    }];
    return result;
}

// NB: The system's text selection color follows the user's highlight color. LibWeb makes it translucent.
Gfx::Color macos_web_selection_color(Web::CSS::PreferredColorScheme color_scheme)
{
    return color_in_appearance([NSColor selectedTextBackgroundColor], color_scheme).value_or(Gfx::Color(128, 188, 254, 153));
}

Gfx::Color macos_web_inactive_selection_color()
{
    return Gfx::Color(183, 183, 183, 153);
}

}

namespace Ladybird {

static constexpr int POPOVER_ANCHOR_GAP = 4;
// NB: The popovers' shadow falls downward, so it needs less room above the card.
static constexpr QMargins POPOVER_SHADOW_MARGINS { 60, 36, 60, 90 };

// The window is transparent around a card that casts its own shadow. The window has no shadow of its own, which would
// not follow the card's rounded corners.
Popover::Popover(QWidget* parent)
    : QWidget(parent, Qt::Popup | Qt::FramelessWindowHint | Qt::NoDropShadowWindowHint)
{
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
    setAttribute(Qt::WA_NativeWindow);
#endif
    setAttribute(Qt::WA_TranslucentBackground);
    // NB: The window is placed by its card, and macOS can report a safe area at its top, which would take a point from
    //     the card's height.
    setAttribute(Qt::WA_ContentsMarginsRespectsSafeArea, false);

    auto* layout = new QVBoxLayout(this);
    layout->setContentsMargins(POPOVER_SHADOW_MARGINS);
    layout->setSpacing(0);

    m_card = new QFrame(this);
    m_card->setFrameShape(QFrame::StyledPanel);
    m_card->setFrameShadow(QFrame::Raised);
    layout->addWidget(m_card);
    cast_popover_shadow(*m_card);
}

// An opening popover grows to its full size from a little smaller.
static constexpr qreal OPENING_POPOVER_STARTING_SCALE = 0.97;

#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
// A picture of a popover that is opening, which grows out of the popover's anchor as it fades in. The popover itself
// is shown at once, transparent, so it takes the keyboard and the pointer as a popup does, and appears when the picture
// has grown.
class OpeningPopoverSnapshot final : public QWidget {
public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    OpeningPopoverSnapshot(QWidget& popover, QPixmap snapshot, QPointF origin, Function<void()> on_finished)
        : QWidget(nullptr, Qt::ToolTip | Qt::FramelessWindowHint | Qt::NoDropShadowWindowHint | Qt::WindowTransparentForInput)
        , m_snapshot(AK::move(snapshot))
        , m_origin(origin)
    {
        setAttribute(Qt::WA_TranslucentBackground);
        setAttribute(Qt::WA_ShowWithoutActivating);
        setAttribute(Qt::WA_TransparentForMouseEvents);
        setAttribute(Qt::WA_DeleteOnClose);
        setGeometry(popover.geometry());
        show();

        auto* animation = new QVariantAnimation(this);
        animation->setDuration(Motion::FAST);
        animation->setEasingCurve(Motion::enter_easing());
        animation->setStartValue(0.0);
        animation->setEndValue(1.0);
        QObject::connect(animation, &QVariantAnimation::valueChanged, this, [this](QVariant const& value) {
            m_progress = value.toReal();
            update();
        });
        QObject::connect(animation, &QVariantAnimation::finished, this, [this, on_finished = AK::move(on_finished)] {
            on_finished();
            close();
        });
        animation->start(QAbstractAnimation::DeleteWhenStopped);
    }

private:
    virtual void paintEvent(QPaintEvent*) override
    {
        auto scale = OPENING_POPOVER_STARTING_SCALE + ((1.0 - OPENING_POPOVER_STARTING_SCALE) * m_progress);

        QPainter painter(this);
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter::SmoothPixmapTransform);
        painter.setOpacity(m_progress);
        painter.translate(m_origin);
        painter.scale(scale, scale);
        painter.translate(-m_origin);
        painter.drawPixmap(0, 0, m_snapshot);
    }

    QPixmap m_snapshot;
    QPointF m_origin;
    qreal m_progress { 0 };
};
#endif

#if !defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
// NB: Where windows do not blend with the desktop, a popover would fade in from black and fade out to black.
static bool popovers_fade()
{
#    if defined(AK_OS_LINUX)
    return windows_blend_with_desktop();
#    else
    return true;
#    endif
}
#endif

// A popover fades in quickly as it opens, growing out of its anchor.
void Popover::showEvent(QShowEvent* event)
{
    QWidget::showEvent(event);

    Optional<QPointF> origin;
    if (!SystemAppearance::prefers_reduced_motion() && m_anchor_point.has_value())
        origin = QPointF(mapFromGlobal(*m_anchor_point));

#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
    // NB: AppKit would fade the window out as it hides, under the picture that fades out in its place.
    disable_appkit_window_animations(*this);

    if (!origin.has_value()) {
        auto* animation = new QVariantAnimation(this);
        animation->setDuration(Motion::FAST);
        animation->setEasingCurve(Motion::enter_easing());
        animation->setStartValue(0.0);
        animation->setEndValue(1.0);
        QObject::connect(animation, &QVariantAnimation::valueChanged, this, [this](QVariant const& value) {
            setWindowOpacity(value.toReal());
        });
        setWindowOpacity(0);
        animation->start(QAbstractAnimation::DeleteWhenStopped);
    } else {
        auto snapshot = grab();
        setWindowOpacity(0);
        m_opening_snapshot = new OpeningPopoverSnapshot(*this, AK::move(snapshot), *origin, [popover = QPointer { this }] {
            if (popover)
                popover->setWindowOpacity(1);
        });
    }
#else
    if (popovers_fade())
        fade_in(origin);
#endif

    if (on_visibility_change)
        on_visibility_change(true);
}

#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
// A picture of a popover that has just closed, which fades out where it was. The popover itself closes at once, so
// that it lets go of the keyboard and the pointer as a popup does.
class ClosingPopoverSnapshot final : public QWidget {
public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    ClosingPopoverSnapshot(QPixmap snapshot, QRect geometry)
        : QWidget(nullptr, Qt::ToolTip | Qt::FramelessWindowHint | Qt::NoDropShadowWindowHint | Qt::WindowTransparentForInput)
        , m_snapshot(AK::move(snapshot))
    {
        setAttribute(Qt::WA_TranslucentBackground);
        setAttribute(Qt::WA_ShowWithoutActivating);
        setAttribute(Qt::WA_TransparentForMouseEvents);
        setAttribute(Qt::WA_DeleteOnClose);
        setGeometry(geometry);
        show();

        auto* animation = new QVariantAnimation(this);
        animation->setDuration(Motion::EXIT);
        animation->setEasingCurve(Motion::exit_easing());
        animation->setStartValue(1.0);
        animation->setEndValue(0.0);
        QObject::connect(animation, &QVariantAnimation::valueChanged, this, [this](QVariant const& value) {
            m_opacity = value.toReal();
            update();
        });
        QObject::connect(animation, &QVariantAnimation::finished, this, &QWidget::close);
        animation->start(QAbstractAnimation::DeleteWhenStopped);
    }

private:
    virtual void paintEvent(QPaintEvent*) override
    {
        QPainter painter(this);
        painter.setOpacity(m_opacity);
        painter.drawPixmap(0, 0, m_snapshot);
    }

    QPixmap m_snapshot;
    qreal m_opacity { 1 };
};
#endif

#if !defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
void Popover::stop_fading()
{
    if (!m_fading_animation)
        return;
    // NB: The animation deletes itself once stopped.
    m_fading_animation->stop();
    m_fading_animation = nullptr;
    m_is_fading_out = false;
    m_fading_picture = {};
    m_fading_origin = {};
    m_card->show();
    layout()->setEnabled(true);
}

void Popover::paintEvent(QPaintEvent* event)
{
    if (!m_fading_picture.has_value()) {
        QWidget::paintEvent(event);
        return;
    }
    QPainter painter(this);
    painter.setOpacity(m_fading_progress);
    if (m_fading_origin.has_value()) {
        auto scale = OPENING_POPOVER_STARTING_SCALE + ((1.0 - OPENING_POPOVER_STARTING_SCALE) * m_fading_progress);
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter::SmoothPixmapTransform);
        painter.translate(*m_fading_origin);
        painter.scale(scale, scale);
        painter.translate(-*m_fading_origin);
    }
    painter.drawPixmap(0, 0, *m_fading_picture);
}
#endif

void Popover::setVisible(bool visible)
{
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
    // The picture a closing popover fades out with is taken while it is still shown, as it looked, with the focus that
    // it loses once hidden.
    if (!visible && isVisible() && !size().isEmpty())
        m_closing_picture = grab();
#else
    if (visible) {
        stop_fading();
    } else if (isVisible() && !m_is_finishing_close && popovers_fade()) {
        fade_out(AfterFadingOut::Hide);
        return;
    }
#endif
    QWidget::setVisible(visible);
}

#if !defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
// NB: A window of its own first appears a frame or more after it is shown on Wayland, so a picture of the popover in a
//     window of its own would leave a frame with neither. The popover fades out a picture of itself in its own window
//     instead, and hides or closes once it has faded. One the compositor closed itself, such as a popup dismissed by a
//     click outside it, is already gone.
void Popover::closeEvent(QCloseEvent* event)
{
    if (!event->spontaneous() && isVisible() && !m_is_finishing_close && popovers_fade()) {
        event->ignore();
        fade_out(AfterFadingOut::Close);
        return;
    }
    QWidget::closeEvent(event);
}

// NB: The card is hidden behind its picture, with the layout set aside so the window keeps its size.
void Popover::show_fading_picture()
{
    m_fading_picture = grab();
    layout()->setEnabled(false);
    m_card->hide();
}

// NB: As it fades out, the popover fades in a picture of itself in its own window, for the same reason.
void Popover::fade_in(Optional<QPointF> origin)
{
    stop_fading();
    show_fading_picture();
    m_fading_origin = origin;
    m_fading_progress = 0;
    m_fading_animation = new QVariantAnimation(this);
    m_fading_animation->setDuration(Motion::FAST);
    m_fading_animation->setEasingCurve(Motion::enter_easing());
    m_fading_animation->setStartValue(0.0);
    m_fading_animation->setEndValue(1.0);
    QObject::connect(m_fading_animation, &QVariantAnimation::valueChanged, this, [this](QVariant const& value) {
        m_fading_progress = value.toReal();
        update();
    });
    QObject::connect(m_fading_animation, &QVariantAnimation::finished, this, [this] {
        m_fading_animation = nullptr;
        m_fading_picture = {};
        m_fading_origin = {};
        m_card->show();
        layout()->setEnabled(true);
    });
    m_fading_animation->start(QAbstractAnimation::DeleteWhenStopped);
}

void Popover::fade_out(AfterFadingOut after_fading_out)
{
    if (m_is_fading_out)
        return;
    stop_fading();
    show_fading_picture();
    m_is_fading_out = true;
    m_fading_progress = 1;
    m_fading_animation = new QVariantAnimation(this);
    m_fading_animation->setDuration(Motion::EXIT);
    m_fading_animation->setEasingCurve(Motion::exit_easing());
    m_fading_animation->setStartValue(1.0);
    m_fading_animation->setEndValue(0.0);
    QObject::connect(m_fading_animation, &QVariantAnimation::valueChanged, this, [this](QVariant const& value) {
        m_fading_progress = value.toReal();
        update();
    });
    QObject::connect(m_fading_animation, &QVariantAnimation::finished, this, [this, after_fading_out] {
        TemporaryChange finishing_close { m_is_finishing_close, true };
        if (after_fading_out == AfterFadingOut::Close)
            close();
        else
            hide();
    });
    m_fading_animation->start(QAbstractAnimation::DeleteWhenStopped);
}
#endif

// The window reaches well past the card, to make room for its shadow. A press there is outside the popover as far as
// anyone can see, so it closes the popover like a press anywhere else outside it.
void Popover::mousePressEvent(QMouseEvent* event)
{
#if !defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
    // A popover that is fading out has closed, and takes no more presses.
    if (m_is_fading_out) {
        event->accept();
        return;
    }
#endif
    if (!m_card->geometry().contains(event->position().toPoint())) {
        close();
        event->accept();
        return;
    }
    QWidget::mousePressEvent(event);
}

// A popover fades out quickly as it closes.
void Popover::hideEvent(QHideEvent* event)
{
    QWidget::hideEvent(event);

#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
    if (m_opening_snapshot)
        m_opening_snapshot->close();
    setWindowOpacity(1);
    if (auto picture = exchange(m_closing_picture, {}); picture.has_value() && !event->spontaneous())
        new ClosingPopoverSnapshot(picture.release_value(), geometry());
#else
    stop_fading();
#endif

    if (on_visibility_change)
        on_visibility_change(false);
}

// A message that asks whether to act on it. Leaving the popover in any other way than accepting it, such as by clicking
// outside it, dismisses the message.
MessagePopover::MessagePopover(QWidget* parent, int width, QString const& title, QString const& body, QString const& dismiss_text, QString const& accept_text, QIcon const& icon)
    : Popover(parent)
{
    card().setObjectName("LadybirdMessagePopover");
    card().setFixedWidth(width);

    auto* layout = new QVBoxLayout(&card());
    layout->setContentsMargins(16, 16, 16, 16);
    layout->setSpacing(6);

    auto* title_label = new QLabel(title, &card());
    title_label->setObjectName("LadybirdMessagePopoverTitle");
    title_label->setWordWrap(true);
    if (icon.isNull()) {
        layout->addWidget(title_label);
    } else {
        auto* header = new QHBoxLayout;
        header->setSpacing(12);
        auto* icon_tile = new QLabel(&card());
        icon_tile->setObjectName("LadybirdMessagePopoverIcon");
        icon_tile->setFixedSize(32, 32);
        icon_tile->setAlignment(Qt::AlignCenter);
        icon_tile->setPixmap(icon.pixmap(QSize(18, 18), devicePixelRatioF()));
        header->addWidget(icon_tile, 0, Qt::AlignTop);
        header->addWidget(title_label, 1);
        layout->addLayout(header);
    }

    if (!body.isEmpty()) {
        auto* body_label = new QLabel(body, &card());
        body_label->setObjectName("LadybirdMessagePopoverBody");
        body_label->setWordWrap(true);
        layout->addWidget(body_label);
    }

    layout->addSpacing(8);
    auto* button_layout = new QHBoxLayout;
    button_layout->setSpacing(8);
    button_layout->addStretch();
    layout->addLayout(button_layout);

    auto* dismiss_button = new QPushButton(dismiss_text, &card());
    dismiss_button->setObjectName("LadybirdMessagePopoverDismissButton");
    // NB: The platform style lays out a push button by a frame of its own rather than by the button, which would
    //     make it overlap its neighbors.
    dismiss_button->setAttribute(Qt::WA_LayoutUsesWidgetRect);
    dismiss_button->setFocusPolicy(Qt::NoFocus);
    QObject::connect(dismiss_button, &QPushButton::clicked, this, [this] { close(); });
    button_layout->addWidget(dismiss_button);

    auto* accept_button = new QPushButton(accept_text, &card());
    accept_button->setObjectName("LadybirdMessagePopoverAcceptButton");
    accept_button->setAttribute(Qt::WA_LayoutUsesWidgetRect);
    accept_button->setDefault(true);
    QObject::connect(accept_button, &QPushButton::clicked, this, [this] {
        m_is_accepted = true;
        close();
        if (on_accept)
            on_accept();
    });
    button_layout->addWidget(accept_button);
}

void MessagePopover::update_chrome_style(QPalette const& palette)
{
    setPalette(palette);
    setStyleSheet(ChromeStyle::message_popover_style_sheet(palette));
}

void MessagePopover::hideEvent(QHideEvent* event)
{
    Popover::hideEvent(event);
    if (!exchange(m_is_accepted, false) && on_dismiss)
        on_dismiss();
}

// Places the popover's card below the anchor with their left or right edges aligned, kept on the anchor's screen, and
// above the anchor when there is no room below it. Only the shadow around the card may reach past the edge of the screen.
void move_popover_below(Popover& popover, QWidget& anchor, PopoverAlignment alignment, Optional<QRect> anchor_rect)
{
    auto rect = anchor_rect.value_or(anchor.rect());
    auto card_size = popover.size().shrunkBy(POPOVER_SHADOW_MARGINS);
    auto anchor_position = anchor.mapToGlobal(rect.bottomRight());
    auto card_x = alignment == PopoverAlignment::Leading ? anchor.mapToGlobal(rect.topLeft()).x() : anchor_position.x() - card_size.width();
    auto card_position = QPoint(card_x, anchor_position.y() + POPOVER_ANCHOR_GAP);

    if (auto* screen = QGuiApplication::screenAt(anchor_position)) {
        auto available_geometry = screen->availableGeometry();
        if (card_position.x() < available_geometry.left())
            card_position.setX(available_geometry.left());
        if (card_position.x() + card_size.width() > available_geometry.right())
            card_position.setX(available_geometry.right() - card_size.width() + 1);
        if (card_position.y() + card_size.height() > available_geometry.bottom())
            card_position.setY(anchor.mapToGlobal(rect.topRight()).y() - card_size.height() - POPOVER_ANCHOR_GAP);
        if (card_position.y() < available_geometry.top())
            card_position.setY(available_geometry.top());
    }

    popover.move(card_position - QPoint(POPOVER_SHADOW_MARGINS.left(), POPOVER_SHADOW_MARGINS.top()));

    // The popover grows out of the corner of its card nearest the anchor.
    auto anchor_x = alignment == PopoverAlignment::Leading ? card_position.x() : card_position.x() + card_size.width();
    popover.set_anchor_point(QPoint(anchor_x, card_position.y()));
}

void move_popover_above(Popover& popover, QWidget& anchor, PopoverAlignment alignment)
{
    auto rect = anchor.rect();
    auto card_size = popover.size().shrunkBy(POPOVER_SHADOW_MARGINS);
    auto anchor_top_left = anchor.mapToGlobal(rect.topLeft());
    auto card_x = alignment == PopoverAlignment::Leading ? anchor_top_left.x() : anchor.mapToGlobal(rect.topRight()).x() - card_size.width();
    auto card_position = QPoint(card_x, anchor_top_left.y() - POPOVER_ANCHOR_GAP - card_size.height());

    if (auto* screen = QGuiApplication::screenAt(anchor_top_left)) {
        auto available_geometry = screen->availableGeometry();
        if (card_position.x() + card_size.width() > available_geometry.right())
            card_position.setX(available_geometry.right() - card_size.width() + 1);
        if (card_position.x() < available_geometry.left())
            card_position.setX(available_geometry.left());
        if (card_position.y() < available_geometry.top())
            card_position.setY(available_geometry.top());
    }

    popover.move(card_position - QPoint(POPOVER_SHADOW_MARGINS.left(), POPOVER_SHADOW_MARGINS.top()));

    // The popover grows out of the corner of its card nearest the anchor.
    auto anchor_x = alignment == PopoverAlignment::Leading ? card_position.x() : card_position.x() + card_size.width();
    popover.set_anchor_point(QPoint(anchor_x, card_position.y() + card_size.height()));
}

// Cards that float over other content cast the same shadow as popovers, whether they are windows of their own or not.
void cast_popover_shadow(QWidget& card)
{
    auto* shadow = new QGraphicsDropShadowEffect(&card);
    shadow->setBlurRadius(ChromeStyle::drop_shadow_blur_radius(36));
    shadow->setOffset(0, 14);
    shadow->setColor(QColor(0, 0, 0, Theme::is_dark() ? 115 : 41));
    card.setGraphicsEffect(shadow);
}

static constexpr int SHEET_SHADOW_MARGIN = 100;

#if !defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
// The shape that casts the shadow. It lies under the surface, so only the shadow around it shows.
class FloatingShadowCaster final : public QWidget {
public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    FloatingShadowCaster(QWidget& parent, qreal corner_radius, FloatingShadowTone tone, FloatingShadowKind kind)
        : QWidget(&parent)
        , m_corner_radius(corner_radius)
        , m_tone(tone)
    {
        auto is_dark = tone == FloatingShadowTone::Dark || Theme::is_dark();
        auto* shadow = new QGraphicsDropShadowEffect(this);
        if (kind == FloatingShadowKind::Sheet) {
            shadow->setBlurRadius(ChromeStyle::drop_shadow_blur_radius(40));
            shadow->setOffset(0, 18);
            shadow->setColor(QColor(0, 0, 0, is_dark ? 140 : 56));
        } else {
            shadow->setBlurRadius(ChromeStyle::drop_shadow_blur_radius(36));
            shadow->setOffset(0, 14);
            shadow->setColor(QColor(0, 0, 0, is_dark ? 115 : 41));
        }
        setGraphicsEffect(shadow);
    }

private:
    virtual void paintEvent(QPaintEvent*) override
    {
        QPainter painter(this);
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter::Antialiasing);
        painter.setPen(Qt::NoPen);
        painter.setBrush(m_tone == FloatingShadowTone::Dark ? QColor(28, 28, 30) : Theme::panel().surface);
        painter.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(rect()), m_corner_radius, m_corner_radius);
    }

    qreal m_corner_radius { 0 };
    FloatingShadowTone m_tone { FloatingShadowTone::FollowTheme };
};
#endif

class FloatingShadow final : public QWidget {
public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    // NB: On macOS, the shadow is a plain view right below the surface's native view, so it stacks above the page's
    //     native view, while letting the mouse through to it, and this widget stays hidden. Elsewhere the page and the
    //     surface are drawn in the window itself, so the shadow is a widget beside the surface.
    FloatingShadow(QWidget& surface, qreal corner_radius, FloatingShadowTone tone, FloatingShadowKind kind)
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
        : QWidget(surface.window())
#else
        : QWidget(surface.parentWidget())
#endif
        , m_surface(&surface)
        , m_margins(kind == FloatingShadowKind::Sheet
                  ? QMargins(SHEET_SHADOW_MARGIN, 0, SHEET_SHADOW_MARGIN, SHEET_SHADOW_MARGIN)
                  : POPOVER_SHADOW_MARGINS)
        , m_corner_radius(corner_radius)
        , m_kind(kind)
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
        , m_tone(tone)
#endif
    {
#if !defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
        setAttribute(Qt::WA_TranslucentBackground);
        setAttribute(Qt::WA_ShowWithoutActivating);
        setAttribute(Qt::WA_TransparentForMouseEvents);
        auto* layout = new QVBoxLayout(this);
        layout->setContentsMargins(m_margins);
        layout->addWidget(new FloatingShadowCaster(*this, corner_radius, tone, kind));
#endif

        watch_surface_and_its_ancestors();
        connect(&surface, &QObject::destroyed, this, &QObject::deleteLater);
        hide();
        follow_surface();
    }

#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
    void set_opacity(qreal opacity) { m_view_shadow.set_opacity(opacity); }
#endif

private:
    // The focus ring's line right outside the surface's edge is inside a softer ring this wide.
    static constexpr qreal FOCUS_RING_WIDTH = 2;

#if !defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
    virtual void paintEvent(QPaintEvent*) override
    {
        if (m_kind != FloatingShadowKind::FocusedField)
            return;
        QPainter painter(this);
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter::Antialiasing);
        painter.setBrush(Qt::NoBrush);
        auto surface_rect = QRectF(rect().marginsRemoved(m_margins));
        auto ring_outset = 1 + (FOCUS_RING_WIDTH / 2);
        painter.setPen(QPen(Theme::focus_ring(), FOCUS_RING_WIDTH));
        painter.drawRoundedRect(surface_rect.adjusted(-ring_outset, -ring_outset, ring_outset, ring_outset), m_corner_radius + ring_outset, m_corner_radius + ring_outset);
        painter.setPen(QPen(Theme::focus_edge(), 1));
        painter.drawRoundedRect(surface_rect.adjusted(-0.5, -0.5, 0.5, 0.5), m_corner_radius + 0.5, m_corner_radius + 0.5);
    }
#endif

    virtual bool eventFilter(QObject*, QEvent* event) override
    {
        switch (event->type()) {
        case QEvent::Move:
        case QEvent::Resize:
        case QEvent::Show:
        case QEvent::Hide:
        case QEvent::ZOrderChange:
        case QEvent::PaletteChange:
            follow_surface();
            break;
        case QEvent::ParentChange:
            // NB: The surface can move to another window with its tab, so the shadow watches the widgets it now lies in.
            watch_surface_and_its_ancestors();
            follow_surface();
            break;
        default:
            break;
        }
        return false;
    }

    // The surface moves in the window when it or any widget it lies in moves.
    void watch_surface_and_its_ancestors()
    {
        if (!m_surface)
            return;
        for (QWidget* widget = m_surface; widget; widget = widget->isWindow() ? nullptr : widget->parentWidget())
            widget->installEventFilter(this);
    }

    void follow_surface()
    {
        // NB: The shadow is deleted only after its surface, and may still hear from the surface's window until then.
        if (m_is_following || !m_surface)
            return;
        TemporaryChange following { m_is_following, true };

        if (!m_surface->isVisible()) {
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
            m_view_shadow.hide();
#else
            hide();
#endif
            return;
        }

#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
        // NB: The shadow belongs to the surface's window, so it is not deleted with a window the surface has left.
        if (parentWidget() != m_surface->window())
            setParent(m_surface->window(), windowFlags());

        // NB: Core Animation's blur radius is a little over 40% of the CSS one of the design.
        auto is_dark = m_tone == FloatingShadowTone::Dark || Theme::is_dark();
        auto fill_color = m_tone == FloatingShadowTone::Dark ? QColor(28, 28, 30) : Theme::panel().surface;
        if (m_kind == FloatingShadowKind::Sheet)
            m_view_shadow.follow(*m_surface, m_margins, m_corner_radius, 17, 18, QColor(0, 0, 0, is_dark ? 140 : 56), fill_color);
        else if (m_kind == FloatingShadowKind::FocusedField)
            m_view_shadow.follow(*m_surface, m_margins, m_corner_radius, 15, 14, QColor(0, 0, 0, is_dark ? 115 : 41), fill_color, AppKitViewFocusRing { Theme::focus_edge(), Theme::focus_ring(), FOCUS_RING_WIDTH });
        else
            m_view_shadow.follow(*m_surface, m_margins, m_corner_radius, 15, 14, QColor(0, 0, 0, is_dark ? 115 : 41), fill_color);
#else
        if (parentWidget() != m_surface->parentWidget())
            setParent(m_surface->parentWidget());
        setGeometry(m_surface->geometry().marginsAdded(m_margins));
        show();
        stackUnder(m_surface);
#endif
    }

    QPointer<QWidget> m_surface;
    QMargins m_margins;
    bool m_is_following { false };
    qreal m_corner_radius { 0 };
    FloatingShadowKind m_kind { FloatingShadowKind::Popover };
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
    FloatingShadowTone m_tone { FloatingShadowTone::FollowTheme };
    AppKitViewShadow m_view_shadow;
#endif
};

QWidget& cast_floating_shadow(QWidget& surface, qreal corner_radius, FloatingShadowTone tone, FloatingShadowKind kind)
{
    return *new FloatingShadow(surface, corner_radius, tone, kind);
}

void set_floating_window_opacity(QWidget& window, qreal opacity)
{
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
    if (auto* shadow = as_if<FloatingShadow>(window))
        shadow->set_opacity(opacity);
    else
        set_appkit_view_opacity(window, opacity);
#else
    // NB: Wayland has no window opacity, and a widget in a window has none either, so those fade by an effect instead.
    static auto const has_window_opacity = !QGuiApplication::platformName().startsWith(QStringLiteral("wayland"));
    if (window.isWindow() && has_window_opacity) {
        // NB: A compositing manager blends top-level windows only, and may apply the opacity of a window embedded in
        //     one to the whole top-level window. An embedded window can't fade by an effect either, as it would fade
        //     from black, so it stays opaque.
        if (auto* handle = window.windowHandle(); !handle || !handle->parent())
            window.setWindowOpacity(opacity);
        return;
    }
    auto* effect = qobject_cast<QGraphicsOpacityEffect*>(window.graphicsEffect());
    if (opacity >= 1.0) {
        if (effect)
            window.setGraphicsEffect(nullptr);
        return;
    }
    if (!effect) {
        // NB: A widget has only one effect, and one it casts its shadow with is left alone.
        if (window.graphicsEffect())
            return;
        effect = new QGraphicsOpacityEffect(&window);
        window.setGraphicsEffect(effect);
    }
    effect->setOpacity(opacity);
#endif
}

PopoverSwitch::PopoverSwitch(QWidget* parent)
    : QCheckBox(parent)
{
    setAttribute(Qt::WA_MacShowFocusRect, false);
    setAttribute(Qt::WA_LayoutUsesWidgetRect);
    setFocusPolicy(Qt::StrongFocus);
    setFixedSize(sizeHint());
}

static constexpr int CHECK_BOX_SIZE = 16;
static constexpr int CHECK_BOX_TEXT_GAP = 8;

PopoverCheckBox::PopoverCheckBox(QString const& text, QWidget* parent)
    : QCheckBox(text, parent)
{
    setAttribute(Qt::WA_MacShowFocusRect, false);
}

// Focus that came from a click isn't ringed.
static bool is_keyboard_focus_reason(Qt::FocusReason reason)
{
    return reason == Qt::TabFocusReason || reason == Qt::BacktabFocusReason || reason == Qt::ShortcutFocusReason;
}

void PopoverSwitch::focusInEvent(QFocusEvent* event)
{
    m_has_keyboard_focus = is_keyboard_focus_reason(event->reason());
    QCheckBox::focusInEvent(event);
}

void PopoverCheckBox::focusInEvent(QFocusEvent* event)
{
    m_has_keyboard_focus = is_keyboard_focus_reason(event->reason());
    QCheckBox::focusInEvent(event);
}

QSize PopoverCheckBox::sizeHint() const
{
    auto metrics = fontMetrics();
    return { CHECK_BOX_SIZE + CHECK_BOX_TEXT_GAP + metrics.horizontalAdvance(text()), max(CHECK_BOX_SIZE, metrics.height()) };
}

void PopoverCheckBox::paintEvent(QPaintEvent*)
{
    QPainter painter(this);
    painter.setRenderHint(QPainter::Antialiasing);
    QRectF box { 0, (height() - CHECK_BOX_SIZE) / 2.0, CHECK_BOX_SIZE, CHECK_BOX_SIZE };
    auto const& panel = Theme::panel();
    if (isChecked()) {
        painter.setPen(Qt::NoPen);
        painter.setBrush(Theme::accent());
        painter.drawRoundedRect(box, 4, 4);
        // The check is drawn on a 16 px grid, scaled into the middle of the box.
        painter.save();
        painter.translate(box.center());
        painter.scale(11.0 / 16, 11.0 / 16);
        painter.translate(-8, -8);
        painter.setPen(QPen(Qt::white, 2.4, Qt::SolidLine, Qt::RoundCap, Qt::RoundJoin));
        QPointF check[] { { 3.5, 8.5 }, { 6.5, 11.5 }, { 12.5, 4.5 } };
        painter.drawPolyline(check, 3);
        painter.restore();
    } else {
        painter.setPen(QPen(panel.shortcut, 1.5));
        painter.setBrush(panel.page);
        painter.drawRoundedRect(box.adjusted(0.75, 0.75, -0.75, -0.75), 3.25, 3.25);
    }
    if (hasFocus() && m_has_keyboard_focus)
        ChromeStyle::paint_focus_ring(painter, box, 4);

    painter.setPen(palette().color(foregroundRole()));
    painter.drawText(QRectF(CHECK_BOX_SIZE + CHECK_BOX_TEXT_GAP, 0, width() - CHECK_BOX_SIZE - CHECK_BOX_TEXT_GAP, height()), Qt::AlignLeft | Qt::AlignVCenter, text());
}

void PopoverSwitch::paintEvent(QPaintEvent*)
{
    QPainter painter(this);
    painter.setRenderHint(QPainter::Antialiasing);
    QRectF track { (width() - 32) / 2.0, (height() - 18) / 2.0, 32, 18 };
    auto track_color = isChecked() ? Theme::accent() : (Theme::is_dark() ? QColor(0x48484e) : QColor(0xbcbcc2));
    // A switch that can't be turned fades, knob and all, so it doesn't look as though it could.
    if (!isEnabled())
        painter.setOpacity(0.4);

    painter.setPen(Qt::NoPen);
    painter.setBrush(track_color);
    painter.drawRoundedRect(track, 9, 9);

    auto knob_x = isChecked() != (layoutDirection() == Qt::RightToLeft) ? track.right() - 16 : track.left() + 2;
    painter.setBrush(QColor(0, 0, 0, 40));
    painter.drawEllipse(QRectF(knob_x, track.top() + 3, 14, 14));
    painter.setBrush(Qt::white);
    painter.drawEllipse(QRectF(knob_x, track.top() + 2, 14, 14));

    if (hasFocus() && m_has_keyboard_focus) {
        painter.setOpacity(1);
        ChromeStyle::paint_focus_ring(painter, track, 9);
    }
}

QString task_manager_site_label(URL::URL const& url)
{
    if (url == URL::about_blank())
        return {};
    if (url.host().has_value()) {
        // NB: Pages and request servers are isolated by site, so a site's hosts, such as www.example.com and
        //     example.com, are listed together under its registrable domain.
        if (auto registrable_domain = url.host()->registrable_domain(); registrable_domain.has_value())
            return qstring_from_ak_string(*registrable_domain);
        auto host = qstring_from_ak_string(url.serialized_host());
        if (!host.isEmpty())
            return host;
    }
    if (url.scheme() == "file"sv && !url.basename().is_empty())
        return qstring_from_ak_string(url.basename());
    return qstring_from_ak_string(url.scheme()) + ":";
}
