  <interface name="wp_viewporter" version="1">
    <description summary="surface cropping and scaling">
      The global interface exposing surface cropping and scaling
      capabilities is used to instantiate an interface extension for a
      wl_surface object. This extended interface will then allow
      cropping and scaling the surface contents, effectively
      disconnecting the direct relationship between the buffer and the
      surface size.
    </description>

    <request name="destroy" type="destructor">
      <description summary="unbind from the cropping and scaling interface">
	Informs the server that the client will not be using this
	protocol object anymore. This does not affect any other objects,
	wp_viewport objects included.
      </description>
    </request>

    <enum name="error">
      <entry name="viewport_exists" value="0"
             summary="the surface already has a viewport object associated"/>
    </enum>

    <request name="get_viewport">
      <description summary="extend surface interface for crop and scale">
	Instantiate an interface extension for the given wl_surface to
	crop and scale its content. If the given wl_surface already has
	a wp_viewport object associated, the viewport_exists
	protocol error is raised.
      </description>
      <arg name="id" type="new_id" interface="wp_viewport"
           summary="the new viewport interface id"/>
      <arg name="surface" type="object" interface="wl_surface"
           summary="the surface"/>
    </request>
  </interface>

  <interface name="wp_viewport" version="1">
    <description summary="crop and scale interface to a wl_surface">
      An additional interface to a wl_surface object, which allows the
      client to specify the cropping and scaling of the surface
      contents.

      This interface works with two concepts: the source rectangle (src_x,
      src_y, src_width, src_height), and the destination size (dst_width,
      dst_height). The contents of the source rectangle are scaled to the
      destination size, and content outside the source rectangle is ignored.
      This state is double-buffered, see wl_surface.commit.

      The two parts of crop and scale state are independent: the source
      rectangle, and the destination size. Initially both are unset, that
      is, no scaling is applied. The whole of the current wl_buffer is
      used as the source, and the surface size is as defined in
      wl_surface.attach.

      If the destination size is set, it causes the surface size to become
      dst_width, dst_height. The source (rectangle) is scaled to exactly
      this size. This overrides whatever the attached wl_buffer size is,
      unless the wl_buffer is NULL. If the wl_buffer is NULL, the surface
      has no content and therefore no size. Otherwise, the size is always
      at least 1x1 in surface local coordinates.

      If the source rectangle is set, it defines what area of the wl_buffer is
      taken as the source. If the source rectangle is set and the destination
      size is not set, then src_width and src_height must be integers, and the
      surface size becomes the source rectangle size. This results in cropping
      without scaling. If src_width or src_height are not integers and
      destination size is not set, the bad_size protocol error is raised when
      the surface state is applied.

      The coordinate transformations from buffer pixel coordinates up to
      the surface-local coordinates happen in the following order:
        1. buffer_transform (wl_surface.set_buffer_transform)
        2. buffer_scale (wl_surface.set_buffer_scale)
        3. crop and scale (wp_viewport.set*)
      This means, that the source rectangle coordinates of crop and scale
      are given in the coordinates after the buffer transform and scale,
      i.e. in the coordinates that would be the surface-local coordinates
      if the crop and scale was not applied.

      If src_x or src_y are negative, the bad_value protocol error is raised.
      Otherwise, if the source rectangle is partially or completely outside of
      the non-NULL wl_buffer, then the out_of_buffer protocol error is raised
      when the surface state is applied. A NULL wl_buffer does not raise the
      out_of_buffer error.

      If the wl_surface associated with the wp_viewport is destroyed,
      all wp_viewport requests except 'destroy' raise the protocol error
      no_surface.

      If the wp_viewport object is destroyed, the crop and scale
      state is removed from the wl_surface. The change will be applied
      on the next wl_surface.commit.
    </description>

    <request name="destroy" type="destructor">
      <description summary="remove scaling and cropping from the surface">
	The associated wl_surface's crop and scale state is removed.
	The change is applied on the next wl_surface.commit.
      </description>
    </request>

    <enum name="error">
      <entry name="bad_value" value="0"
	     summary="negative or zero values in width or height"/>
      <entry name="bad_size" value="1"
	     summary="destination size is not integer"/>
      <entry name="out_of_buffer" value="2"
	     summary="source rectangle extends outside of the content area"/>
      <entry name="no_surface" value="3"
	     summary="the wl_surface was destroyed"/>
    </enum>

    <request name="set_source">
      <description summary="set the source rectangle for cropping">
	Set the source rectangle of the associated wl_surface. See
	wp_viewport for the description, and relation to the wl_buffer
	size.

	If all of x, y, width and height are -1.0, the source rectangle is
	unset instead. Any other set of values where width or height are zero
	or negative, or x or y are negative, raise the bad_value protocol
	error.

	The crop and scale state is double-buffered, see wl_surface.commit.
      </description>
      <arg name="x" type="fixed" summary="source rectangle x"/>
      <arg name="y" type="fixed" summary="source rectangle y"/>
      <arg name="width" type="fixed" summary="source rectangle width"/>
      <arg name="height" type="fixed" summary="source rectangle height"/>
    </request>

    <request name="set_destination">
      <description summary="set the surface size for scaling">
	Set the destination size of the associated wl_surface. See
	wp_viewport for the description, and relation to the wl_buffer
	size.

	If width is -1 and height is -1, the destination size is unset
	instead. Any other pair of values for width and height that
	contains zero or negative values raises the bad_value protocol
	error.

	The crop and scale state is double-buffered, see wl_surface.commit.
      </description>
      <arg name="width" type="int" summary="surface width"/>
      <arg name="height" type="int" summary="surface height"/>
    </request>
  </interface>

</protocol>

  <description summary="Protocol for requesting activation of surfaces">
    The way for a client to pass focus to another toplevel is as follows.

    The client that intends to activate another toplevel uses the
    xdg_activation_v1.get_activation_token request to get an activation token.
    This token is then forwarded to the client, which is supposed to activate
    one of its surfaces, through a separate band of communication.

    One established way of doing this is through the XDG_ACTIVATION_TOKEN
    environment variable of a newly launched child process. The child process
    should unset the environment variable again right after reading it out in
    order to avoid propagating it to other child processes.

    Another established way exists for Applications implementing the D-Bus
    interface org.freedesktop.Application, which should get their token under
    activation-token on their platform_data.

    In general activation tokens may be transferred across clients through
    means not described in this protocol.

    The client to be activated will then pass the token
    it received to the xdg_activation_v1.activate request. The compositor can
    then use this token to decide how to react to the activation request.

    The token the activating client gets may be ineffective either already at
    the time it receives it, for example if it was not focused, for focus
    stealing prevention. The activating client will have no way to discover
    the validity of the token, and may still forward it to the to be activated
    client.

    The created activation token may optionally get information attached to it
    that can be used by the compositor to identify the application that we
    intend to activate. This can for example be used to display a visual hint
    about what application is being started.

    Warning! The protocol described in this file is currently in the testing
    phase. Backward compatible changes may be added together with the
    corresponding interface version bump. Backward incompatible changes can
    only be done by creating a new major version of the extension.
  </description>

  <interface name="xdg_activation_v1" version="1">
    <description summary="interface for activating surfaces">
      A global interface used for informing the compositor about applications
      being activated or started, or for applications to request to be
      activated.
    </description>

    <request name="destroy" type="destructor">
      <description summary="destroy the xdg_activation object">
        Notify the compositor that the xdg_activation object will no longer be
        used.

        The child objects created via this interface are unaffected and should
        be destroyed separately.
      </description>
    </request>

    <request name="get_activation_token">
      <description summary="requests a token">
        Creates an xdg_activation_token_v1 object that will provide
        the initiating client with a unique token for this activation. This
        token should be offered to the clients to be activated.
      </description>

      <arg name="id" type="new_id" interface="xdg_activation_token_v1"/>
    </request>

    <request name="activate">
      <description summary="notify new interaction being available">
        Requests surface activation. It's up to the compositor to display
        this information as desired, for example by placing the surface above
        the rest.

        The compositor may know who requested this by checking the activation
        token and might decide not to follow through with the activation if it's
        considered unwanted.

        Compositors can ignore unknown activation tokens when an invalid
        token is passed.
      </description>
      <arg name="token" type="string" summary="the activation token of the initiating client"/>
      <arg name="surface" type="object" interface="wl_surface"
	   summary="the wl_surface to activate"/>
    </request>
  </interface>

  <interface name="xdg_activation_token_v1" version="1">
    <description summary="an exported activation handle">
      An object for setting up a token and receiving a token handle that can
      be passed as an activation token to another client.

      The object is created using the xdg_activation_v1.get_activation_token
      request. This object should then be populated with the app_id, surface
      and serial information and committed. The compositor shall then issue a
      done event with the token. In case the request's parameters are invalid,
      the compositor will provide an invalid token.
    </description>

    <enum name="error">
      <entry name="already_used" value="0"
             summary="The token has already been used previously"/>
    </enum>

    <request name="set_serial">
      <description summary="specifies the seat and serial of the activating event">
        Provides information about the seat and serial event that requested the
        token.

        The serial can come from an input or focus event. For instance, if a
        click triggers the launch of a third-party client, the launcher client
        should send a set_serial request with the serial and seat from the
        wl_pointer.button event.

        Some compositors might refuse to activate toplevels when the token
        doesn't have a valid and recent enough event serial.

        Must be sent before commit. This information is optional.
      </description>
      <arg name="serial" type="uint"
           summary="the serial of the event that triggered the activation"/>
      <arg name="seat" type="object" interface="wl_seat"
           summary="the wl_seat of the event"/>
    </request>

    <request name="set_app_id">
      <description summary="specifies the application being activated">
        The requesting client can specify an app_id to associate the token
        being created with it.

        Must be sent before commit. This information is optional.
      </description>
      <arg name="app_id" type="string"
           summary="the application id of the client being activated."/>
    </request>

    <request name="set_surface">
      <description summary="specifies the surface requesting activation">
        This request sets the surface requesting the activation. Note, this is
        different from the surface that will be activated.

        Some compositors might refuse to activate toplevels when the token
        doesn't have a requesting surface.

        Must be sent before commit. This information is optional.
      </description>
      <arg name="surface" type="object" interface="wl_surface"
	   summary="the requesting surface"/>
    </request>

    <request name="commit">
      <description summary="issues the token request">
        Requests an activation token based on the different parameters that
        have been offered through set_serial, set_surface and set_app_id.
      </description>
    </request>

    <event name="done">
      <description summary="the exported activation token">
        The 'done' event contains the unique token of this activation request
        and notifies that the provider is done.
      </description>
      <arg name="token" type="string" summary="the exported activation token"/>
    </event>

    <request name="destroy" type="destructor">
      <description summary="destroy the xdg_activation_token_v1 object">
        Notify the compositor that the xdg_activation_token_v1 object will no
        longer be used. The received token stays valid.
      </description>
    </request>
  </interface>

/*

#include <UI/Qt/Application.h>
#include <UI/Qt/HubConnection.h>
#include <UI/Qt/RemoteDownloads.h>

namespace Ladybird {

RemoteDownloads& RemoteDownloads::the()
{
    static RemoteDownloads s_the;
    return s_the;
}

static RemoteDownloads::Download download_from(Hub::DownloadState const& state)
{
    return {
        .id = state.id,
        .is_private = state.is_private,
        .url = state.url,
        .destination = LexicalPath { state.destination },
        .status = state.status,
        .downloaded_size = state.downloaded_size,
        .total_size = state.total_size,
        .error = state.error,
        .can_resume = state.can_resume,
        .connection_count = state.connection_count,
        .bytes_per_second = state.bytes_per_second,
        .is_waiting_to_retry = state.is_waiting_to_retry,
        .created_time = state.created_time,
    };
}

void RemoteDownloads::set_downloads(ReadonlySpan<Hub::DownloadState> downloads)
{
    m_downloads.clear();
    m_segments.clear();
    for (auto const& download : downloads) {
        m_downloads.append(download_from(download));
        m_segments.set(download.id, download.segments);
    }
}

void RemoteDownloads::did_add(Hub::DownloadState const& state)
{
    m_downloads.append(download_from(state));
    m_segments.set(state.id, state.segments);
    for (auto& observer : m_observers)
        observer.download_added(m_downloads.last());
}

void RemoteDownloads::did_update(Hub::DownloadState const& state)
{
    for (auto& download : m_downloads) {
        if (download.id != state.id)
            continue;
        download = download_from(state);
        m_segments.set(state.id, state.segments);
        for (auto& observer : m_observers)
            observer.download_updated(download);
        return;
    }
}

void RemoteDownloads::did_remove(u64 id, WebView::IsPrivate is_private)
{
    m_downloads.remove_first_matching([&](auto const& download) { return download.id == id; });
    m_segments.remove(id);
    for (auto& observer : m_observers)
        observer.download_removed(id, is_private);
}

Vector<RemoteDownloads::Download> RemoteDownloads::downloads_of_session(WebView::IsPrivate is_private) const
{
    Vector<Download> downloads;
    for (auto const& download : m_downloads) {
        if (download.is_private == is_private)
            downloads.append(download);
    }
    return downloads;
}

Optional<RemoteDownloads::Download const&> RemoteDownloads::download(u64 id) const
{
    for (auto const& download : m_downloads) {
        if (download.id == id)
            return download;
    }
    return {};
}

bool RemoteDownloads::has_active_downloads() const
{
    return any_of(m_downloads, [](auto const& download) { return WebView::FileDownloader::status_is_active(download.status); });
}

bool RemoteDownloads::has_unresumable_downloads() const
{
    return any_of(m_downloads, [](auto const& download) { return WebView::FileDownloader::status_is_active(download.status) && !download.can_resume; });
}

void RemoteDownloads::cancel_download(u64 id)
{
    HubConnection::the().async_cancel_download(id);
}

void RemoteDownloads::pause_download(u64 id)
{
    HubConnection::the().async_pause_download(id);
}

void RemoteDownloads::resume_download(u64 id)
{
    HubConnection::the().async_resume_download(id);
}

void RemoteDownloads::open_path(ByteString const& path, StringView error_message)
{
    if (auto path_string = String::from_byte_string(path); !path_string.is_error())
        Application::the().open_file(path_string.value());
    else
        Application::the().display_error_dialog(error_message);
}

// NB: The UI opens a download itself, as only it sees the user ask for that. The Hub cannot have the UI open any file.
void RemoteDownloads::open(u64 id)
{
    auto download = this->download(id);
    if (!download.has_value() || download->status != WebView::FileDownloader::DownloadStatus::Completed)
        return;
    open_path(download->destination.string(), "Unable to open downloaded file: path cannot be represented by this frontend"sv);
}

void RemoteDownloads::show_in_folder(u64 id)
{
    auto download = this->download(id);
    if (!download.has_value() || download->status != WebView::FileDownloader::DownloadStatus::Completed)
        return;
    open_path(download->destination.dirname(), "Unable to show downloaded file: path cannot be represented by this frontend"sv);
}

void RemoteDownloads::prune_inactive_downloads(WebView::IsPrivate is_private)
{
    HubConnection::the().async_prune_inactive_downloads(is_private);
}

void RemoteDownloads::pause_active_downloads()
{
    HubConnection::the().async_pause_active_downloads();
}

void RemoteDownloads::cancel_unresumable_downloads()
{
    HubConnection::the().async_cancel_unresumable_downloads();
}

RemoteDownloadsObserver::RemoteDownloadsObserver()
{
    RemoteDownloads::the().m_observers.append(*this);
}

RemoteDownloadsObserver::~RemoteDownloadsObserver()
{
    RemoteDownloads::the().m_observers.remove_first_matching([&](auto& observer) { return &observer == this; });
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <Hub/HubClientEndpoint.h>
#include <LibWebView/FileDownloader.h>

namespace Ladybird {

class RemoteDownloadsObserver;

// The Hub's downloads, as the UI shows them.
class RemoteDownloads {
public:
    using Download = WebView::FileDownloader::Download;

    static RemoteDownloads& the();

    void set_downloads(ReadonlySpan<Hub::DownloadState>);
    void did_add(Hub::DownloadState const&);
    void did_update(Hub::DownloadState const&);
    void did_remove(u64 id, WebView::IsPrivate);

    Vector<Download> downloads_of_session(WebView::IsPrivate) const;
    Optional<Download const&> download(u64 id) const;
    Vector<WebView::FileDownloader::SegmentProgress> segment_progress(u64 id) const { return m_segments.get(id).value_or({}); }
    bool has_active_downloads() const;
    bool has_unresumable_downloads() const;

    void cancel_download(u64 id);
    void pause_download(u64 id);
    void resume_download(u64 id);
    void open(u64 id);
    void show_in_folder(u64 id);
    void prune_inactive_downloads(WebView::IsPrivate);
    void pause_active_downloads();
    void cancel_unresumable_downloads();

private:
    friend class RemoteDownloadsObserver;

    static void open_path(ByteString const& path, StringView error_message);

    Vector<Download> m_downloads;
    HashMap<u64, Vector<WebView::FileDownloader::SegmentProgress>> m_segments;
    Vector<RemoteDownloadsObserver&> m_observers;
};

class RemoteDownloadsObserver {
public:
    RemoteDownloadsObserver();
    virtual ~RemoteDownloadsObserver();

    virtual void download_added(RemoteDownloads::Download const&) { }
    virtual void download_updated(RemoteDownloads::Download const&) { }
    virtual void download_removed(u64, WebView::IsPrivate) { }
};

}

static HashMap<u64, RemoteView*> s_views;

RemoteView::RemoteView(Optional<u64> view_id, Hub::View::InitialState initial_state)
    : BookmarkStoreObserver(Application::bookmark_store())
    , m_is_private(initial_state.is_private)
    , m_device_pixel_ratio(initial_state.device_pixel_ratio)
    , m_display_id(initial_state.display_id)
{
#ifdef LADYBIRD_HUB_IN_OWN_PROCESS
    if (view_id.has_value()) {
        m_view_id = *view_id;
        m_state = HubConnection::the().view_description(*view_id);
    } else {
        auto view = HubConnection::the().create_view({
            .is_private = initial_state.is_private,
            .device_pixel_ratio = initial_state.device_pixel_ratio,
            .maximum_frames_per_second = initial_state.maximum_frames_per_second,
            .display_id = initial_state.display_id,
            .screen_shows_high_dynamic_range = initial_state.screen_shows_high_dynamic_range,
            .system_theme = move(initial_state.system_theme),
            .screen_rects = move(initial_state.screen_rects),
            .owner_view_id = initial_state.owner_view_id,
            .websites_prefer_dark = initial_state.websites_prefer_dark,
            .is_tab = initial_state.is_tab,
        });
        m_view_id = view.view_id();
        m_state = view.take_state();
    }
#else
    if (view_id.has_value()) {
        auto view = WebView::ViewImplementation::find_view_by_id(*view_id);
        VERIFY(view.has_value());
        m_view = static_cast<Hub::View*>(&view.value());
    } else {
        m_view = &Hub::Application::the().create_view(move(initial_state));
    }
    m_view_id = m_view->view_id();
    m_state = m_view->current_state();
#endif

    m_navigate_back_action = Action::create("Back"sv, ActionID::NavigateBack, [this] {
        traverse_the_history_by_delta(-1);
    });
    m_navigate_forward_action = Action::create("Forward"sv, ActionID::NavigateForward, [this] {
        traverse_the_history_by_delta(+1);
    });
    m_toggle_bookmark_action = Action::create("Toggle Bookmark"sv, ActionID::ToggleBookmarkViaToolbar, [] {
        Application::the().show_bookmark_popover();
    });
    m_reset_zoom_action = Action::create("100%"sv, ActionID::ResetZoomViaToolbar, [this] {
        reset_zoom();
    });
    m_reset_zoom_action->set_tooltip("Reset zoom level"sv);
    m_copy_link_to_highlight_action = Action::create("Copy Link to Highlight"sv, ActionID::CopyLinkToHighlight, [this] {
        if (m_link_to_highlight.has_value())
            Application::the().set_clipboard_text(MUST(String::from_byte_string(WebView::url_text_to_copy(*m_link_to_highlight))));
    });
    create_translation_actions();

    update_view_actions();
    update_bookmark_action();

    s_views.set(m_view_id, this);
}

RemoteView::~RemoteView()
{
    s_views.remove(m_view_id);
    if (auto* hub = HubConnection::the_if_connected())
        hub->async_destroy_view(m_view_id);

    // NB: The Hub answers nothing for a view that is gone, so whoever still waits on this one is answered here, once
    //     this view is fully gone. A gone view stands in the way of no close.
    if (m_pending_close_preflights.is_empty() && m_pending_selected_text.is_empty() && m_pending_page_dumps.is_empty())
        return;
    Core::deferred_invoke([close_preflights = move(m_pending_close_preflights), selected_text = move(m_pending_selected_text), page_dumps = move(m_pending_page_dumps)]() mutable {
        for (auto& it : close_preflights)
            it.value(true);
        for (auto& it : selected_text)
            it.value->reject(Error::from_errno(ECANCELED));
        for (auto& it : page_dumps)
            it.value->reject(Error::from_errno(ECANCELED));
    });
}

void RemoteView::update_bookmark_action()
{
    auto is_bookmarked = Application::bookmark_store().is_bookmarked(url());
    m_toggle_bookmark_action->set_tooltip(is_bookmarked ? "Remove bookmark"sv : "Bookmark this page"sv);
    m_toggle_bookmark_action->set_engaged(is_bookmarked);
    Application::bookmarks().update_toggle_bookmark_action();
}

    if (auto rects = screen_rects(); rects.has_value())
        HubConnection::the().async_view_set_screen_rects(view_id(), rects.release_value());
}

    m_navigation_listeners.set(id, move(listener));
    return id;

void RemoteView::did_start_navigation_load(URL::URL const& url)
{
    for (auto const& [id, listener] : m_navigation_listeners) {
        if (listener.on_load_start)
            listener.on_load_start(url);
    }
}

void RemoteView::did_finish_navigation_load(URL::URL const& url)
{
    for (auto const& [id, listener] : m_navigation_listeners) {
        if (listener.on_load_finish)
            listener.on_load_finish(url);
    }
}

void RemoteView::did_install_backing_stores(u64 page_id, Vector<i32> bitmap_ids, Vector<Gfx::SharedImage> backing_stores)
{
    // A publication that can't be imported is refused, so the backing stores, and the page they're from, stay as they
    // were. Its front backing store goes straight back, since nothing here will ever present from it.
    auto front_bitmap_id = bitmap_ids.first();
    if (auto result = m_backing_stores.install(move(bitmap_ids), move(backing_stores)); result.is_error()) {
        warnln("Could not install backing stores for page {}: {}", page_id, result.error());
        release_backing_store(page_id, front_bitmap_id);
        return;
    }
    m_backing_stores_page_id = page_id;
}

void RemoteView::did_present_backing_store(u64 page_id, i32 bitmap_id, Gfx::IntSize size, double device_pixel_ratio)
{
    // NB: The Compositor may paint into the backing store this frame replaced as soon as it gets it back, so that must
    //     wait until nothing here reads from it anymore.
    auto result = m_backing_stores.present(bitmap_id, size, device_pixel_ratio);
    release_backing_store(page_id, result.bitmap_id_to_release);
}

void RemoteView::did_accept_backing_store(i32 bitmap_id, Gfx::IntRect damage_rect)
{
    did_accept_presented_backing_store(bitmap_id, damage_rect);
    if (on_ready_to_paint)
        on_ready_to_paint();
}

void RemoteView::did_present_frame_in_remote_layer(Gfx::IntSize size, double device_pixel_ratio)
{
    // The view shows the remote layer from now on, so the frames it was given before are of no further use.
    m_backing_stores.clear();
    m_backing_stores.clear_backup();
    m_backing_stores.present_frame_shown_in_remote_layer(size, device_pixel_ratio);
    if (on_ready_to_paint)
        on_ready_to_paint();
}

    auto request_id = m_next_request_id++;
    m_pending_frame_snapshots.set(request_id, move(callback));
    HubConnection::the().async_view_take_frame_snapshot(view_id(), request_id);
}

    if (auto callback = m_pending_frame_snapshots.take(request_id); callback.has_value())
        (*callback)(move(snapshot));
}

        hub->async_release_backing_store(page_id, bitmap_id);
}

void RemoteView::enqueue_input_event(Web::InputEvent event)
{
    auto input_id = m_next_input_id++;
    event.visit(
        [&](Web::KeyEvent& event) {
            m_input_in_hub.set(input_id, move(event.browser_data));
            HubConnection::the().async_view_enqueue_key_event(view_id(), input_id, event.clone_without_browser_data());
        },
        [&](Web::MouseEvent& event) {
            m_input_in_hub.set(input_id, move(event.browser_data));
            HubConnection::the().async_view_enqueue_mouse_event(view_id(), input_id, event.clone_without_browser_data());
        },
        [&](Web::DragEvent& event) {
            m_input_in_hub.set(input_id, move(event.browser_data));
            auto event_to_send = event.clone_without_browser_data();
            event_to_send.files = move(event.files);
            HubConnection::the().async_view_enqueue_drag_event(view_id(), input_id, move(event_to_send));
        },
        [&](Web::PinchEvent& event) {
            HubConnection::the().async_view_enqueue_pinch_event(view_id(), event);
        });
}

void RemoteView::did_finish_handling_key_event(u64 input_id, Web::KeyEvent event)
{
    if (!on_finish_handling_key_event)
        return;
    if (auto browser_data = m_input_in_hub.take(input_id); browser_data.has_value())
        event.browser_data = browser_data.release_value();
    on_finish_handling_key_event(event);
}

void RemoteView::did_finish_handling_mouse_event(u64 input_id, Web::MouseEvent event, Web::EventResult result)
{
    if (!on_finish_handling_mouse_event)
        return;
    if (auto browser_data = m_input_in_hub.take(input_id); browser_data.has_value())
        event.browser_data = browser_data.release_value();
    on_finish_handling_mouse_event(event, result);
}

void RemoteView::did_finish_handling_drag_event(u64 input_id, Web::DragEvent event)
{
    if (!on_finish_handling_drag_event)
        return;
    if (auto browser_data = m_input_in_hub.take(input_id); browser_data.has_value())
        event.browser_data = browser_data.release_value();
    on_finish_handling_drag_event(event);
}

NonnullRefPtr<Core::Promise<ByteString>> RemoteView::selected_text()
{
    auto promise = Core::Promise<ByteString>::construct();
    auto request_id = m_next_request_id++;
    m_pending_selected_text.set(request_id, promise);
    HubConnection::the().async_view_request_selected_text(view_id(), request_id);
    return promise;
}

void RemoteView::did_get_selected_text(u64 request_id, Optional<ByteString> text)
{
    auto promise = m_pending_selected_text.take(request_id);
    if (!promise.has_value())
        return;
    if (text.has_value())
        (*promise)->resolve(text.release_value());
    else
        (*promise)->reject(Error::from_errno(ECANCELED));
}

        (*on_complete)(may_close);
}

Optional<i32> RemoteView::history_step_at_delta(int delta) const
{
    auto const& traversable = m_view->traversable();
    auto used_steps = traversable.session_history().used_steps();
    auto step_index = traversable.effective_current_session_history_step_index() + delta;
    if (step_index >= used_steps.size())
        return {};
    return used_steps[step_index];
}

    for (auto& [view_id, view] : s_views)
        callback(*view);

void RemoteView::did_change_session_history(WebView::SessionHistorySnapshot history, URL::URL url)
{
    // NB: A report the Hub sent before we stopped asking for them may still arrive.
    if (!m_session_tab_id.has_value())
        return;
    Application::session_store(m_is_private).update_tab_state({ .tab_id = *m_session_tab_id, .history = move(history), .url = move(url) });
}

Vector<WebView::HistoryEntry> RemoteView::recent_history_entries(size_t limit) const
{
    if (is_private() == WebView::IsPrivate::Yes)
        return {};
    return Application::history_store().list_entries({}, 0, limit);
}

Vector<RemoteView::SessionHistoryTraversalMenuItem> RemoteView::session_history_traversal_menu_items(int direction) const
{
    Vector<SessionHistoryTraversalMenuItem> items;
    for (auto& item : session_history_traversal_items(direction)) {
        Optional<WebView::HistoryEntry> history_entry;
        if (is_private() == WebView::IsPrivate::No)
            history_entry = Application::history_store().entry_for_url(item.url);
        auto url = item.url.serialize();
        auto title = history_entry.has_value() && history_entry->title.has_value() && !history_entry->title->is_empty()
            ? move(*history_entry->title)
            : url;
        items.append({
            .step = item.step,
            .title = move(title),
            .url = move(url),
            .favicon_png = history_entry.has_value() ? move(history_entry->favicon_png) : OptionalNone {},
        });
    }
    return items;
}

void RemoteView::did_change_favicon(Optional<Gfx::Bitmap const&> favicon)
{
    m_favicon_hash.clear();
    if (!favicon.has_value())
        return;

    if (auto favicon_png = Gfx::PNGWriter::encode(*favicon); !favicon_png.is_error())
        m_favicon_hash = Application::favicon_store(is_private()).add_favicon(favicon_png.release_value());
    if (!m_favicon_hash.has_value() || is_private() == WebView::IsPrivate::Yes)
        return;

    Application::history_store().update_favicon(url(), *m_favicon_hash);
    Application::bookmark_store().update_favicon(url(), *m_favicon_hash);
}

void RemoteView::did_visit_page(URL::URL const& url, Optional<String> const& title, WebView::HistoryVisitTransition transition)
{
    if (is_private() == WebView::IsPrivate::No)
        Application::history_store().record_visit(url, title, UnixDateTime::now(), transition);
}

void RemoteView::did_change_visited_page_title(URL::URL const& url, String const& title)
{
    if (is_private() == WebView::IsPrivate::No)
        Application::history_store().update_title(url, title);
}

void RemoteView::did_finish_loading(URL::URL const& url)
{
    if (is_private() == WebView::IsPrivate::No && m_favicon_hash.has_value())
        Application::history_store().update_favicon(url, *m_favicon_hash);
}

// The browser's own strings are English, so languages are named in English.
static String language_display_name(StringView language)
{
    auto primary_language = WebView::primary_language_subtag(language);
    if (auto name = Unicode::language_display_name("en"sv, primary_language, Unicode::LanguageDisplay::Standard); name.has_value())
        return name->to_utf8();
    return MUST(String::from_utf8(primary_language));
}

void RemoteView::create_translation_actions()
{
    m_translate_action = Action::create("Translate"sv, ActionID::TranslatePage, [] { });

    m_translation_menu = Menu::create("Translation"sv);
    for (size_t index = 0; index < WebView::PageTranslation::MAXIMUM_OFFERED_LANGUAGES; ++index) {
        auto translate_to_action = Action::create_checkable("Translate"sv, ActionID::TranslateTo, [this, index] {
            if (index < m_state.translation_targets.size() && !m_state.translation_targets[index].needs_download)
                HubConnection::the().async_view_translate_to(view_id(), m_state.translation_targets[index].language);
            // NB: The check mark shows the language the page is in, which activating an action doesn't change by itself.
            update_view_actions();
        });
        translate_to_action->set_visible(false);
        m_translation_menu->add_action(translate_to_action);
        m_translate_to_actions.append(move(translate_to_action));

        auto download_languages_action = Action::create("Download"sv, ActionID::DownloadTranslationLanguages, [this, index] {
            if (index < m_state.translation_targets.size())
                HubConnection::the().async_view_download_translation_languages(view_id(), m_state.translation_targets[index].language);
        });
        download_languages_action->set_visible(false);
        m_translation_menu->add_action(download_languages_action);
        m_download_languages_actions.append(move(download_languages_action));
    }
    m_show_original_action = Action::create("Show Original"sv, ActionID::ShowOriginal, [this] {
        HubConnection::the().async_view_show_original(view_id());
    });
    m_translation_menu->add_action(*m_show_original_action);
    m_translation_menu->add_separator();
    m_prefer_higher_quality_action = Action::create_checkable("Use Higher-Quality Models"sv, ActionID::PreferHigherQualityTranslation, [this] {
        HubConnection::the().async_view_prefer_higher_quality_translation(view_id(), !m_state.translation_prefers_higher_quality);
        // NB: The check mark shows the saved choice, which the Hub sends back with the view's state.
        update_view_actions();
    });
    m_prefer_higher_quality_action->set_visible(false);
    m_translation_menu->add_action(*m_prefer_higher_quality_action);
    m_translation_menu->add_action(Action::create("Preferred Languages…"sv, ActionID::EditPreferredLanguages, [] {
        auto url = URL::about_settings();
        url.set_fragment("editLanguages"sv);
        Application::the().activate_or_open_tab_with_url(url);
    }));
}

void RemoteView::update_translation_actions()
{
    auto const& targets = m_state.translation_targets;
    // The platform's settings run a download and don't say how far along it is — so the button pulses until it ends.
    auto downloading = any_of(targets, [](auto const& target) { return target.downloading; });
    m_translate_action->set_visible(m_state.translation_offered);
    m_translate_action->set_engaged(m_state.is_translated);
    m_translate_action->set_busy(downloading);
    if (m_state.is_translated)
        m_translate_action->set_tooltip("Showing translation"sv);
    else if (downloading)
        m_translate_action->set_tooltip("Downloading a language to translate this page"sv);
    else
        m_translate_action->set_tooltip("Translate this page"sv);

    auto const& target_language = m_state.translation_target_language;
    for (size_t index = 0; index < m_translate_to_actions.size(); ++index) {
        auto& translate_to_action = m_translate_to_actions[index];
        auto& download_languages_action = m_download_languages_actions[index];
        if (index >= targets.size()) {
            translate_to_action->set_visible(false);
            download_languages_action->set_visible(false);
            continue;
        }

        auto const& target = targets[index];
        auto name = language_display_name(target.language);
        // The item names the languages to download, and the target when it isn't one of them: "Download Dutch to
        // Translate to English…" for a Dutch page, but "Download Italian to Translate…" for an English one.
        String download_names;
        String download_target;
        if (target.languages_to_download.is_empty()) {
            download_names = "Languages"_string;
            download_target = MUST(String::formatted(" to {}", name));
        } else {
            Vector<String> names;
            for (auto const& language : target.languages_to_download)
                names.append(language_display_name(language));
            download_names = MUST(String::join(" and "sv, names));
            if (!any_of(target.languages_to_download, [&](auto const& language) { return WebView::is_same_language(language, target.language); }))
                download_target = MUST(String::formatted(" to {}", name));
        }

        translate_to_action->set_text(MUST(String::formatted("Translate to {}", name)));
        translate_to_action->set_checked(target_language.has_value() && WebView::is_same_language(*target_language, target.language));
        translate_to_action->set_visible(!target.needs_download);

        if (target.needs_download && target.downloading)
            download_languages_action->set_text(MUST(String::formatted("Downloading {} to Translate{}…", download_names, download_target)));
        else if (target.needs_download)
            download_languages_action->set_text(MUST(String::formatted("Download {} to Translate{}…", download_names, download_target)));
        else if (target.downloading)
            download_languages_action->set_text(MUST(String::formatted("Downloading {} for Faster Translation{}…", download_names, download_target)));
        else
            download_languages_action->set_text(MUST(String::formatted("Download {} for Faster Translation{}…", download_names, download_target)));
        download_languages_action->set_enabled(!target.downloading);
        download_languages_action->set_visible(target.needs_download || target.faster_after_download);
    }

    m_show_original_action->set_enabled(m_state.is_translated);

    auto* translator = Application::the().translator();
    auto higher_quality_models_name = translator ? translator->higher_quality_models_name() : Optional<StringView> {};
    if (higher_quality_models_name.has_value())
        m_prefer_higher_quality_action->set_text(MUST(String::formatted("Use {} (Slower)", *higher_quality_models_name)));
    m_prefer_higher_quality_action->set_checked(m_state.translation_prefers_higher_quality);
    m_prefer_higher_quality_action->set_visible(higher_quality_models_name.has_value() && any_of(targets, [](auto const& target) { return target.higher_quality_available; }));
}

void RemoteView::update_view_actions()
{
    // NB: The state can come before the view has made its actions.
    if (!m_navigate_back_action)
        return;

    m_navigate_back_action->set_enabled(m_state.can_navigate_back);
    m_navigate_forward_action->set_enabled(m_state.can_navigate_forward);
    if (m_state.zoom_level != 1.0) {
        m_reset_zoom_action->set_text(MUST(String::formatted("{}%", round_to<int>(m_state.zoom_level * 100))));
        m_reset_zoom_action->set_visible(true);
    } else {
        m_reset_zoom_action->set_visible(false);
    }
    update_translation_actions();
}

void RemoteView::did_request_context_menu(WebView::ContextMenuRequest const& request)
{
    // NB: The menu has to outlive this call, since the view may show it later.
    m_context_menu = create_context_menu(*this, request);
    show_context_menu(*m_context_menu, request.widget_position);
}

void RemoteView::did_make_link_to_highlight(Optional<URL::URL> url)
{
    m_link_to_highlight = move(url);
    m_copy_link_to_highlight_action->set_enabled(m_link_to_highlight.has_value());
}

void RemoteView::load_from_user_input(URL::URL const& url)
{
    if (on_load_from_user_input)
        on_load_from_user_input();

    if (!WebView::is_url_handled_internally(url)) {
        open_external_url_from_user_input(url);
        return;
    }
    load(url);
}

void RemoteView::load_from_user_input(StringView input)
{
    load_from_user_input(input, WebView::sanitize_url(input, Application::settings().search_engine_settings().engine));
}

void RemoteView::load_from_user_input(StringView input, Optional<URL::URL> fallback_url)
{
    if (on_load_from_user_input)
        on_load_from_user_input();

    auto classified_input = WebView::classify_user_input(input);

    if (classified_input.classification != WebView::UserInputClassification::ExternalURL) {
        if (fallback_url.has_value())
            load(*fallback_url);
        else
            load_navigation_error_page(input);
        return;
    }

    VERIFY(classified_input.url.has_value());
    auto external_url = classified_input.url.release_value();

    if (fallback_url.has_value() && *fallback_url == external_url) {
        open_external_url_from_user_input(external_url);
        return;
    }

    open_external_url_from_user_input(external_url, [view_id = view_id(), input = MUST(String::from_utf8(input)), fallback_url = move(fallback_url)] {
        auto* view = RemoteView::find(view_id);
        if (!view)
            return;
        if (fallback_url.has_value())
            view->load(*fallback_url);
        else
            view->load_navigation_error_page(input);
    });
}

void RemoteView::open_url_in_new_tab(URL::URL const& url, Web::HTML::ActivateTab activate_tab)
{
    if (!WebView::is_url_handled_internally(url)) {
        open_external_url_from_user_input(url);
        return;
    }
    HubConnection::the().async_view_open_url_in_new_tab(view_id(), url, activate_tab);
}

void RemoteView::open_url_in_new_window(URL::URL const& url, WebView::IsPrivate is_private)
{
    if (!WebView::is_url_handled_internally(url)) {
        open_external_url_from_user_input(url);
        return;
    }
    HubConnection::the().async_view_open_url_in_new_window(view_id(), url, is_private);
}

void RemoteView::load_navigation_error_page(StringView input)
{
    auto message = MUST(String::formatted("Failed to load \"{}\"", input));

    StringBuilder builder;
    builder.appendff(WebView::ERROR_HTML_HEADER, ""sv, WebView::ERROR_SVG, message);
    builder.append("<p>If you were trying to enter a search query, please enable search in <a href=\"about:settings#search\">settings</a>.</p>"sv);
    builder.append(WebView::ERROR_HTML_FOOTER);
    load_html(builder.string_view());
}

void RemoteView::open_external_url_from_user_input(URL::URL const& url, Function<void()> on_handler_unavailable)
{
    m_pending_external_urls.enqueue({ url, this->url().origin(), move(on_handler_unavailable) });
    open_next_external_url();
}

void RemoteView::open_next_external_url()
{
    while (!m_external_url_pending && !m_pending_external_urls.is_empty()) {
        auto request = m_pending_external_urls.dequeue();
        if (WebView::ExternalURLRequestPolicy::is_denied_scheme(request.url.scheme()))
            continue;

        m_external_url_pending = true;
        auto url = request.url;
        Application::the().resolve_external_url_handler(url, [view_id = view_id(), request = move(request)](RefPtr<WebView::ExternalURLHandler> handler) mutable {
            if (auto* view = RemoteView::find(view_id))
                view->open_external_url_with_handler(move(request), move(handler));
        });
    }
}

void RemoteView::open_external_url_with_handler(PendingExternalURL request, RefPtr<WebView::ExternalURLHandler> handler)
{
    auto launch = [view_id = view_id()](WebView::ExternalURLHandler const& handler, URL::URL const& url) {
        handler.launch(url, [view_id](bool success) {
            if (!success && RemoteView::find(view_id))
                Application::the().display_error_dialog("Unable to open external URL"sv);
        });
    };

    if (!handler || handler->is_ladybird()) {
        finish_external_url();
        if (request.on_handler_unavailable)
            request.on_handler_unavailable();
        else if (!handler)
            Application::the().display_error_dialog(MUST(String::formatted("No application is registered to open {}", request.url)));
        return;
    }

    // Don't prompt when the user asked for a mailto: URL. This matches other browsers.
    if (request.url.scheme() == "mailto"sv) {
        launch(*handler, request.url);
        finish_external_url();
        return;
    }

    if (!on_request_external_url_confirmation) {
        finish_external_url();
        return;
    }

    on_request_external_url_confirmation(request.url, request.initiator_origin, handler->application_name(), [view_id = view_id(), url = request.url, handler, launch](bool accepted) {
        if (accepted)
            launch(*handler, url);
        if (auto* view = RemoteView::find(view_id))
            view->finish_external_url();
    });
}

void RemoteView::finish_external_url()
{
    VERIFY(m_external_url_pending);
    m_external_url_pending = false;
    if (m_pending_external_urls.is_empty())
        return;
    Core::deferred_invoke([view_id = view_id()] {
        if (auto* view = RemoteView::find(view_id))
            view->open_next_external_url();
    });
}

}

// the rest of the UI the calls and callbacks that it takes to use the view.

    };

#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <UI/Qt/ChromeStyle.h>

namespace Ladybird::ReportReview {

QLabel* create_label(QString const& text, QWidget* parent)
{
    auto* label = new QLabel(text, parent);
    label->setTextFormat(Qt::PlainText);
    label->setWordWrap(true);
    label->setTextInteractionFlags(Qt::TextSelectableByMouse);
    return label;
}

QLabel* create_heading(QString const& text, qreal scale, QWidget* parent)
{
    auto* label = create_label(text, parent);
    auto font = label->font();
    font.setPointSizeF(font.pointSizeF() * scale);
    font.setBold(true);
    label->setFont(font);
    return label;
}

QLabel* create_title(QString const& text, QWidget* parent)
{
    auto* label = create_label(text, parent);
    auto font = label->font();
    font.setPixelSize(22);
    font.setWeight(QFont::DemiBold);
    label->setFont(font);
    return label;
}

// A button that shows or hides the content below it, which starts out hidden. It is drawn as plain text, flush with the
// text around it, as styles frame buttons on hover and press and indent them. A triangle in the same font shows whether
// the content is shown, as styles size arrows to the icon size. Keyboard focus shows in the accent color.
QPushButton* create_disclosure(QString const& text, QWidget* content, QWidget* parent)
{
    auto* button = new QPushButton(parent);
    button->setAutoDefault(false);
    button->setStyleSheet("QPushButton { border: none; background: transparent; padding: 0; margin: 0; text-align: left; }"
                          "QPushButton:focus { color: palette(highlight); text-decoration: underline; }");
    // Styles may give buttons a font of their own, which only a size set on the button itself overrides.
    auto font = QApplication::font("QLabel");
    if (font.pointSizeF() > 0)
        font.setPointSizeF(font.pointSizeF());
    else
        font.setPixelSize(font.pixelSize());
    button->setFont(font);

    auto update_text = [button, text](bool expanded) {
        // U+FE0E keeps the triangles in text presentation, where macOS would otherwise draw them as emoji.
        button->setText(QStringLiteral("%1︎ %2").arg(expanded ? QChar(0x25BC) : QChar(0x25B6), text));
    };
    update_text(false);
    content->hide();
    QObject::connect(button, &QPushButton::clicked, content, [content, update_text] {
        auto expanded = content->isHidden();
        update_text(expanded);
        content->setVisible(expanded);
    });
    return button;
}

// Items within a group sit close together, and the groups themselves further apart.
QVBoxLayout* create_group_layout(QWidget* group)
{
    auto* layout = new QVBoxLayout(group);
    layout->setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0);
    layout->setSpacing(item_spacing);
    return layout;
}

QFrame* create_details_panel(QWidget* parent)
{
    auto* details = new QFrame(parent);
    details->setObjectName("ReportDetails");
    auto* layout = create_group_layout(details);
    layout->setContentsMargins(panel_padding, panel_padding, panel_padding, panel_padding);
    return details;
}

QFormLayout* create_details_form()
{
    auto* form = new QFormLayout;
    form->setFieldGrowthPolicy(QFormLayout::AllNonFixedFieldsGrow);
    form->setLabelAlignment(Qt::AlignLeft | Qt::AlignTop);
    form->setHorizontalSpacing(group_spacing / 2);
    form->setVerticalSpacing(item_spacing);
    return form;
}

void set_details(QFormLayout& form, ReadonlySpan<WebView::ReportDetail> details, QWidget* parent)
{
    while (form.rowCount() > 0)
        form.removeRow(0);

    for (auto const& detail : details) {
        // Labels stay on one line, so each value starts level with its label however far it wraps.
        auto* label = create_label(qstring_from_ak_string(detail.label), parent);
        label->setWordWrap(false);
        auto* value = create_label(qstring_from_ak_string(detail.value), parent);
        if (detail.is_code)
            value->setFont(QFontDatabase::systemFont(QFontDatabase::FixedFont));
        // The review may be styled already, and its style sheet would hold these to the application's palette.
        if (parent) {
            label->setPalette(parent->palette());
            value->setPalette(parent->palette());
        }
        form.addRow(label, value);
    }
}

// The full report is read in place of the review that offers to send it, exactly as it would be sent.
ReportTextPage create_report_text_page(QWidget* parent)
{
    auto* page = new QWidget(parent);
    auto* layout = create_group_layout(page);
    layout->addWidget(create_heading(QObject::tr("Full report"), 1, page));

    auto* text = new QPlainTextEdit(page);
    text->setObjectName("ReportText");
    text->setReadOnly(true);
    text->setLineWrapMode(QPlainTextEdit::NoWrap);
    text->setFont(QFontDatabase::systemFont(QFontDatabase::FixedFont));
    text->setMinimumHeight(text->fontMetrics().lineSpacing() * 24);
    layout->addWidget(text);

    auto* back_button = new QPushButton(QObject::tr("Back"), page);
    back_button->setObjectName("ReportTextBackButton");
    back_button->setAutoDefault(false);
    layout->addSpacing(item_spacing);
    layout->addWidget(back_button, 0, Qt::AlignLeft);

    page->hide();
    return { page, text, back_button };
}

// Only the fields get a stronger placeholder color. The muted lines keep the color the screen around the review uses
// for its own.
void apply_style(QWidget& review, ReadonlySpan<QWidget*> fields)
{
    // The review starts again from the palette it inherits, so it sees every switch between light and dark. Its style
    // sheet comes off first, as Qt puts back the palette a widget had when its style sheet was applied. And a widget
    // that a style sheet styles takes the application's palette rather than its parent's, so each one is given the
    // review's.
    review.setStyleSheet({});
    review.setPalette(QPalette {});
    // Every role is set explicitly, as a widget that a style sheet styles resolves the roles left unset against the
    // application's palette, which may have the other appearance.
    auto palette = Theme::interface_palette(review.palette());
    palette.setResolveMask(~QPalette::ResolveMask { 0 });
    review.setPalette(palette);
    for (auto* widget : review.findChildren<QWidget*>())
        widget->setPalette(palette);

    for (auto* field : fields) {
        auto field_palette = field->palette();
        field_palette.setColor(QPalette::PlaceholderText, ChromeStyle::report_review_placeholder_text(review.palette()));
        field->setPalette(field_palette);
    }
    review.setStyleSheet(ChromeStyle::report_review_style_sheet(review.palette()));

    // A widget with a style sheet of its own, such as a disclosure, keeps the palette Qt saved for it when it was first
    // styled, and gets that back as the review's style sheet is applied.
    for (auto* widget : review.findChildren<QWidget*>()) {
        if (!widget->styleSheet().isEmpty())
            widget->setPalette(palette);
    }
}

// Tab moves through every control of the review and wraps around within it. The platform's own focus chain would skip
// buttons where the system limits Tab to text fields, as macOS does by default, and lead into the web view behind a
// tab's crash screen, which keeps Tab for the page.
bool focus_next_control(QWidget& review, bool next)
{
    Vector<QWidget*> controls;
    for (auto* widget = review.nextInFocusChain(); widget != &review; widget = widget->nextInFocusChain()) {
        if (review.isAncestorOf(widget) && widget->isVisibleTo(&review) && widget->isEnabled() && (widget->focusPolicy() & Qt::TabFocus))
            controls.append(widget);
    }
    if (controls.is_empty())
        return false;

    auto current = controls.find_first_index(review.window()->focusWidget());
    size_t index = 0;
    if (current.has_value())
        index = next ? (*current + 1) % controls.size() : (*current + controls.size() - 1) % controls.size();
    else if (!next)
        index = controls.size() - 1;

    auto* control = controls[index];
    control->setFocus(next ? Qt::TabFocusReason : Qt::BacktabFocusReason);
    for (auto* ancestor = review.parentWidget(); ancestor; ancestor = ancestor->parentWidget()) {
        if (auto* scroll_area = qobject_cast<QScrollArea*>(ancestor)) {
            scroll_area->ensureWidgetVisible(control);
            break;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

// How far along a report is at each stage of sending it, which takes most of its time solving the proof of work.
int progress_percent(WebView::ReportSubmission::Stage stage)
{
    using Stage = WebView::ReportSubmission::Stage;

    switch (stage) {
    case Stage::Preparing:
        return 15;
    case Stage::RequestingChallenge:
        return 40;
    case Stage::SolvingProof:
        return 65;
    case Stage::Sending:
        return 85;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

void show_actions(ReadonlySpan<QPushButton*> all_actions, ReadonlySpan<QPushButton*> actions, QPushButton* primary)
{
    for (auto* button : all_actions) {
        button->setVisible(actions.contains_slow(button));
        button->setDefault(button == primary);
    }
    if (auto* focused = primary ? primary : (actions.is_empty() ? nullptr : actions.first()))
        focused->setFocus(Qt::OtherFocusReason);
}

QString retry_message(String const& reason, u32 retry_number, u32 maximum_retries, u32 delay_seconds)
{
    return QObject::tr("%1 Trying again in %2 seconds (%3 of %4)…")
        .arg(qstring_from_ak_string(reason))
        .arg(delay_seconds)
        .arg(retry_number)
        .arg(maximum_retries);
}

}

#include <AK/GenericShorthands.h>
#include <UI/Qt/ChromeStyle.h>
#include <UI/Qt/Icon.h>
#include <UI/Qt/Popover.h>
#include <UI/Qt/ScreenshotSelectionOverlay.h>

#include <QApplication>
#include <QEvent>
#include <QFontMetricsF>
#include <QFrame>
#include <QHBoxLayout>
#include <QKeyEvent>
#include <QLabel>
#include <QMouseEvent>
#include <QPainter>
#include <QPointer>
#include <QPushButton>
#include <QTimer>
#include <QVBoxLayout>

namespace Ladybird {

static constexpr int INSTRUCTIONS_MARGIN = 16;
static constexpr int INSTRUCTIONS_PADDING = 16;
static constexpr int INSTRUCTIONS_BUTTON_SPACING = 8;
static constexpr int INSTRUCTIONS_ROW_SPACING = 12;
static constexpr int DIMMING_ALPHA = 110;
static constexpr int SCROLL_SETTLE_TIME_MS = 100;
static constexpr int MAXIMUM_SCROLL_ANIMATION_TIME_MS = 300;

// The instructions stay on one line while the tab has room for it, and wrap rather than being cut off when it does not.
class InstructionsLabel final : public QLabel {
public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    InstructionsLabel(QString const& text, QWidget* parent)
        : QLabel(text, parent)
    {
        setTextFormat(Qt::PlainText);
        setWordWrap(true);
    }

    virtual QSize sizeHint() const override
    {
        auto margins = contentsMargins();
        auto width = qCeil(QFontMetricsF(font()).horizontalAdvance(text())) + margins.left() + margins.right() + 1;
        return { width, heightForWidth(width) };
    }
};

// Shows the page as it was when the selection started or the user last scrolled it, so the user selects what they saw,
// not what the page has changed to since. The rest of the frame dims around the selection.
ScreenshotSelectionOverlay::ScreenshotSelectionOverlay(QImage frame, QWidget* parent, Purpose purpose)
    : QWidget(parent)
    , m_frame(AK::move(frame))
{
    setObjectName("LadybirdScreenshotSelection");
    setCursor(Qt::CrossCursor);
    setFocusPolicy(Qt::StrongFocus);

    m_scroll_settle_timer = new QTimer(this);
    m_scroll_settle_timer->setSingleShot(true);
    m_scroll_settle_timer->setInterval(SCROLL_SETTLE_TIME_MS);
    QObject::connect(m_scroll_settle_timer, &QTimer::timeout, this, [this] { cover_page(); });

    auto* instructions = new QFrame(this);
    instructions->setObjectName("ScreenshotSelectionInstructions");
    instructions->setAttribute(Qt::WA_StyledBackground);
    instructions->setCursor(Qt::OpenHandCursor);
    instructions->installEventFilter(this);
    cast_popover_shadow(*instructions);
    // The text goes above the buttons, with the close button beside it like a dialog's, so that it keeps the card's
    // width in a narrow tab rather than being squeezed into a column beside the buttons.
    auto* layout = new QVBoxLayout(instructions);
    layout->setContentsMargins(INSTRUCTIONS_PADDING, INSTRUCTIONS_PADDING, INSTRUCTIONS_PADDING, INSTRUCTIONS_PADDING);
    layout->setSpacing(INSTRUCTIONS_ROW_SPACING);
    auto* text_layout = new QHBoxLayout;
    text_layout->setSpacing(INSTRUCTIONS_BUTTON_SPACING);
    auto text = purpose == Purpose::ReportIssue ? tr("Drag to select the part of the page that shows the problem.") : tr("Drag to select the part of the page to save.");
    text_layout->addWidget(new InstructionsLabel(text, instructions), 1);
    layout->addLayout(text_layout);
    auto* button_layout = new QHBoxLayout;
    button_layout->setSpacing(INSTRUCTIONS_BUTTON_SPACING);
    button_layout->addStretch();
    layout->addLayout(button_layout);

    auto add_button = [&](QHBoxLayout& row, QString const& text, char const* object_name, auto on_click) {
        auto* button = new QPushButton(text, instructions);
        button->setObjectName(object_name);
        button->setFocusPolicy(Qt::TabFocus);
        button->setCursor(Qt::ArrowCursor);
        // The macOS style lays out a button by the bezel it would draw, which sits higher in the button than this style
        // sheet's border does. Laying the buttons out by their whole rect keeps them in line with the text and the padding.
        button->setAttribute(Qt::WA_LayoutUsesWidgetRect);
        QObject::connect(button, &QPushButton::clicked, this, AK::move(on_click));
        row.addWidget(button, 0, Qt::AlignTop);
        m_buttons.append(button);
        return button;
    };
    add_button(*button_layout, tr("Capture Visible Page"), "ScreenshotSelectionWholeFrameButton", [this] { use_whole_frame(); });
    // A report can go without a screenshot, and a saved screenshot can show all of the page rather than what is visible.
    if (purpose == Purpose::ReportIssue)
        add_button(*button_layout, tr("Continue Without Screenshot"), "ScreenshotSelectionSkipButton", [this] { skip(); });
    else
        add_button(*button_layout, tr("Capture Full Page"), "ScreenshotSelectionFullPageButton", [this] { use_full_page(); });
    m_close_button = add_button(*text_layout, {}, "ScreenshotSelectionCancelButton", [this] { dismiss(); });
    m_close_button->setToolTip(tr("Close"));
    m_close_button->setAccessibleName(tr("Close"));

    m_instructions = instructions;
    update_chrome_style();

    if (parent)
        setGeometry(parent->rect());
}

// The card is as large as its contents, however a restyle changes them, but no wider than the overlay. It sits centered
// at the top until the user moves it, and stays within the overlay either way.
void ScreenshotSelectionOverlay::place_instructions()
{
    auto available = rect().adjusted(INSTRUCTIONS_MARGIN, INSTRUCTIONS_MARGIN, -INSTRUCTIONS_MARGIN, -INSTRUCTIONS_MARGIN);
    auto width = qMax(m_instructions->minimumSizeHint().width(), qMin(m_instructions->sizeHint().width(), available.width()));
    auto height = m_instructions->hasHeightForWidth() ? m_instructions->heightForWidth(width) : m_instructions->sizeHint().height();

    auto position = m_instructions_position.value_or(QPoint { available.left() + (available.width() - width) / 2, available.top() });
    position.setX(qMax(available.left(), qMin(position.x(), available.right() + 1 - width)));
    position.setY(qMax(available.top(), qMin(position.y(), available.bottom() + 1 - height)));
    m_instructions->setGeometry({ position, QSize { width, height } });
}

// The selection in the coordinates of this widget, which the frame is stretched across.
QRect ScreenshotSelectionOverlay::selection() const
{
    if (!m_drag_start.has_value())
        return {};
    QPoint top_left { qMin(m_drag_start->x(), m_drag_end.x()), qMin(m_drag_start->y(), m_drag_end.y()) };
    QSize size { qAbs(m_drag_end.x() - m_drag_start->x()), qAbs(m_drag_end.y() - m_drag_start->y()) };
    return QRect(top_left, size).intersected(rect());
}

void ScreenshotSelectionOverlay::select(QRect area)
{
    area = area.normalized().intersected(rect());
    if (area.width() < minimum_selection_size || area.height() < minimum_selection_size || width() <= 0 || height() <= 0)
        return;

    auto scale_x = static_cast<qreal>(m_frame.width()) / width();
    auto scale_y = static_cast<qreal>(m_frame.height()) / height();
    QRect frame_area {
        qRound(area.x() * scale_x),
        qRound(area.y() * scale_y),
        qRound(area.width() * scale_x),
        qRound(area.height() * scale_y),
    };
    finish(m_frame.copy(frame_area.intersected(m_frame.rect())));
}

void ScreenshotSelectionOverlay::use_whole_frame()
{
    finish(m_frame);
}

void ScreenshotSelectionOverlay::use_full_page()
{
    dismiss();
    if (on_full_page_requested)
        on_full_page_requested();
}

void ScreenshotSelectionOverlay::skip()
{
    finish({});
}

// While the page scrolls underneath, the overlay steps aside for the page to present itself as it does without one,
// rather than copying each frame the page paints. It still takes the input, so that a press starts a selection rather
// than reaching the page. Once the scrolling settles, or the user goes on selecting, the overlay takes the page's frame
// and covers it again.
void ScreenshotSelectionOverlay::page_did_scroll()
{
    if (m_drag_start.has_value())
        return;

    m_scroll_settle_timer->start();
    m_follow_frames_until.setRemainingTime(MAXIMUM_SCROLL_ANIMATION_TIME_MS);
    ++m_reveal_generation;
    if (m_reveals_page)
        return;

    m_reveals_page = true;
    m_instructions->hide();
    update();
    if (on_page_visibility_change)
        on_page_visibility_change();
}

// The scrolling settles once the page stops moving, which it may go on doing for a moment after the last input, such as
// to scroll smoothly. A page that always paints, such as to play an animation, settles soon after the input anyway.
void ScreenshotSelectionOverlay::page_did_paint()
{
    if (m_reveals_page && !m_follow_frames_until.hasExpired())
        m_scroll_settle_timer->start();
}

void ScreenshotSelectionOverlay::cover_page()
{
    if (!m_reveals_page)
        return;

    m_scroll_settle_timer->stop();
    on_request_page_frame([self = QPointer { this }, generation = m_reveal_generation](QImage frame) {
        if (!self || !self->m_reveals_page || self->m_reveal_generation != generation)
            return;
        if (!frame.isNull())
            self->m_frame = AK::move(frame);
        self->m_reveals_page = false;
        self->m_instructions->show();
        self->update();
        if (self->on_page_visibility_change)
            self->on_page_visibility_change();
        if (auto action = AK::move(self->m_action_once_page_is_covered)) {
            self->m_action_once_page_is_covered = nullptr;
            action();
        }
    });
}

// The frame that covers the page arrives later, so a selection or a capture made while the page is revealed waits for
// it, rather than taking the frame from before the page scrolled.
void ScreenshotSelectionOverlay::once_page_is_covered(Function<void()> action)
{
    if (!m_reveals_page) {
        action();
        return;
    }
    m_action_once_page_is_covered = AK::move(action);
    cover_page();
}

void ScreenshotSelectionOverlay::dismiss()
{
    m_scroll_settle_timer->stop();
    m_action_once_page_is_covered = nullptr;
    hide();
    if (on_close)
        on_close();
}

// The overlay closes before the screenshot is handed on, which may open something that takes the focus.
void ScreenshotSelectionOverlay::finish(QImage image)
{
    dismiss();
    if (on_finished)
        on_finished(AK::move(image));
}

void ScreenshotSelectionOverlay::paintEvent(QPaintEvent*)
{
    if (m_reveals_page)
        return;

    QPainter painter(this);
    painter.drawImage(rect(), m_frame);

    auto selected = selection();
    QRegion dimmed { rect() };
    if (!selected.isEmpty())
        dimmed = dimmed.subtracted(selected);
    painter.setClipRegion(dimmed);
    painter.fillRect(rect(), QColor(0, 0, 0, DIMMING_ALPHA));
    painter.setClipping(false);

    if (!selected.isEmpty()) {
        painter.setPen(QPen(palette().color(QPalette::Highlight), 2));
        painter.drawRect(selected.adjusted(1, 1, -1, -1));
    }
}

void ScreenshotSelectionOverlay::mousePressEvent(QMouseEvent* event)
{
    if (event->button() != Qt::LeftButton)
        return;
    cover_page();
    m_drag_start = event->position().toPoint();
    m_drag_end = *m_drag_start;
    update();
}

void ScreenshotSelectionOverlay::mouseMoveEvent(QMouseEvent* event)
{
    if (!m_drag_start.has_value())
        return;

    // Only the area the selection leaves or enters changes, along with the outline around it.
    auto previous_selection = selection();
    m_drag_end = event->position().toPoint();
    update(previous_selection.united(selection()).adjusted(-2, -2, 2, 2));
}

// A click without a drag selects nothing, so the user can try again.
void ScreenshotSelectionOverlay::mouseReleaseEvent(QMouseEvent* event)
{
    if (event->button() != Qt::LeftButton || !m_drag_start.has_value())
        return;
    m_drag_end = event->position().toPoint();
    auto selected = selection();
    m_drag_start.clear();
    update();
    once_page_is_covered([this, selected] { select(selected); });
}

// The user drags the card out of the way of the part of the page they want to select, rather than starting a selection.
bool ScreenshotSelectionOverlay::eventFilter(QObject* object, QEvent* event)
{
    if (object != m_instructions)
        return QWidget::eventFilter(object, event);

    if (event->type() == QEvent::LayoutRequest)
        place_instructions();
    if (!first_is_one_of(event->type(), QEvent::MouseButtonPress, QEvent::MouseMove, QEvent::MouseButtonRelease))
        return QWidget::eventFilter(object, event);

    auto& mouse_event = static_cast<QMouseEvent&>(*event);
    auto position = mouse_event.globalPosition().toPoint();
    if (event->type() == QEvent::MouseButtonPress && mouse_event.button() == Qt::LeftButton) {
        m_instructions_grab_offset = position - m_instructions->pos();
        m_instructions->setCursor(Qt::ClosedHandCursor);
    } else if (event->type() == QEvent::MouseMove && m_instructions_grab_offset.has_value()) {
        m_instructions_position = position - *m_instructions_grab_offset;
        place_instructions();
        m_instructions_position = m_instructions->pos();
    } else if (event->type() == QEvent::MouseButtonRelease && mouse_event.button() == Qt::LeftButton) {
        m_instructions_grab_offset.clear();
        m_instructions->setCursor(Qt::OpenHandCursor);
    }
    return true;
}

void ScreenshotSelectionOverlay::resizeEvent(QResizeEvent* event)
{
    QWidget::resizeEvent(event);
    place_instructions();
}

void ScreenshotSelectionOverlay::keyPressEvent(QKeyEvent* event)
{
    switch (event->key()) {
    case Qt::Key_Return:
    case Qt::Key_Enter: {
        // A focused button does what it says. Otherwise, the whole frame is taken.
        QPointer<QPushButton> focused_button = qobject_cast<QPushButton*>(QApplication::focusWidget());
        if (focused_button && !m_buttons.contains_slow(focused_button.data()))
            focused_button = nullptr;
        once_page_is_covered([this, focused_button] {
            if (focused_button)
                focused_button->click();
            else
                use_whole_frame();
        });
        return;
    }
    case Qt::Key_Escape:
        dismiss();
        return;
    default:
        QWidget::keyPressEvent(event);
    }
}

// Tab moves between the selection and its buttons, and stays within the overlay rather than reaching the page or the
// review behind it.
bool ScreenshotSelectionOverlay::focusNextPrevChild(bool next)
{
    cover_page();

    Vector<QWidget*> stops { this };
    for (auto* button : m_buttons)
        stops.append(button);

    auto index = stops.find_first_index(QApplication::focusWidget()).value_or(0);
    index = next ? (index + 1) % stops.size() : (index + stops.size() - 1) % stops.size();
    stops[index]->setFocus(next ? Qt::TabFocusReason : Qt::BacktabFocusReason);
    return true;
}

void ScreenshotSelectionOverlay::changeEvent(QEvent* event)
{
    if (event->type() == QEvent::PaletteChange)
        update_chrome_style();
    QWidget::changeEvent(event);
}

void ScreenshotSelectionOverlay::update_chrome_style()
{
    m_instructions->setStyleSheet(ChromeStyle::screenshot_selection_style_sheet(palette()));
    m_close_button->setIcon(create_chrome_icon(ChromeIcon::Close, palette()));
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/kmalloc.h>

#include <QDeadlineTimer>
#include <QImage>
#include <QPoint>
#include <QRect>
#include <QWidget>

class QPushButton;
class QTimer;

namespace Ladybird {

class ScreenshotSelectionOverlay final : public QWidget {
public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    static constexpr int minimum_selection_size = 8;

    enum class Purpose {
        ReportIssue,
        SaveScreenshot,
    };

    ScreenshotSelectionOverlay(QImage frame, QWidget* parent, Purpose = Purpose::ReportIssue);

    void select(QRect);
    void use_whole_frame();
    void use_full_page();
    void skip();
    void dismiss();

    bool reveals_page() const { return m_reveals_page; }
    void page_did_scroll();
    void page_did_paint();

    Function<void()> on_close;
    Function<void(QImage)> on_finished;
    Function<void()> on_full_page_requested;
    // The frame can arrive later, when the process that holds it sends it.
    Function<void(Function<void(QImage)>)> on_request_page_frame;
    Function<void()> on_page_visibility_change;

protected:
    virtual void paintEvent(QPaintEvent*) override;
    virtual void mousePressEvent(QMouseEvent*) override;
    virtual void mouseMoveEvent(QMouseEvent*) override;
    virtual void mouseReleaseEvent(QMouseEvent*) override;
    virtual void resizeEvent(QResizeEvent*) override;
    virtual void keyPressEvent(QKeyEvent*) override;
    virtual bool focusNextPrevChild(bool next) override;
    virtual void changeEvent(QEvent*) override;
    virtual bool eventFilter(QObject*, QEvent*) override;

private:
    void place_instructions();
    void cover_page();
    void once_page_is_covered(Function<void()>);
    QRect selection() const;
    void finish(QImage);
    void update_chrome_style();

    QImage m_frame;
    bool m_reveals_page { false };
    // Moves on whenever the page scrolls, so a frame that was asked for before then is not taken.
    u64 m_reveal_generation { 0 };
    // What the user asked for while the page was revealed, which takes the frame that covers it.
    Function<void()> m_action_once_page_is_covered;
    QTimer* m_scroll_settle_timer { nullptr };
    QDeadlineTimer m_follow_frames_until;
    Optional<QPoint> m_drag_start;
    QPoint m_drag_end;
    QWidget* m_instructions { nullptr };
    Optional<QPoint> m_instructions_position;
    Optional<QPoint> m_instructions_grab_offset;
    Vector<QPushButton*> m_buttons;
    QPushButton* m_close_button { nullptr };
};
