            .retention_limit = max_closed_units(UnitKind::ClosedTab),
        }));
    }
    append_closed_tab_unit(pending);
    m_transient_storage.prune_closed_units(UnitKind::ClosedTab, max_closed_units(UnitKind::ClosedTab));
    return {};
}

ErrorOr<void> SessionStore::finish_window_close(PendingWindowClose const& pending)
{
    bool any_tab_worth_keeping = false;
    for (auto const& member : pending.members)
        any_tab_worth_keeping |= is_tab_worth_keeping(member.tab.url);

    if (pending.members.is_empty() || !any_tab_worth_keeping) {
        if (m_persisted_storage.has_value())
            TRY(m_persisted_storage->delete_session_rows(pending.window_id));
        return {};
    }

    if (m_persisted_storage.has_value()) {
        ClosedWindowWrite write {
            .unit = {
                .id = pending.window_id,
                .kind = UnitKind::ClosedWindow,
                .closed_at = pending.closed_at,
                .close_sequence = pending.close_sequence,
                .source_window_id = pending.window_id,
                .source_tab_index = {},
                .origin = ClosedSessionUnit::Origin::CloseAction,
                .active_tab_index = min(pending.active_tab_index, index_as_i64(pending.members.size() - 1)),
                .restore_at_launch = pending.restore_at_launch,
            },
            .members = {},
            .retention_limit = max_closed_units(UnitKind::ClosedWindow),
        };
        for (auto const& member : pending.members)
            write.members.append(tab_write_for(member.tab_id, member.tab, 0));
        TRY(m_persisted_storage->close_window(write));
    }
    append_closed_window_unit(pending);
    m_transient_storage.prune_closed_units(UnitKind::ClosedWindow, max_closed_units(UnitKind::ClosedWindow));
    return {};
}

ErrorOr<void> SessionStore::tab_closed(TabClosed closed)
{
    auto const* tab = m_transient_storage.find_tab(closed.tab_id);
    if (!tab)
        return {};

    if (m_quitting) {
        ErrorOr<void> result;
        if (m_persisted_storage.has_value() && tab->dirty)
            result = flush_tab(closed.tab_id, *tab);
        m_transient_storage.remove_tab(closed.tab_id);
        return result;
    }

    Optional<i64> source_tab_index;
    if (auto index = m_transient_storage.tab_index(closed.tab_id); index.has_value()) {
        source_tab_index = index_as_i64(*index);
    }

    auto discard_without_undo = [&]() -> ErrorOr<void> {
        if (!m_persisted_storage.has_value()) {
            m_transient_storage.remove_tab(closed.tab_id);
            return {};
        }
        auto tab_window_id = tab->window_id;
        auto discard_result = drain_window_metadata();
        if (!discard_result.is_error())
            discard_result = m_persisted_storage->discard_tab({ .id = closed.tab_id, .remaining_window = remaining_window_write(tab_window_id, closed.tab_id) });
        if (discard_result.is_error()) {
            PendingTabClose discard {
                .tab_id = closed.tab_id,
                .unit_id = 0,
                .tab = *tab,
                .closed_at = canonicalized_to_milliseconds(closed.closed_at),
                .close_sequence = 0,
                .source_tab_index = source_tab_index,
                .discard = true,
            };
            m_pending_tab_closes.append(move(discard));
        }
        m_transient_storage.remove_tab(closed.tab_id);
        if (discard_result.is_error())
            return discard_result;
        m_transient_storage.mark_window_metadata_clean(tab_window_id);
        return {};
    };

    if (closed.keep_for_reopening == KeepForReopening::No)
        return discard_without_undo();

    auto close_sequence = m_close_sequence_allocator.allocate();
    if (close_sequence.is_error()) {
        auto result = discard_without_undo();
        if (WebView::history_debug_enabled())
            dbgln("[History] Tab closed without undo: {}", close_sequence.error());
        return result;
    }

    // Closes must retire the transient tab even when no unit id is allocatable for the demotion, and
    // the closed tab's rows must be discarded so startup recovery cannot resurrect it.
    auto unit_id = m_session_id_allocator.allocate();
    if (unit_id.is_error()) {
        auto result = discard_without_undo();
        if (WebView::history_debug_enabled())
            dbgln("[History] Tab closed without undo: {}", unit_id.error());
        return result;
    }

    PendingTabClose close {
        .tab_id = closed.tab_id,
        .unit_id = unit_id.value(),
        .tab = *tab,
        .closed_at = canonicalized_to_milliseconds(closed.closed_at),
        .close_sequence = close_sequence.value(),
        .source_tab_index = source_tab_index,
        .discard = false,
    };
    auto window_id = close.tab.window_id;

    auto result = drain_window_metadata();
    if (!result.is_error())
        result = finish_tab_close(close);
    if (result.is_error() && m_persisted_storage.has_value()) {
        // A clean tab's only snapshot is its rows; reads can still work while writes fail, so
        // rescue it rather than let the retry depend on the rows surviving.
        if (!close.tab.dirty) {
            if (auto snapshot = m_persisted_storage->load_tab_snapshot(closed.tab_id, close.tab.current_used_step_index); !snapshot.is_error()) {
                close.tab.history = snapshot.release_value();
                close.tab.dirty = true;
            }
        }
        m_pending_tab_closes.append(move(close));
    }

    m_transient_storage.remove_tab(closed.tab_id);
    if (!result.is_error() && m_persisted_storage.has_value())
        m_transient_storage.mark_window_metadata_clean(window_id);
    return result;
}

void SessionStore::tab_detached(SessionTabId tab_id)
{
    auto const* tab = m_transient_storage.find_tab(tab_id);
    if (!tab)
        return;

    if (!m_persisted_storage.has_value()) {
        m_transient_storage.remove_tab(tab_id);
        return;
    }

    auto window_id = tab->window_id;
    auto result = drain_window_metadata();
    if (!result.is_error())
        result = m_persisted_storage->discard_tab({ .id = tab_id, .remaining_window = remaining_window_write(window_id, tab_id) });
    if (result.is_error()) {
        PendingTabClose discard {
            .tab_id = tab_id,
            .unit_id = 0,
            .tab = *tab,
            .closed_at = canonicalized_to_milliseconds(UnixDateTime::now()),
            .source_tab_index = {},
            .discard = true,
        };
        m_pending_tab_closes.append(move(discard));
    }

    m_transient_storage.remove_tab(tab_id);
    if (!result.is_error())
        m_transient_storage.mark_window_metadata_clean(window_id);
}

ErrorOr<void> SessionStore::window_closing(WindowClosing closing)
{
    auto const* window = m_transient_storage.find_window(closing.window_id);
    if (!window)
        return {};

    if (m_quitting) {
        if (m_persisted_storage.has_value()) {
            for (auto member_id : window->tabs) {
                if (auto const* tab = m_transient_storage.find_tab(member_id); tab && tab->dirty)
                    TRY(flush_tab(member_id, *tab));
            }
            if (window->metadata_dirty)
                m_retired_window_metadata.append(window_metadata_write(closing.window_id, *window));
        }
        m_transient_storage.remove_window(closing.window_id);
        return {};
    }

    auto closed_at = canonicalized_to_milliseconds(closing.closed_at);
    closing.active_tab_index = max(closing.active_tab_index, 0);

    // The last window closing counts as left open, until another window opens.
    auto restore_at_launch = m_transient_storage.window_count() == 1;

    auto make_pending_close = [&](SessionCloseSequence close_sequence, bool discard) {
        PendingWindowClose close {
            .window_id = closing.window_id,
            .members = {},
            .active_tab_index = closing.active_tab_index,
            .closed_at = closed_at,
            .close_sequence = close_sequence,
            .discard = discard,
            .restore_at_launch = restore_at_launch,
            .activation_sequence = window->activation_sequence,
            .geometry = window->geometry,
        };
        for (auto member_id : window->tabs) {
            if (auto const* tab = m_transient_storage.find_tab(member_id))
                close.members.append({ .tab_id = member_id, .unit_id = 0, .tab = *tab, .closed_at = closed_at, .source_tab_index = {}, .discard = false });
        }
        return close;
    };

    auto close_sequence = m_close_sequence_allocator.allocate();
    if (close_sequence.is_error()) {
        auto close = make_pending_close(0, true);
        ErrorOr<void> result;
        if (m_persisted_storage.has_value())
            result = m_persisted_storage->delete_session_rows(closing.window_id);
        if (result.is_error() && m_persisted_storage.has_value()) {
            if (window->metadata_dirty)
                m_retired_window_metadata.append(window_metadata_write(closing.window_id, *window));
            m_pending_window_closes.append(move(close));
        }
        m_transient_storage.remove_window(closing.window_id);
        if (WebView::history_debug_enabled())
            dbgln("[History] Window closed without undo: {}", close_sequence.error());
        return result;
    }

    // Resolve pending child closes before changing the window unit's kind.
    bool topology_is_current = true;
    if (m_persisted_storage.has_value()) {
        topology_is_current = !drain_window_metadata().is_error();
        if (topology_is_current) {
            for (size_t i = 0; i < m_pending_tab_closes.size();) {
                auto const& pending = m_pending_tab_closes[i];
                if (pending.tab.window_id != closing.window_id) {
                    ++i;
                    continue;
                }
                ErrorOr<void> result;
                if (pending.discard)
                    result = m_persisted_storage->discard_tab({ .id = pending.tab_id, .remaining_window = remaining_window_write(closing.window_id, pending.tab_id) });
                else
                    result = finish_tab_close(pending);
                if (result.is_error())
                    ++i;
                else
                    m_pending_tab_closes.remove(i);
            }
        }
    }

    auto close = make_pending_close(close_sequence.value(), false);

    ErrorOr<void> result;
    bool queue_close = m_persisted_storage.has_value() && (!topology_is_current || window_has_pending_tab_closes(closing.window_id));
    if (!queue_close) {
        result = finish_window_close(close);
        queue_close = result.is_error() && m_persisted_storage.has_value();
    }
    if (queue_close) {
        // A retired window leaves the drain's reach; carry its stale topology until a drain commits.
        if (window->metadata_dirty)
            m_retired_window_metadata.append(window_metadata_write(closing.window_id, *window));
        m_pending_window_closes.append(move(close));
    }
    m_transient_storage.remove_window(closing.window_id);
    return result;
}

void SessionStore::application_quitting()
{
    m_quitting = true;
    flush_dirty_state();
}

void SessionStore::application_quit_aborted()
{
    m_quitting = false;
}

// A run that the next launch doesn't bring back whole leaves nothing of itself on disk but the pinned tabs.
void SessionStore::mark_clean_exit(AfterExit after_exit)
{
    m_consecutive_unclean_exits = 0;
    if (!m_persisted_storage.has_value())
        return;
    if (after_exit == AfterExit::KeepPinnedTabs) {
        // Which tabs are pinned has to be on disk first, or a tab that was pinned since the last write would go too.
        if (auto result = drain_window_metadata(); result.is_error())
            dbgln("Unable to save which tabs are pinned, so the session stays in the session store: {}", result.error());
        else if (auto result = discard_pending_closes(); result.is_error())
            dbgln("Unable to remove what was closed, so the session stays in the session store: {}", result.error());
        else if (auto result = m_persisted_storage->forget_all_but_pinned_tabs(); result.is_error())
            dbgln("Unable to remove the session from the session store: {}", result.error());
    }
    if (auto result = m_persisted_storage->write_lifecycle(true, 0, after_exit == AfterExit::Restart); result.is_error())
        dbgln("Unable to record a clean exit in the session store: {}", result.error());
}

// A close that failed to write leaves what it closed among the open windows and tabs, where a pinned tab would be kept,
// and would write it back once it is tried again. Nothing closed is kept, so such a close removes its rows instead. Only
// the window that the next launch brings back is written as it was closed, since its pending close alone holds the latest
// state of its tabs, unless deleting browsing data took it.
ErrorOr<void> SessionStore::discard_pending_closes()
{
    for (auto const& pending : m_pending_tab_closes)
        TRY(m_persisted_storage->discard_tab({ .id = pending.tab_id, .remaining_window = remaining_window_write(pending.tab.window_id, pending.tab_id) }));
    m_pending_tab_closes.clear();

    for (auto const& pending : m_pending_window_closes) {
        if (pending.discard || !pending.restore_at_launch)
            TRY(m_persisted_storage->delete_session_rows(pending.window_id));
        else
            TRY(finish_window_close(pending));
    }
    m_pending_window_closes.clear();
    return {};
}

bool SessionStore::has_closed_units() const
{
    return m_transient_storage.has_closed_units();
}

Vector<RestoredSessionWindow> SessionStore::take_launch_plan()
{
    return move(m_launch_plan);
}

Optional<WebView::SessionHistorySnapshot> SessionStore::load_tab_history(SessionTabId tab_id)
{
    auto const* tab = m_transient_storage.find_tab(tab_id);
    if (!tab)
        return {};
    if (tab->dirty || !m_persisted_storage.has_value())
        return tab->history;

    auto snapshot = m_persisted_storage->load_tab_snapshot(tab_id, tab->current_used_step_index);
    if (snapshot.is_error()) {
        if (WebView::history_debug_enabled())
            dbgln("[History] Failed to load tab {} history: {}", tab_id, snapshot.error());
        return {};
    }
    return snapshot.release_value();
}

ErrorOr<Optional<ClosedSessionUnit>> SessionStore::take_most_recently_closed()
{
    auto const& closed_units = m_transient_storage.closed_units();
    if (closed_units.is_empty())
        return Optional<ClosedSessionUnit> {};
    return take_closed_unit(closed_units.last().session_id);
}

Vector<RecentlyClosedSessionUnit> SessionStore::recently_closed_units(size_t limit) const
{
    Vector<RecentlyClosedSessionUnit> units;
    auto const& closed_units = m_transient_storage.closed_units();
    for (size_t i = closed_units.size(); i > 0 && units.size() < limit; --i) {
        auto const& unit = closed_units[i - 1];
        if (unit.tabs.is_empty())
            continue;
        auto active_tab_index = clamp(unit.active_tab_index, 0, index_as_i64(unit.tabs.size() - 1));
        units.append({
            .id = unit.session_id,
            .active_url = unit.tabs[active_tab_index].active_url,
            .tab_count = unit.tabs.size(),
            .was_window = unit.kind == UnitKind::ClosedWindow,
            .from_startup_recovery = unit.origin == ClosedSessionUnit::Origin::StartupRecovery,
            .closed_at = unit.closed_time,
        });
    }
    return units;
}

ErrorOr<Optional<ClosedSessionUnit>> SessionStore::take_closed_unit(SessionWindowId unit_id)
{
    auto unit = m_transient_storage.closed_units().first_matching([&](auto const& unit) { return unit.session_id == unit_id; });
    if (!unit.has_value())
        return Optional<ClosedSessionUnit> {};

    ClosedSessionUnit result {
        .tabs = {},
        .active_tab_index = unit->active_tab_index,
        .was_window = unit->kind == UnitKind::ClosedWindow,
        .source_window_id = unit->source_window_id,
        .source_tab_index = unit->source_tab_index,
        .origin = unit->origin,
        .geometry = unit->geometry,
    };

    if (m_persisted_storage.has_value()) {
        result.tabs = TRY(m_persisted_storage->take_closed_unit(unit_id));
        (void)m_transient_storage.take_closed_unit(unit_id);
    } else {
        auto taken = m_transient_storage.take_closed_unit(unit_id).release_value();
        for (auto& tab : taken.tabs)
            result.tabs.append({ .active_url = move(tab.active_url), .history = move(tab.history), .pinned = tab.pinned });
    }

    if (result.tabs.is_empty())
        return Optional<ClosedSessionUnit> {};
    result.active_tab_index = min(result.active_tab_index, index_as_i64(result.tabs.size() - 1));
    return Optional<ClosedSessionUnit> { move(result) };
}

ErrorOr<void> SessionStore::remove_entries_accessed_since(UnixDateTime since)
{
    auto closed_units = m_transient_storage.remove_closed_units_since(since);

    if (!m_persisted_storage.has_value()) {
        m_pending_tab_closes.remove_all_matching([&](auto const& pending) { return pending.closed_at >= since; });
        m_pending_window_closes.remove_all_matching([&](auto const& pending) { return pending.closed_at >= since; });
        return {};
    }

    if (!m_pending_clear_closed_units.has_value())
        m_pending_clear_closed_units = PendingClearClosedUnits {};
    auto& pending_clear = *m_pending_clear_closed_units;
    for (auto closed_unit : closed_units) {
        if (!pending_clear.closed_units.contains_slow(closed_unit))
            pending_clear.closed_units.append(closed_unit);
    }

    // Convert matching pending closes into deletion retries.
    for (auto& pending : m_pending_tab_closes) {
        if (pending.closed_at < since)
            continue;
        pending.discard = true;
        if (!pending_clear.pending_tabs.contains_slow(pending.tab_id))
            pending_clear.pending_tabs.append(pending.tab_id);
    }
    for (auto& pending : m_pending_window_closes) {
        if (pending.closed_at < since)
            continue;
        pending.discard = true;
        if (!pending_clear.pending_windows.contains_slow(pending.window_id))
            pending_clear.pending_windows.append(pending.window_id);
    }

    return retry_pending_clear_closed_units();
}

ErrorOr<void> SessionStore::retry_pending_clear_closed_units()
{
    VERIFY(m_persisted_storage.has_value());
    VERIFY(m_pending_clear_closed_units.has_value());

    auto const& pending_clear = *m_pending_clear_closed_units;
    ClearClosedUnitsWrite write { .closed_units = pending_clear.closed_units, .pending_tabs = {}, .pending_windows = {} };
    for (auto const& pending : m_pending_tab_closes) {
        if (pending_clear.pending_tabs.contains_slow(pending.tab_id))
            write.pending_tabs.append({ .id = pending.tab_id, .remaining_window = remaining_window_write(pending.tab.window_id, pending.tab_id) });
    }
    for (auto const& pending : m_pending_window_closes) {
        if (pending_clear.pending_windows.contains_slow(pending.window_id))
            write.pending_windows.append(pending.window_id);
    }

    TRY(drain_window_metadata());
    TRY(m_persisted_storage->clear_closed_units(write));

    m_pending_tab_closes.remove_all_matching([&](auto const& pending) { return pending_clear.pending_tabs.contains_slow(pending.tab_id); });
    m_pending_window_closes.remove_all_matching([&](auto const& pending) { return pending_clear.pending_windows.contains_slow(pending.window_id); });
    m_pending_clear_closed_units.clear();
    return {};
}

void SessionStore::flush_dirty_state()
{
    if (!m_persisted_storage.has_value())
        return;

    if (m_pending_clear_closed_units.has_value())
        (void)retry_pending_clear_closed_units();

    // Pending retries rewrite ordinals, so they only run once the persisted topology is current.
    bool any_close_completed = false;
    if (!drain_window_metadata().is_error()) {
        for (size_t i = 0; i < m_pending_tab_closes.size();) {
            auto const& pending = m_pending_tab_closes[i];
            ErrorOr<void> result;
            if (pending.discard) {
                result = m_persisted_storage->discard_tab({ .id = pending.tab_id, .remaining_window = remaining_window_write(pending.tab.window_id, pending.tab_id) });
            } else {
                result = finish_tab_close(pending);
                if (!result.is_error())
                    any_close_completed = true;
            }
            if (result.is_error())
                ++i;
            else
                m_pending_tab_closes.remove(i);
        }

        for (size_t i = 0; i < m_pending_window_closes.size();) {
            auto const& pending = m_pending_window_closes[i];
            // The persisted unit must stay open until every pending child row has left it.
            if (!pending.discard && window_has_pending_tab_closes(pending.window_id)) {
                ++i;
                continue;
            }
            ErrorOr<void> result;
            if (pending.discard) {
                result = m_persisted_storage->delete_session_rows(pending.window_id);
            } else {
                result = finish_window_close(pending);
                if (!result.is_error())
                    any_close_completed = true;
            }
            if (result.is_error())
                ++i;
            else
                m_pending_window_closes.remove(i);
        }
    }

    Vector<SessionTabId> dirty_tabs;
    m_transient_storage.for_each_tab([&](auto tab_id, auto const& tab) {
        if (tab.dirty)
            dirty_tabs.append(tab_id);
    });
    for (auto tab_id : dirty_tabs) {
        if (auto const* tab = m_transient_storage.find_tab(tab_id))
            (void)flush_tab(tab_id, *tab);
    }

    if (any_close_completed && on_closed_units_changed)
        on_closed_units_changed();
}

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/Error.h>
#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/NonnullOwnPtr.h>
#include <AK/Optional.h>
#include <AK/RefPtr.h>
#include <AK/Time.h>
#include <AK/Vector.h>
#include <LibCore/Timer.h>
#include <LibDatabase/Database.h>
#include <LibURL/URL.h>
#include <LibWebView/SessionHistory.h>
#include <UI/Qt/SessionHistorySnapshotStorage.h>

namespace Ladybird {

using SessionWindowId = i64;
using SessionTabId = i64;
using SessionCloseSequence = i64;

// A window's normal (not maximized) geometry, plus whether it's maximized.
struct SessionWindowGeometry {
    i32 x { 0 };
    i32 y { 0 };
    i32 width { 0 };
    i32 height { 0 };
    bool maximized { false };

    bool operator==(SessionWindowGeometry const&) const = default;
};

struct ClosedSessionTab {
    URL::URL active_url;
    Optional<WebView::SessionHistorySnapshot> history;
    bool pinned { false };
};

struct ClosedSessionUnit {
    enum class Origin : i64 {
        CloseAction = 0,
        StartupRecovery = 1,
    };

    Vector<ClosedSessionTab> tabs;
    i64 active_tab_index { 0 };
    bool was_window { false };
    Optional<SessionWindowId> source_window_id;
    Optional<i64> source_tab_index;
    Origin origin { Origin::CloseAction };
    Optional<SessionWindowGeometry> geometry;
};

// A closed tab or window as a list of them shows it: the page its active tab was on, and when it closed.
struct RecentlyClosedSessionUnit {
    SessionWindowId id { 0 };
    URL::URL active_url;
    size_t tab_count { 0 };
    bool was_window { false };
    // Left open by the last run, which ended without closing it, rather than closed by the user.
    bool from_startup_recovery { false };
    UnixDateTime closed_at;
};

// What startup recovery does with the windows the last run left open.
enum class SessionLaunchPolicy : u8 {
    // Every leftover window becomes a closed unit on the Reopen Closed Window stack.
    None,
    // Each leftover window's pinned tabs come back in a window of their own, and the rest becomes a closed unit.
    PinnedOnly,
    // Every leftover window comes back whole.
    Everything,
};

struct RestoredSessionTab {
    SessionTabId tab_id { 0 };
    URL::URL url;
    bool pinned { false };
};

// A window that startup recovery kept open for the frontend to show, with its tabs in order.
struct RestoredSessionWindow {
    SessionWindowId window_id { 0 };
    Vector<RestoredSessionTab> tabs;
    i64 active_tab_index { 0 };
    Optional<SessionWindowGeometry> geometry;
};

// Persists live windows and tabs plus a bounded recently-closed stack. State updates coalesce; lifecycle mutations
// write through. At startup, recovery hands the windows the last run left open to the frontend, or to the closed stack,
// as its launch policy says.
class SessionStore {
    AK_MAKE_NONCOPYABLE(SessionStore);
    AK_MAKE_NONMOVABLE(SessionStore);

public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    enum class IsActive {
        No,
        Yes,
    };

    struct TabOpened {
        Optional<SessionWindowId> window_id;
        URL::URL initial_url;
        Optional<i64> insertion_index;
        IsActive is_active { IsActive::No };
    };

    struct TabStateUpdate {
        SessionTabId tab_id { 0 };
        Optional<WebView::SessionHistorySnapshot> history;
        URL::URL url;
    };

    enum class KeepForReopening : u8 {
        No,
        Yes,
    };

    struct TabClosed {
        SessionTabId tab_id { 0 };
        UnixDateTime closed_at;
        KeepForReopening keep_for_reopening { KeepForReopening::Yes };
    };

    struct TabMoved {
        SessionTabId tab_id { 0 };
        SessionWindowId new_window_id { 0 };
        i64 ordinal { 0 };
    };

    struct TabOrderChanged {
        SessionWindowId window_id { 0 };
        Vector<SessionTabId> ordered_tabs;
    };

    struct WindowClosing {
        SessionWindowId window_id { 0 };
        i64 active_tab_index { 0 };
        UnixDateTime closed_at;
    };

    static ErrorOr<Database::MigrationOutcome> migrate_schema(Database::Database&, Database::MigrationMode = Database::MigrationMode::Apply);

    static ErrorOr<NonnullOwnPtr<SessionStore>> create(Database::Database&, SessionLaunchPolicy = SessionLaunchPolicy::None);
    static NonnullOwnPtr<SessionStore> create();

    ~SessionStore();

    ErrorOr<SessionWindowId> window_opened();
    ErrorOr<void> window_closing(WindowClosing);
    void window_detached(SessionWindowId);
    void window_activated(SessionWindowId);
    void window_geometry_changed(SessionWindowId, SessionWindowGeometry);
    ErrorOr<SessionTabId> tab_opened(TabOpened);
    void update_tab_state(TabStateUpdate);
    ErrorOr<void> tab_closed(TabClosed);
    void tab_detached(SessionTabId);
    void tab_moved(TabMoved);
    void tab_order_changed(TabOrderChanged);

    // A pin moves the tab into or out of the pinned tabs at the start of its window, so it's written at once, together
    // with the window's tab order: Launch restore depends on both. And a write that fails leaves the window's metadata
    // dirty, for the next flush to retry.
    ErrorOr<void> tab_pinned_changed(SessionTabId, bool pinned);
    void active_tab_changed(SessionTabId);
    void application_quitting();
    void application_quit_aborted();

    // How many runs in a row, ending with the one before this, ended without mark_clean_exit().
    u32 consecutive_unclean_exits() const { return m_consecutive_unclean_exits; }
    bool follows_restart() const { return m_follows_restart; }

    enum class AfterExit : u8 {
        KeepEverything,
        KeepPinnedTabs,
        Restart,
    };
    // Records that this run is ending normally. Only a normal teardown calls it, so a crash never records one.
    void mark_clean_exit(AfterExit = AfterExit::KeepEverything);

    bool is_persistent() const { return m_persisted_storage.has_value(); }

    bool has_closed_units() const;
    ErrorOr<Optional<ClosedSessionUnit>> take_most_recently_closed();
    // The closed units, most recently closed first.
    Vector<RecentlyClosedSessionUnit> recently_closed_units(size_t limit) const;
    ErrorOr<Optional<ClosedSessionUnit>> take_closed_unit(SessionWindowId);
    ErrorOr<void> remove_entries_accessed_since(UnixDateTime);

    // The windows startup recovery kept open, in activation order with the frontmost last. It's handed over once.
    Vector<RestoredSessionWindow> take_launch_plan();

    // A tab's history: the store's own copy if it holds a newer one than the tab's rows, and otherwise the rows'.
    Optional<WebView::SessionHistorySnapshot> load_tab_history(SessionTabId);

    void flush_dirty_state();

    // Fired when a flush completes a previously failed close.
    Function<void()> on_closed_units_changed;

private:
    // Monotonic within one serialized writer.
    class IdAllocator {
    public:
        explicit IdAllocator(i64 last_used = 0)
            : m_last_used(last_used)
        {
        }

        // The statement must yield one row whose first column is the INTEGER maximum id in use, or
        // NULL when no rows exist.
        static ErrorOr<IdAllocator> create_from_maximum(Database::Database&, Database::StatementID);

        ErrorOr<i64> allocate();

    private:
        i64 m_last_used { 0 };
    };

    struct IdAllocators {
        IdAllocator session_ids;
        IdAllocator tab_ids;
        IdAllocator close_sequences;
        IdAllocator activation_sequences;
    };

    struct Statements {
        Database::StatementID insert_session;
        Database::StatementID insert_tab;
        Database::StatementID insert_tab_if_missing;
        Database::StatementID update_tab_row;
        Database::StatementID update_tab_placement;
        Database::StatementID update_tab_parent;
        Database::StatementID update_session_closed;
        Database::StatementID update_session_metadata;
        Database::StatementID update_session_geometry;
        Database::StatementID delete_session;
        Database::StatementID delete_tab;
        Database::StatementID prune_closed;
        Database::StatementID select_max_session_id;
        Database::StatementID select_max_tab_id;
        Database::StatementID select_max_close_sequence;
        Database::StatementID select_max_activation_sequence;
        Database::StatementID select_closed_sessions;
        Database::StatementID select_session_tabs;
        Database::StatementID select_open_sessions;
        Database::StatementID select_restore_at_launch_session;
        Database::StatementID clear_restore_at_launch;
        Database::StatementID clear_startup_recovery_origin;
        Database::StatementID reopen_closed_session;
        Database::StatementID recover_open_session;
        Database::StatementID delete_empty_open_sessions;
        Database::StatementID delete_closed_units_left_closed;
        Database::StatementID delete_unpinned_tabs;
        Database::StatementID delete_empty_sessions;
        Database::StatementID select_lifecycle;
        Database::StatementID write_lifecycle;
        SessionHistorySnapshotStatements snapshot_statements;
    };

    enum class UnitKind : i64 {
        OpenWindow = 0,
        ClosedTab = 1,
        ClosedWindow = 2,
    };

    struct OpenTab {
        SessionWindowId window_id { 0 };
        URL::URL url;
        size_t current_used_step_index { 0 };
        // The pending flush payload in persisted mode, dropped once flushed; the storage itself in
        // transient mode.
        Optional<WebView::SessionHistorySnapshot> history;
        bool dirty { false };
        bool pinned { false };
    };

    struct OpenWindow {
        Vector<SessionTabId> tabs;
        SessionTabId active_tab { 0 };
        bool metadata_dirty { false };
        i64 activation_sequence { 0 };
        Optional<SessionWindowGeometry> geometry;
    };

    struct ClosedTab {
        URL::URL active_url;
        i64 tab_id { 0 };
        size_t current_used_step_index { 0 };
        // Transient mode captures the snapshot at demotion; persisted mode loads it on reopen.
        Optional<WebView::SessionHistorySnapshot> history;
        bool pinned { false };
    };

    struct ClosedUnit {
        i64 session_id { 0 };
        UnitKind kind { UnitKind::ClosedTab };
        UnixDateTime closed_time;
        SessionCloseSequence close_sequence { 0 };
        i64 active_tab_index { 0 };
        Optional<SessionWindowId> source_window_id;
        Optional<i64> source_tab_index;
        ClosedSessionUnit::Origin origin { ClosedSessionUnit::Origin::CloseAction };
        Vector<ClosedTab> tabs;
        Optional<SessionWindowGeometry> geometry;
    };

    enum class SnapshotDisposition {
        Preserve,
        Replace,
        Clear,
    };

    struct TabWrite {
        SessionTabId id { 0 };
        SessionWindowId window_id { 0 };
        i64 tab_ordinal { 0 };
        URL::URL url;
        i64 current_used_step_index { 0 };
        SnapshotDisposition snapshot_disposition { SnapshotDisposition::Preserve };
        WebView::SessionHistorySnapshot const* snapshot { nullptr };
        bool pinned { false };
    };

    // Always the complete live-plus-pending order, so persisted units stay contiguous while failed
    // closes await their retry.
    struct WindowMetadataWrite {
        SessionWindowId id { 0 };
        Vector<SessionTabId> tabs_in_order;
        HashTable<SessionTabId> pinned_tabs;
        i64 active_tab_index { 0 };
        i64 activation_sequence { 0 };
        Optional<SessionWindowGeometry> geometry;
    };

    struct OpenTabWrite {
        TabWrite tab;
        WindowMetadataWrite window;
    };

    struct ClosedUnitWrite {
        SessionWindowId id { 0 };
        UnitKind kind { UnitKind::ClosedTab };
        UnixDateTime closed_at;
        SessionCloseSequence close_sequence { 0 };
        Optional<SessionWindowId> source_window_id;
        Optional<i64> source_tab_index;
        ClosedSessionUnit::Origin origin { ClosedSessionUnit::Origin::CloseAction };
        i64 active_tab_index { 0 };
        bool restore_at_launch { false };
    };

    struct ClosedTabWrite {
        ClosedUnitWrite unit;
        TabWrite tab;
        Optional<WindowMetadataWrite> remaining_window;
        u32 retention_limit { 0 };
    };

    struct ClosedWindowWrite {
        ClosedUnitWrite unit;
        Vector<TabWrite> members;
        u32 retention_limit { 0 };
    };

    struct DiscardTabWrite {
        SessionTabId id { 0 };
        Optional<WindowMetadataWrite> remaining_window;
    };

    struct ClearClosedUnitsWrite {
        Vector<SessionWindowId> closed_units;
        Vector<DiscardTabWrite> pending_tabs;
        Vector<SessionWindowId> pending_windows;
    };

    // Retain the exact targets until the clear transaction commits. Reapplying a timestamp cutoff
    // would also delete units closed after the user initiated the clear.
    struct PendingClearClosedUnits {
        Vector<SessionWindowId> closed_units;
        Vector<SessionTabId> pending_tabs;
        Vector<SessionWindowId> pending_windows;
    };

    struct RecoveryWrite {
        UnixDateTime recovered_at;
        u32 closed_tab_limit { 0 };
        u32 closed_window_limit { 0 };
        SessionLaunchPolicy policy { SessionLaunchPolicy::None };
    };

    struct RecoveredTab {
        SessionTabId id { 0 };
        i64 ordinal { 0 };
        URL::URL url;
        size_t current_used_step_index { 0 };
        bool pinned { false };
    };

    struct RecoveredWindow {
        SessionWindowId id { 0 };
        Vector<RecoveredTab> tabs;
        i64 active_tab_index { 0 };
        i64 activation_sequence { 0 };
        Optional<SessionWindowGeometry> geometry;
    };

    struct RecoveryResult {
        u32 consecutive_unclean_exits { 0 };
        bool follows_restart { false };
        Vector<RecoveredWindow> windows;
    };

    // Applies mutations atomically while preserving persisted row invariants.
    struct PersistedStorage {
        static ErrorOr<Database::MigrationOutcome> migrate_schema(Database::Database&, Database::MigrationMode);
        static ErrorOr<PersistedStorage> create(Database::Database&);

        ErrorOr<void> insert_open_window(SessionWindowId);
        ErrorOr<void> open_tab(OpenTabWrite const&);
        ErrorOr<void> flush_tab(TabWrite const&);
        ErrorOr<void> write_windows_metadata(Vector<WindowMetadataWrite> const&);
        ErrorOr<void> close_tab(ClosedTabWrite const&);
        ErrorOr<void> close_window(ClosedWindowWrite const&);
        ErrorOr<void> discard_tab(DiscardTabWrite const&);
        ErrorOr<void> clear_closed_units(ClearClosedUnitsWrite const&);
        ErrorOr<RecoveryResult> recover_open_windows(RecoveryWrite const&, IdAllocator& session_id_allocator, IdAllocator& close_sequence_allocator);
        ErrorOr<void> clear_restore_at_launch();
        ErrorOr<void> clear_startup_recovery_origin();
        ErrorOr<void> delete_session_rows(SessionWindowId);
        ErrorOr<void> prune_closed_units(UnitKind, u32 max_units);
        ErrorOr<void> write_lifecycle(bool clean_exit, u32 consecutive_unclean_exits, bool restart = false);
        ErrorOr<void> forget_all_but_pinned_tabs();

        ErrorOr<IdAllocators> create_id_allocators();
        ErrorOr<WebView::SessionHistorySnapshot> load_tab_snapshot(SessionTabId, size_t current_used_step_index);
        ErrorOr<Vector<ClosedUnit>> load_closed_units();
        ErrorOr<Vector<ClosedSessionTab>> take_closed_unit(SessionWindowId);

        NonnullRefPtr<Database::Database> database;
        Statements statements;

    private:
        struct RunStart {
            u32 consecutive_unclean_exits { 0 };
            bool follows_restart { false };
        };
        ErrorOr<RunStart> record_run_start();
        ErrorOr<void> apply_tab_row_write(TabWrite const&);
        ErrorOr<void> apply_window_metadata(WindowMetadataWrite const&);
        ErrorOr<void> insert_closed_unit_row(ClosedUnitWrite const&);
        ErrorOr<void> delete_tab_rows(SessionTabId);
        ErrorOr<Vector<RecoveredTab>> read_recovered_tabs(SessionWindowId);
        ErrorOr<void> reparent_tabs(SessionWindowId, Vector<RecoveredTab> const&);
        ErrorOr<void> write_session_metadata(SessionWindowId, i64 active_tab_index, i64 activation_sequence);
        ErrorOr<void> write_session_geometry(SessionWindowId, SessionWindowGeometry const&);
        ErrorOr<void> demote_to_startup_recovery_unit(SessionWindowId, UnixDateTime recovered_at, IdAllocator& close_sequence_allocator);
        ErrorOr<void> reopen_session(SessionWindowId);
    };

    // A close whose database write failed; the frontend tab or window is already gone, so the
    // demotion retries from these copies instead of holding the unit open.
    struct PendingTabClose {
        SessionTabId tab_id { 0 };
        i64 unit_id { 0 };
        OpenTab tab;
        UnixDateTime closed_at;
        SessionCloseSequence close_sequence { 0 };
        Optional<i64> source_tab_index;
        bool discard { false };
    };

    struct PendingWindowClose {
        SessionWindowId window_id { 0 };
        Vector<PendingTabClose> members;
        i64 active_tab_index { 0 };
        UnixDateTime closed_at;
        SessionCloseSequence close_sequence { 0 };
        bool discard { false };
        bool restore_at_launch { false };
        i64 activation_sequence { 0 };
        Optional<SessionWindowGeometry> geometry;
    };

    // Owns in-memory membership, ordering, and dirty state.
    class TransientStorage {
    public:
        void open_window(SessionWindowId);
        Optional<size_t> open_tab(SessionWindowId, SessionTabId, OpenTab, Optional<size_t> insertion_index = {});
        OpenTab const* find_tab(SessionTabId) const;
        OpenWindow const* find_window(SessionWindowId) const;
        Optional<size_t> tab_index(SessionTabId) const;
        size_t window_count() const { return m_windows.size(); }

        void set_tab_state(SessionTabId, Optional<WebView::SessionHistorySnapshot>, URL::URL, bool dirty);
        bool set_tab_pinned(SessionTabId, bool pinned);
        void mark_tab_flushed(SessionTabId, size_t current_used_step_index);
        void set_active_tab(SessionTabId);
        void set_activation_sequence(SessionWindowId, i64);
        void set_geometry(SessionWindowId, SessionWindowGeometry);
        void set_tab_order(SessionWindowId, Vector<SessionTabId> const&);
        Optional<SessionWindowId> move_tab(SessionTabId, SessionWindowId, size_t ordinal);
        void remove_tab(SessionTabId);
        void remove_window(SessionWindowId);
        void mark_window_metadata_clean(SessionWindowId);

        template<typename Callback>
        void for_each_window(Callback callback) const
        {
            for (auto const& it : m_windows)
                callback(it.key, it.value);
        }

        template<typename Callback>
        void for_each_tab(Callback callback) const
        {
            for (auto const& it : m_tabs)
                callback(it.key, it.value);
        }

        bool has_closed_units() const { return !m_closed_units.is_empty(); }
        void set_closed_units(Vector<ClosedUnit>);
        void append_closed_unit(ClosedUnit);
        Vector<ClosedUnit> const& closed_units() const { return m_closed_units; }
        Optional<ClosedUnit> take_closed_unit(SessionWindowId);
        void prune_closed_units(UnitKind, u32 max_units);
        Vector<SessionWindowId> remove_closed_units_since(UnixDateTime);

        Optional<SessionWindowId> default_window;

    private:
        HashMap<SessionWindowId, OpenWindow> m_windows;
        HashMap<SessionTabId, OpenTab> m_tabs;

        // Oldest first by close sequence; reopen consumes from the back.
        Vector<ClosedUnit> m_closed_units;
    };

    explicit SessionStore(Optional<PersistedStorage>);

    ErrorOr<void> run_startup_recovery(UnixDateTime recovered_at, SessionLaunchPolicy);
    ErrorOr<void> flush_tab(SessionTabId, OpenTab const&);
    ErrorOr<void> drain_window_metadata();
    WindowMetadataWrite window_metadata_write(SessionWindowId, OpenWindow const&) const;
    Optional<WindowMetadataWrite> remaining_window_write(SessionWindowId, SessionTabId closing_tab) const;
    TabWrite tab_write_for(SessionTabId, OpenTab const&, i64 tab_ordinal) const;
    bool window_has_pending_tab_closes(SessionWindowId) const;
    ErrorOr<void> discard_pending_closes();
    ErrorOr<void> finish_tab_close(PendingTabClose const&);
    ErrorOr<void> finish_window_close(PendingWindowClose const&);
    ErrorOr<void> retry_pending_clear_closed_units();
    void append_closed_tab_unit(PendingTabClose const&);
    void append_closed_window_unit(PendingWindowClose const&);
    ErrorOr<SessionWindowId> default_window();
    static bool is_tab_worth_keeping(URL::URL const&);
    static u32 max_closed_units(UnitKind);

    Optional<PersistedStorage> m_persisted_storage;
    TransientStorage m_transient_storage;
    RefPtr<Core::Timer> m_flush_timer;
    Vector<PendingTabClose> m_pending_tab_closes;
    Vector<PendingWindowClose> m_pending_window_closes;
    Optional<PendingClearClosedUnits> m_pending_clear_closed_units;
    Vector<WindowMetadataWrite> m_retired_window_metadata;
    bool m_quitting { false };
    u32 m_consecutive_unclean_exits { 0 };
    bool m_follows_restart { false };
    Vector<RestoredSessionWindow> m_launch_plan;

    IdAllocator m_session_id_allocator;
    IdAllocator m_tab_id_allocator;
    IdAllocator m_close_sequence_allocator;
    IdAllocator m_activation_sequence_allocator;
};

}

FILE: UI/Qt/Shaders/WebContentViewLinux.frag
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#version 450

layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2D web_content_texture;

layout(location = 0) in vec2 texture_coordinates;
layout(location = 0) out vec4 output_color;

void main()
{
    // Force opaque output so the page never blends; only the strips we explicitly clear to transparent (behind
    // hover-expanded vertical tabs) reveal the widgets composited below this window.
    output_color = vec4(texture(web_content_texture, texture_coordinates).rgb, 1.0);
}

FILE: UI/Qt/Shaders/WebContentViewLinux.vert
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#version 450

layout(push_constant) uniform PushConstants {
    vec2 target_size;
    vec2 content_size;
    vec2 source_size;
} push_constants;

layout(location = 0) out vec2 texture_coordinates;

void main()
{
    vec2 unit_positions[4] = vec2[](
        vec2(0.0, 0.0),
        vec2(1.0, 0.0),
        vec2(0.0, 1.0),
        vec2(1.0, 1.0));

    vec2 unit_position = unit_positions[gl_VertexIndex];
    vec2 target_position = unit_position * push_constants.content_size;
    vec2 clip_position = target_position / push_constants.target_size * 2.0 - 1.0;

    gl_Position = vec4(clip_position, 0.0, 1.0);
    texture_coordinates = target_position / push_constants.source_size;
}

#include <UI/Qt/ChromeStyle.h>
#include <UI/Qt/Icon.h>

#include <QSignalBlocker>
#include <QToolButton>

namespace Ladybird {

static constexpr int POPOVER_WIDTH = 344;
static constexpr int ROW_HEIGHT = 36;
static constexpr int BLOCKED_RESOURCE_ROW_HEIGHT = 26;
// NB: The heading of a page without a site leaves its text the card's width less the card's border, the page's and the
//     heading's side margins, and the favicon and the space after it.
static constexpr int NO_SITE_TITLE_WIDTH = POPOVER_WIDTH - 2 * 1 - 2 * 6 - 2 * 10 - 28 - 10;

static void add_separator(QWidget& parent, QVBoxLayout& layout, int top_margin, int bottom_margin)
{
    layout.addSpacing(top_margin);
    auto* separator = new QFrame(&parent);
    separator->setObjectName("LadybirdPopoverSeparator");
    separator->setFixedHeight(1);
    auto* row = new QHBoxLayout;
    row->setContentsMargins(10, 0, 10, 0);
    row->addWidget(separator);
    layout.addLayout(row);
    layout.addSpacing(bottom_margin);
}

static QLabel* create_icon(QWidget& parent)
{
    auto* label = new QLabel(&parent);
    label->setFixedSize(16, 16);
    return label;
}

// A page's favicon for the heading of the popover, or a globe for a page without one.
static QPixmap heading_favicon_pixmap(QIcon const& favicon, qreal device_pixel_ratio)
{
    auto const& icon = favicon.isNull() ? create_chrome_icon(ChromeIcon::Globe, Theme::panel().muted) : favicon;
    return icon.pixmap(QSize(16, 16), device_pixel_ratio);
}

static QPushButton* create_link(QWidget& parent, QString const& text)
{
    auto* link = new QPushButton(text, &parent);
    link->setObjectName("LadybirdPopoverLink");
    link->setCursor(Qt::PointingHandCursor);
    // NB: The platform style lays out a push button by a frame of its own rather than by the button, which would
    //     make it overlap its neighbors.
    link->setAttribute(Qt::WA_LayoutUsesWidgetRect);
    return link;
}

// The popover shows the site, and the settings that apply to it. Its content blocking leads on to what was blocked on
// the page, shown in place of the site until the popover goes back to it.
static QString autoplay_policy_name(Web::HTML::AutoplayPolicy policy)
{
    switch (policy) {
    case Web::HTML::AutoplayPolicy::AllowAudioAndVideo:
        return QStringLiteral("Allow");
    case Web::HTML::AutoplayPolicy::BlockAudio:
        return QStringLiteral("Block audio");
    case Web::HTML::AutoplayPolicy::BlockAudioAndVideo:
        return QStringLiteral("Block");
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

static QString permission_label(Web::Permissions::PermissionName name)
{
    switch (name) {
    case Web::Permissions::PermissionName::Geolocation:
        return QStringLiteral("Location");
    case Web::Permissions::PermissionName::Microphone:
        return QStringLiteral("Microphone");
    case Web::Permissions::PermissionName::Notifications:
        return QStringLiteral("Notifications");
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

static ChromeIcon permission_icon(Web::Permissions::PermissionName name)
{
    switch (name) {
    case Web::Permissions::PermissionName::Geolocation:
        return ChromeIcon::Location;
    case Web::Permissions::PermissionName::Microphone:
        return ChromeIcon::Microphone;
    case Web::Permissions::PermissionName::Notifications:
        return ChromeIcon::Notifications;
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

// The value a permission row shows for the site's decision; a site with none is asked.
static QString permission_decision_name(Optional<WebView::PermissionDecision> decision)
{
    if (!decision.has_value())
        return QStringLiteral("Ask");
    switch (*decision) {
    case WebView::PermissionDecision::Allow:
        return QStringLiteral("Allow");
    case WebView::PermissionDecision::AllowOnce:
        return QStringLiteral("Allow this time");
    case WebView::PermissionDecision::Block:
        return QStringLiteral("Block");
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

static QPushButton* create_value_button(QWidget& parent)
{
    auto* button = new QPushButton(&parent);
    button->setObjectName("LadybirdPopoverValueButton");
    button->setCursor(Qt::PointingHandCursor);
    button->setAttribute(Qt::WA_LayoutUsesWidgetRect);
    // NB: The chevron follows the value.
    button->setLayoutDirection(Qt::RightToLeft);
    button->setIconSize({ 12, 12 });
    return button;
}

SiteSettingsPopover::SiteSettingsPopover(QWidget* parent, WebView::Settings& settings)
    : Popover(parent)
    , WebView::SettingsObserver(settings)
    , m_settings(settings)
{
    setAccessibleName("Site settings");
    card().setObjectName("LadybirdSiteSettingsPopover");
    card().setFixedWidth(POPOVER_WIDTH);

    auto* pages = new QVBoxLayout(&card());
    pages->setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0);
    pages->setSpacing(0);

    // The site.
    m_site_page = new QWidget(&card());
    auto* layout = new QVBoxLayout(m_site_page);
    layout->setContentsMargins(6, 14, 6, 8);
    layout->setSpacing(0);

    auto* heading = new QHBoxLayout;
    heading->setContentsMargins(10, 0, 10, 0);
    heading->setSpacing(10);
    m_favicon = new QLabel(m_site_page);
    m_favicon->setFixedSize(28, 28);
    m_favicon->setAlignment(Qt::AlignCenter);
    m_favicon->setObjectName("LadybirdSiteSettingsFavicon");
    heading->addWidget(m_favicon);
    auto* heading_text = new QVBoxLayout;
    heading_text->setSpacing(2);
    m_host_label = new QLabel(m_site_page);
    m_host_label->setObjectName("LadybirdSiteSettingsHost");
    m_host_label->setTextFormat(Qt::PlainText);
    heading_text->addWidget(m_host_label);
    m_security_label = new QLabel(m_site_page);
    m_security_label->setObjectName("LadybirdSiteSettingsSecurity");
    m_security_label->setTextFormat(Qt::PlainText);
    heading_text->addWidget(m_security_label);
    heading->addLayout(heading_text, 1);
    layout->addLayout(heading);

    add_separator(*m_site_page, *layout, 12, 6);

    // The permissions the user decided for the site, or the page asked for. The rows are made for each site shown.
    m_permission_rows = new QWidget(m_site_page);
    auto* permission_rows_layout = new QVBoxLayout(m_permission_rows);
    permission_rows_layout->setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0);
    permission_rows_layout->setSpacing(0);
    layout->addWidget(m_permission_rows);

    // Whether media may play on its own.
    auto* autoplay_row = new QHBoxLayout;
    autoplay_row->setContentsMargins(10, 0, 10, 0);
    autoplay_row->setSpacing(10);
    m_autoplay_icon = create_icon(*m_site_page);
    autoplay_row->addWidget(m_autoplay_icon);
    auto* autoplay_label = new QLabel("Autoplay", m_site_page);
    autoplay_label->setFixedHeight(ROW_HEIGHT);
    autoplay_row->addWidget(autoplay_label, 1);
    m_autoplay_button = create_value_button(*m_site_page);
    QObject::connect(m_autoplay_button, &QPushButton::clicked, this, [this] {
        auto const& autoplay = m_settings.autoplay_settings();
        auto site_policy = autoplay.site_filters.get(m_origin);
        QMenu menu(this);

        for (auto policy : { Web::HTML::AutoplayPolicy::AllowAudioAndVideo, Web::HTML::AutoplayPolicy::BlockAudio, Web::HTML::AutoplayPolicy::BlockAudioAndVideo }) {
            auto* action = menu.addAction(autoplay_policy_name(policy));
            action->setData(static_cast<int>(policy));
            action->setCheckable(true);
            action->setChecked(site_policy == policy);
        }

        auto* use_default = menu.addAction(qformatted("Default ({})", autoplay_policy_name(autoplay.policy)));
        use_default->setCheckable(true);
        use_default->setChecked(!site_policy.has_value());

        auto* chosen = menu.exec(m_autoplay_button->mapToGlobal(QPoint(0, m_autoplay_button->height())));
        if (chosen == use_default)
            m_settings.remove_autoplay_site_filter(m_origin);
        else if (chosen)
            m_settings.add_autoplay_site_filter(m_origin, static_cast<Web::HTML::AutoplayPolicy>(chosen->data().toInt()));

        update_autoplay();
    });
    autoplay_row->addWidget(m_autoplay_button);
    layout->addLayout(autoplay_row);

    add_separator(*m_site_page, *layout, 6, 6);

    // Whether pages on the site are darkened, overriding the default for every site.
    auto* force_dark_row = new QHBoxLayout;
    force_dark_row->setContentsMargins(10, 0, 10, 0);
    force_dark_row->setSpacing(10);
    m_force_dark_icon = create_icon(*m_site_page);
    force_dark_row->addWidget(m_force_dark_icon);
    auto* force_dark_label = new QLabel("Force dark mode", m_site_page);
    force_dark_label->setFixedHeight(ROW_HEIGHT);
    force_dark_row->addWidget(force_dark_label, 1);
    m_force_dark_switch = new PopoverSwitch(m_site_page);
    m_force_dark_switch->setAccessibleName("Force dark mode on this site");
    QObject::connect(m_force_dark_switch, &QCheckBox::toggled, this, [this](bool enabled) {
        if (!m_is_private && !m_host.is_empty())
            m_settings.set_force_dark_for_host(m_host, enabled);
    });
    force_dark_row->addWidget(m_force_dark_switch);
    layout->addLayout(force_dark_row);

    // Whether content blocking is on for the site, and what it blocked on the page.
    auto* blocking_row = new QHBoxLayout;
    blocking_row->setContentsMargins(10, 0, 10, 0);
    blocking_row->setSpacing(10);
    m_content_blocking_icon = create_icon(*m_site_page);
    blocking_row->addWidget(m_content_blocking_icon);
    auto* blocking_label = new QLabel("Content blocking", m_site_page);
    blocking_label->setFixedHeight(ROW_HEIGHT);
    blocking_row->addWidget(blocking_label, 1);
    m_content_blocking_switch = new PopoverSwitch(m_site_page);
    m_content_blocking_switch->setAccessibleName("Content blocking on this site");
    QObject::connect(m_content_blocking_switch, &QCheckBox::toggled, this, [this](bool enabled) {
        if (on_content_blocking_toggle)
            on_content_blocking_toggle(enabled);
    });
    blocking_row->addWidget(m_content_blocking_switch);
    layout->addLayout(blocking_row);

    m_blocked_row = new QPushButton(m_site_page);
    m_blocked_row->setObjectName("LadybirdPopoverRow");
    m_blocked_row->setAccessibleName("Blocked on this page");
    m_blocked_row->setFixedHeight(ROW_HEIGHT);
    m_blocked_row->setAttribute(Qt::WA_LayoutUsesWidgetRect);
    auto* blocked_row_layout = new QHBoxLayout(m_blocked_row);
    blocked_row_layout->setContentsMargins(10, 0, 10, 0);
    blocked_row_layout->setSpacing(10);
    // NB: A box layout puts no spacing after a spacer, so this spacer covers the icon and its spacing in the rows above.
    blocked_row_layout->addSpacing(26);
    auto* blocked_label = new QLabel("Blocked on this page", m_blocked_row);
    blocked_label->setAttribute(Qt::WA_TransparentForMouseEvents);
    blocked_row_layout->addWidget(blocked_label, 1);
    m_blocked_count = new QLabel(m_blocked_row);
    m_blocked_count->setObjectName("LadybirdSiteSettingsDetail");
    m_blocked_count->setAttribute(Qt::WA_TransparentForMouseEvents);
    blocked_row_layout->addWidget(m_blocked_count);
    m_blocked_row_chevron = new QLabel(m_blocked_row);
    m_blocked_row_chevron->setFixedSize(12, 12);
    m_blocked_row_chevron->setAttribute(Qt::WA_TransparentForMouseEvents);
    blocked_row_layout->addWidget(m_blocked_row_chevron);
    QObject::connect(m_blocked_row, &QPushButton::clicked, this, [this] { show_blocked_resources(true); });
    layout->addWidget(m_blocked_row);

    add_separator(*m_site_page, *layout, 6, 2);

    auto* links = new QHBoxLayout;
    links->setContentsMargins(4, 0, 4, 0);
    // What can be set for the site is reset to the defaults.
    m_reset_permissions_link = create_link(*m_site_page, "Reset permissions");
    QObject::connect(m_reset_permissions_link, &QPushButton::clicked, this, [this] {
        m_settings.remove_autoplay_site_filter(m_origin);
        if (!m_is_private)
            m_settings.reset_host_setting(WebView::HostSetting::ForceDark, m_host);
        update_autoplay();
        if (on_reset_permissions)
            on_reset_permissions();
    });
    links->addWidget(m_reset_permissions_link);
    links->addStretch(1);
    auto* site_settings_link = create_link(*m_site_page, "All site settings");
    QObject::connect(site_settings_link, &QPushButton::clicked, this, [this] {
        close();
        if (on_open_all_site_settings)
            on_open_all_site_settings();
    });
    links->addWidget(site_settings_link);
    layout->addLayout(links);
    pages->addWidget(m_site_page);

    // What was blocked on the page.
    m_blocked_page = new QWidget(&card());
    auto* blocked_layout = new QVBoxLayout(m_blocked_page);
    blocked_layout->setContentsMargins(6, 8, 6, 8);
    blocked_layout->setSpacing(0);

    auto* blocked_heading = new QHBoxLayout;
    blocked_heading->setContentsMargins(4, 0, 10, 0);
    blocked_heading->setSpacing(4);
    m_back_button = new QToolButton(m_blocked_page);
    m_back_button->setObjectName("LadybirdPopoverIconButton");
    m_back_button->setAccessibleName("Back to site settings");
    m_back_button->setFixedSize(28, 28);
    m_back_button->setIconSize({ 14, 14 });
    QObject::connect(m_back_button, &QToolButton::clicked, this, [this] { show_blocked_resources(false); });
    blocked_heading->addWidget(m_back_button);
    auto* blocked_title = new QLabel("Blocked on this page", m_blocked_page);
    blocked_title->setObjectName("LadybirdSiteSettingsHost");
    blocked_title->setFixedHeight(32);
    blocked_heading->addWidget(blocked_title, 1);
    m_blocked_page_count = new QLabel(m_blocked_page);
    m_blocked_page_count->setObjectName("LadybirdSiteSettingsDetail");
    blocked_heading->addWidget(m_blocked_page_count);
    blocked_layout->addLayout(blocked_heading);
    blocked_layout->addSpacing(6);

    add_separator(*m_blocked_page, *blocked_layout, 0, 6);

    m_blocked_list = new QVBoxLayout;
    m_blocked_list->setContentsMargins(10, 0, 10, 0);
    m_blocked_list->setSpacing(0);
    blocked_layout->addLayout(m_blocked_list);

    add_separator(*m_blocked_page, *blocked_layout, 8, 6);

    auto* blocked_links = new QHBoxLayout;
    blocked_links->setContentsMargins(4, 2, 4, 0);
    auto* report_link = create_link(*m_blocked_page, "Report a broken site");
    QObject::connect(report_link, &QPushButton::clicked, this, [this] {
        close();
        if (on_report_broken_site)
            on_report_broken_site();
    });
    blocked_links->addWidget(report_link);
    blocked_links->addStretch(1);
    auto* filter_lists_link = create_link(*m_blocked_page, "Filter lists");
    QObject::connect(filter_lists_link, &QPushButton::clicked, this, [this] {
        close();
        if (on_open_filter_lists)
            on_open_filter_lists();
    });
    blocked_links->addWidget(filter_lists_link);
    blocked_layout->addLayout(blocked_links);
    pages->addWidget(m_blocked_page);
    m_blocked_page->hide();

    // A page that is not from a website.
    m_no_site_page = new QWidget(&card());
    auto* no_site_layout = new QVBoxLayout(m_no_site_page);
    no_site_layout->setContentsMargins(6, 14, 6, 8);
    no_site_layout->setSpacing(0);

    auto* no_site_heading = new QHBoxLayout;
    no_site_heading->setContentsMargins(10, 0, 10, 0);
    no_site_heading->setSpacing(10);
    m_no_site_favicon = new QLabel(m_no_site_page);
    m_no_site_favicon->setFixedSize(28, 28);
    m_no_site_favicon->setAlignment(Qt::AlignCenter);
    m_no_site_favicon->setObjectName("LadybirdSiteSettingsFavicon");
    no_site_heading->addWidget(m_no_site_favicon, 0, Qt::AlignTop);
    auto* no_site_text = new QVBoxLayout;
    no_site_text->setSpacing(2);
    m_no_site_title = new QLabel(m_no_site_page);
    m_no_site_title->setObjectName("LadybirdSiteSettingsHost");
    m_no_site_title->setTextFormat(Qt::PlainText);
    no_site_text->addWidget(m_no_site_title);
    m_no_site_explanation = new QLabel(m_no_site_page);
    m_no_site_explanation->setObjectName("LadybirdSiteSettingsDetail");
    m_no_site_explanation->setTextFormat(Qt::PlainText);
    m_no_site_explanation->setWordWrap(true);
    no_site_text->addWidget(m_no_site_explanation);
    no_site_heading->addLayout(no_site_text, 1);
    no_site_layout->addLayout(no_site_heading);

    add_separator(*m_no_site_page, *no_site_layout, 12, 2);

    auto* no_site_links = new QHBoxLayout;
    no_site_links->setContentsMargins(4, 0, 4, 0);
    no_site_links->addStretch(1);
    auto* no_site_settings_link = create_link(*m_no_site_page, "All site settings");
    QObject::connect(no_site_settings_link, &QPushButton::clicked, this, [this] {
        close();
        if (on_open_all_site_settings)
            on_open_all_site_settings();
    });
    no_site_links->addWidget(no_site_settings_link);
    no_site_layout->addLayout(no_site_links);
    pages->addWidget(m_no_site_page);
    m_no_site_page->hide();

    update_icons();
}

void SiteSettingsPopover::set_site(Site site)
{
    m_origin = site.origin.serialize();
    m_host = AK::move(site.host_for_settings);
    m_is_private = site.is_private;
    content_settings_changed();
    m_host_label->setText(qstring_from_ak_string(site.origin.host().serialize()));
    // A secure connection is the norm, so only an insecure one is mentioned.
    m_security_label->setText("Connection is not secure");
    m_security_label->setVisible(site.origin.scheme() != "https"sv);

    m_favicon->setPixmap(heading_favicon_pixmap(site.favicon, devicePixelRatioF()));

    set_permissions(site.permissions);
    update_autoplay();
    m_no_site_page->hide();
    show_blocked_resources(false);
    set_content_blocking(site.content_blocking);
}

void SiteSettingsPopover::set_page_without_site(QString const& title, QString const& explanation, QIcon const& favicon)
{
    // NB: A long title, such as the path of a file or one a sandboxed page chose, would widen the text past the card,
    //     so it is cut short. The style sheet sets the title's font once it is polished.
    m_no_site_title->ensurePolished();
    m_no_site_title->setText(m_no_site_title->fontMetrics().elidedText(title, Qt::ElideRight, NO_SITE_TITLE_WIDTH));
    m_no_site_explanation->setText(explanation);
    m_no_site_favicon->setPixmap(heading_favicon_pixmap(favicon, devicePixelRatioF()));

    // NB: The page shown before is hidden first, so that the popover never has to fit two pages at once.
    m_site_page->hide();
    m_blocked_page->hide();
    m_no_site_page->show();
    fit_to_page();
}

// A permission the user never decided and the page never asked for has no row.
void SiteSettingsPopover::set_permissions(Vector<WebView::SitePermissionRow> const& permissions)
{
    // The rows go once the event loop is back: a change made from a row's menu arrives from a button in that row.
    auto* rows_layout = m_permission_rows->layout();
    while (auto* item = rows_layout->takeAt(0)) {
        if (auto* widget = item->widget()) {
            widget->hide();
            widget->deleteLater();
        }
        delete item;
    }
    m_permissions.clear();
    m_has_decided_permissions = false;

    for (auto const& permission : permissions) {
        if (!permission.decision.has_value() && !permission.requested_by_page)
            continue;
        m_has_decided_permissions |= permission.decision.has_value();

        auto* row = new QWidget(m_permission_rows);
        auto* row_layout = new QHBoxLayout(row);
        row_layout->setContentsMargins(10, 0, 10, 0);
        row_layout->setSpacing(10);
        auto* icon = create_icon(*row);
        row_layout->addWidget(icon);
        auto* label = new QLabel(permission_label(permission.name), row);
        label->setFixedHeight(ROW_HEIGHT);
        row_layout->addWidget(label, 1);
        auto* button = create_value_button(*row);
        button->setObjectName(QStringLiteral("LadybirdSiteSettingsPermission-%1").arg(qstring_from_ak_string(Web::Permissions::to_string(permission.name))));
        button->setText(permission_decision_name(permission.decision));
        QObject::connect(button, &QPushButton::clicked, this, [this, button, name = permission.name, decision = permission.decision, one_time_grant_is_live = permission.one_time_grant_is_live] {
            QMenu menu(this);
            Vector<QAction*> actions;
            Vector<Optional<WebView::PermissionDecision>> choices;
            auto add_choice = [&](QString const& text, Optional<WebView::PermissionDecision> choice) {
                auto* action = menu.addAction(text);
                action->setCheckable(true);
                action->setChecked(choice == decision);
                actions.append(action);
                choices.append(choice);
            };
            add_choice("Allow", WebView::PermissionDecision::Allow);
            // A one-time grant can be kept while it lasts, but not given from here.
            if (one_time_grant_is_live)
                add_choice("Allow this time", WebView::PermissionDecision::AllowOnce);
            add_choice("Ask", {});
            add_choice("Block", WebView::PermissionDecision::Block);
            auto* chosen = menu.exec(button->mapToGlobal(QPoint(0, button->height())));
            if (auto index = actions.find_first_index(chosen); index.has_value() && on_permission_change)
                on_permission_change(name, choices[*index]);
        });
        row_layout->addWidget(button);
        rows_layout->addWidget(row);
        m_permissions.append({ .name = permission.name, .icon = icon, .button = button });
    }

    m_permission_rows->setVisible(!m_permissions.is_empty());
    update_icons();
    update_reset_link();
    fit_to_page();
}

void SiteSettingsPopover::set_content_blocking(WebView::ContentBlockingSnapshot const& blocking)
{
    QSignalBlocker blocker(m_content_blocking_switch);
    m_content_blocking_switch->setChecked(blocking.enabled());
    m_content_blocking_switch->setEnabled(blocking.can_toggle());

    // What was blocked is only listed while content blocking is on.
    auto count = qformatted("{}", blocking.blocked_resources.size());
    m_blocked_count->setText(count);
    m_blocked_page_count->setText(count);
    m_blocked_row->setVisible(blocking.enabled());
    if (!blocking.enabled())
        show_blocked_resources(false);

    while (auto* item = m_blocked_list->takeAt(0)) {
        delete item->widget();
        delete item;
    }
    if (blocking.blocked_resources.is_empty()) {
        auto* empty = new QLabel("Nothing has been blocked on this page.", m_blocked_page);
        empty->setObjectName("LadybirdSiteSettingsDetail");
        empty->setFixedHeight(BLOCKED_RESOURCE_ROW_HEIGHT);
        m_blocked_list->addWidget(empty);
    }
    for (auto const& resource : blocking.blocked_resources) {
        auto* row = new QWidget(m_blocked_page);
        row->setFixedHeight(BLOCKED_RESOURCE_ROW_HEIGHT);
        auto* row_layout = new QHBoxLayout(row);
        row_layout->setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0);
        row_layout->setSpacing(10);
        auto* host = new QLabel(row);
        host->setTextFormat(Qt::PlainText);
        host->setText(host->fontMetrics().elidedText(qstring_from_ak_string(resource.host), Qt::ElideRight, POPOVER_WIDTH - 120));
        row_layout->addWidget(host, 1);
        auto* kind = new QLabel(qstring_from_ak_string(resource.kind), row);
        kind->setObjectName("LadybirdSiteSettingsDetail");
        row_layout->addWidget(kind);
        m_blocked_list->addWidget(row);
    }
    fit_to_page();
}

void SiteSettingsPopover::show_blocked_resources(bool show)
{
    // NB: The page shown before is hidden first, so that the popover never has to fit both pages at once.
    (show ? m_site_page : m_blocked_page)->hide();
    (show ? m_blocked_page : m_site_page)->show();
    fit_to_page();
}

void SiteSettingsPopover::fit_to_page()
{
    // NB: The page's and the card's layouts take in a row that shows or hides only once they are activated, so they are
    //     activated before the popover's own, which would otherwise keep the card at its old height.
    for (auto* page : { m_site_page, m_blocked_page, m_no_site_page }) {
        if (!page->isHidden())
            page->layout()->activate();
    }
    card().layout()->activate();
    layout()->activate();
    adjustSize();
}

void SiteSettingsPopover::content_settings_changed()
{
    QSignalBlocker blocker(m_force_dark_switch);
    m_force_dark_switch->setChecked(m_settings.force_dark_for_host(m_host));
    m_force_dark_switch->setEnabled(!m_is_private && !m_host.is_empty());
    update_reset_link();
}

void SiteSettingsPopover::update_autoplay()
{
    auto const& autoplay = m_settings.autoplay_settings();
    auto name = autoplay_policy_name(autoplay.site_filters.get(m_origin).value_or(autoplay.policy));
    m_autoplay_button->setText(name);
    m_autoplay_button->setIcon(create_chrome_icon(ChromeIcon::ChevronDown, Theme::panel().muted));
    update_reset_link();
}

// There is something to reset once the site has a decision of its own.
void SiteSettingsPopover::update_reset_link()
{
    if (!m_reset_permissions_link)
        return;
    auto const& autoplay = m_settings.autoplay_settings();
    auto has_force_dark_choice = !m_is_private && m_settings.content_settings().force_dark_per_host.contains(m_host);
    m_reset_permissions_link->setEnabled(m_has_decided_permissions || autoplay.site_filters.contains(m_origin) || has_force_dark_choice);
}

void SiteSettingsPopover::update_chrome_style(QPalette const& palette)
{
    setPalette(palette);
    setStyleSheet(ChromeStyle::site_settings_popover_style_sheet(palette));
    // NB: The popover is kept for its tab, so its icons are drawn again in the colors of the current theme.
    update_icons();
}

void SiteSettingsPopover::update_icons()
{
    auto const& panel = Theme::panel();
    for (auto& permission : m_permissions) {
        permission.icon->setPixmap(create_chrome_icon(permission_icon(permission.name), panel.body).pixmap(QSize(16, 16), devicePixelRatioF()));
        permission.button->setIcon(create_chrome_icon(ChromeIcon::ChevronDown, panel.muted));
    }
    m_autoplay_icon->setPixmap(create_chrome_icon(ChromeIcon::Volume, panel.body).pixmap(QSize(16, 16), devicePixelRatioF()));
    m_force_dark_icon->setPixmap(create_chrome_icon(ChromeIcon::Moon, panel.body).pixmap(QSize(16, 16), devicePixelRatioF()));
    m_content_blocking_icon->setPixmap(create_chrome_icon(ChromeIcon::ContentBlocking, panel.body).pixmap(QSize(16, 16), devicePixelRatioF()));
    m_blocked_row_chevron->setPixmap(create_chrome_icon(ChromeIcon::Forward, panel.muted).pixmap(QSize(12, 12), devicePixelRatioF()));
    m_back_button->setIcon(create_chrome_icon(ChromeIcon::Back, panel.body));
}

}

// What Ladybird knows about the site a page is from, and the settings that apply to it.
class SiteSettingsPopover final : public Popover
    , public WebView::SettingsObserver {
public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    explicit SiteSettingsPopover(QWidget* parent, WebView::Settings&);

    struct Site {
        URL::Origin origin;
        String host_for_settings;
        bool is_private { false };
        QIcon favicon;
        WebView::ContentBlockingSnapshot content_blocking;
        Vector<WebView::SitePermissionRow> permissions;
    };
    void set_site(Site);
    // A page that is not from a website, such as about:blank or a file, has no settings, so the popover says so
    // instead.
    void set_page_without_site(QString const& title, QString const& explanation, QIcon const& favicon);
    void set_content_blocking(WebView::ContentBlockingSnapshot const&);
    void set_permissions(Vector<WebView::SitePermissionRow> const&);
    void update_chrome_style(QPalette const&);

    Function<void(bool)> on_content_blocking_toggle;
    // Changes one of the site's permissions, to the decision given, or back to asking when there is none.
    Function<void(Web::Permissions::PermissionName, Optional<WebView::PermissionDecision>)> on_permission_change;
    Function<void()> on_reset_permissions;
    Function<void()> on_open_all_site_settings;
    Function<void()> on_report_broken_site;
    Function<void()> on_open_filter_lists;

private:
    virtual void content_settings_changed() override;
    virtual void autoplay_settings_changed() override { update_autoplay(); }

    void update_autoplay();
    void update_reset_link();
    void update_icons();
    void show_blocked_resources(bool);
    void fit_to_page();

    struct PermissionRow {
        Web::Permissions::PermissionName name;
        QLabel* icon { nullptr };
        QPushButton* button { nullptr };
    };

    WebView::Settings& m_settings;
    String m_origin;
    String m_host;
    bool m_is_private { false };
    QLabel* m_force_dark_icon { nullptr };
    PopoverSwitch* m_force_dark_switch { nullptr };
    QWidget* m_site_page { nullptr };
    QWidget* m_blocked_page { nullptr };
    QWidget* m_no_site_page { nullptr };
    QLabel* m_no_site_favicon { nullptr };
    QLabel* m_no_site_title { nullptr };
    QLabel* m_no_site_explanation { nullptr };
    QLabel* m_favicon { nullptr };
    QLabel* m_host_label { nullptr };
    QLabel* m_security_label { nullptr };
    QWidget* m_permission_rows { nullptr };
    Vector<PermissionRow> m_permissions;
    bool m_has_decided_permissions { false };
    QLabel* m_autoplay_icon { nullptr };
    QPushButton* m_autoplay_button { nullptr };
    QPushButton* m_reset_permissions_link { nullptr };
    QLabel* m_content_blocking_icon { nullptr };
    PopoverSwitch* m_content_blocking_switch { nullptr };
    QPushButton* m_blocked_row { nullptr };
    QLabel* m_blocked_row_chevron { nullptr };
    QToolButton* m_back_button { nullptr };
    QLabel* m_blocked_count { nullptr };
    QLabel* m_blocked_page_count { nullptr };
    QVBoxLayout* m_blocked_list { nullptr };
};

FILE: UI/Qt/SoftwareUpdaterMac.mm
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
