#include <AK/Format.h>
#include <UI/Qt/SoftwareUpdaterMac.h>

#import <Sparkle/Sparkle.h>

// While it offers the latest version as an update, the running version counts as older than itself, so that Sparkle
// offers to install the newest version of the appcast even when it is the one running. Sparkle's installer refuses
// only downgrades, so installing it again goes through. Sparkle tells versions that look the same apart by their build
// numbers, which are the same as well, so the versions show as they are.
@interface LadybirdUpdaterDelegate : NSObject <SPUUpdaterDelegate, SPUStandardUserDriverDelegate, SUVersionComparison, SUVersionDisplay>

@property (atomic) BOOL offersLatestVersion;
@property (nonatomic, copy) void (^willRelaunch)(void);

@end

@implementation LadybirdUpdaterDelegate

#pragma clang diagnostic push
#pragma clang diagnostic ignored "-Wdeprecated-implementations"
- (id<SUVersionComparison>)versionComparatorForUpdater:(SPUUpdater*)updater
{
    return self.offersLatestVersion ? self : nil;
}
#pragma clang diagnostic pop

// NB: Sparkle may call this off the main thread.
- (NSComparisonResult)compareVersion:(NSString*)versionA toVersion:(NSString*)versionB
{
    auto result = [[SUStandardVersionComparator defaultComparator] compareVersion:versionA toVersion:versionB];
    if (result == NSOrderedSame && [versionA isEqualToString:NSBundle.mainBundle.infoDictionary[@"CFBundleVersion"]])
        return NSOrderedAscending;
    return result;
}

- (id<SUVersionDisplay>)standardUserDriverRequestsVersionDisplayer
{
    return self.offersLatestVersion ? self : nil;
}

- (NSString*)formatUpdateDisplayVersionFromUpdate:(SUAppcastItem*)update andBundleDisplayVersion:(NSString* __autoreleasing*)inOutBundleDisplayVersion withBundleVersion:(NSString*)bundleVersion
{
    return update.displayVersionString;
}

- (void)updater:(SPUUpdater*)updater didFinishUpdateCycleForUpdateCheck:(SPUUpdateCheck)updateCheck error:(NSError*)error
{
    self.offersLatestVersion = NO;
}

- (void)updaterWillRelaunchApplication:(SPUUpdater*)updater
{
    if (self.willRelaunch)
        self.willRelaunch();
}

@end

// Sparkle only runs once the user chose to install an update in Ladybird's own notice, so it installs the update and
// relaunches without asking again. Its progress and its alerts show in Sparkle's own windows. The window that says
// Sparkle is checking for updates is left out: Sparkle's update window would replace it, but that window is skipped.
@interface LadybirdUserDriver : NSObject <SPUUserDriver>

- (instancetype)initWithStandardUserDriver:(SPUStandardUserDriver*)standardUserDriver;

@end

@implementation LadybirdUserDriver
{
    SPUStandardUserDriver* _standard;
}

- (instancetype)initWithStandardUserDriver:(SPUStandardUserDriver*)standardUserDriver
{
    if (self = [super init])
        _standard = standardUserDriver;
    return self;
}

- (void)showUpdatePermissionRequest:(SPUUpdatePermissionRequest*)request reply:(void (^)(SUUpdatePermissionResponse*))reply
{
    [_standard showUpdatePermissionRequest:request reply:reply];
}

- (void)showUserInitiatedUpdateCheckWithCancellation:(void (^)(void))cancellation
{
}

- (void)showUpdateFoundWithAppcastItem:(SUAppcastItem*)appcastItem state:(SPUUserUpdateState*)state reply:(void (^)(SPUUserUpdateChoice))reply
{
    // Sparkle cannot install an update that only informs, so the user sees what it says instead. A check that the user did
    // not start, such as one that a user default scheduled, asks the user as Sparkle normally does.
    if (appcastItem.informationOnlyUpdate || !state.userInitiated) {
        [_standard showUpdateFoundWithAppcastItem:appcastItem state:state reply:reply];
        return;
    }
    reply(SPUUserUpdateChoiceInstall);
}

- (void)showUpdateReleaseNotesWithDownloadData:(SPUDownloadData*)downloadData
{
    [_standard showUpdateReleaseNotesWithDownloadData:downloadData];
}

- (void)showUpdateReleaseNotesFailedToDownloadWithError:(NSError*)error
{
    [_standard showUpdateReleaseNotesFailedToDownloadWithError:error];
}

- (void)showUpdateNotFoundWithError:(NSError*)error acknowledgement:(void (^)(void))acknowledgement
{
    [_standard showUpdateNotFoundWithError:error acknowledgement:acknowledgement];
}

- (void)showUpdaterError:(NSError*)error acknowledgement:(void (^)(void))acknowledgement
{
    [_standard showUpdaterError:error acknowledgement:acknowledgement];
}

- (void)showDownloadInitiatedWithCancellation:(void (^)(void))cancellation
{
    [_standard showDownloadInitiatedWithCancellation:cancellation];
}

- (void)showDownloadDidReceiveExpectedContentLength:(uint64_t)expectedContentLength
{
    [_standard showDownloadDidReceiveExpectedContentLength:expectedContentLength];
}

- (void)showDownloadDidReceiveDataOfLength:(uint64_t)length
{
    [_standard showDownloadDidReceiveDataOfLength:length];
}

- (void)showDownloadDidStartExtractingUpdate
{
    [_standard showDownloadDidStartExtractingUpdate];
}

- (void)showExtractionReceivedProgress:(double)progress
{
    [_standard showExtractionReceivedProgress:progress];
}

- (void)showReadyToInstallAndRelaunch:(void (^)(SPUUserUpdateChoice))reply
{
    reply(SPUUserUpdateChoiceInstall);
}

- (void)showInstallingUpdateWithApplicationTerminated:(BOOL)applicationTerminated retryTerminatingApplication:(void (^)(void))retryTerminatingApplication
{
    [_standard showInstallingUpdateWithApplicationTerminated:applicationTerminated retryTerminatingApplication:retryTerminatingApplication];
}

- (void)showUpdateInstalledAndRelaunched:(BOOL)relaunched acknowledgement:(void (^)(void))acknowledgement
{
    [_standard showUpdateInstalledAndRelaunched:relaunched acknowledgement:acknowledgement];
}

- (void)showUpdateInFocus
{
    [_standard showUpdateInFocus];
}

- (void)dismissUpdateInstallation
{
    [_standard dismissUpdateInstallation];
}

@end

namespace Ladybird {

namespace Detail {

struct SparkleUpdater {
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    // Sparkle holds its delegates weakly.
    LadybirdUpdaterDelegate* delegate { nil };
    LadybirdUserDriver* user_driver { nil };
    SPUUpdater* updater { nil };
};

}

// Sparkle finds updates in the appcast that the app's Info.plist names. The Info.plist also keeps it from looking for
// them by itself, so it only looks when the user asks.
NonnullOwnPtr<SoftwareUpdater> SoftwareUpdater::create()
{
    auto sparkle = make<Detail::SparkleUpdater>();
    sparkle->delegate = [[LadybirdUpdaterDelegate alloc] init];
    auto* standard_user_driver = [[SPUStandardUserDriver alloc] initWithHostBundle:NSBundle.mainBundle delegate:sparkle->delegate];
    sparkle->user_driver = [[LadybirdUserDriver alloc] initWithStandardUserDriver:standard_user_driver];
    sparkle->updater = [[SPUUpdater alloc] initWithHostBundle:NSBundle.mainBundle applicationBundle:NSBundle.mainBundle userDriver:sparkle->user_driver delegate:sparkle->delegate];

    NSError* error = nil;
    if (![sparkle->updater startUpdater:&error])
        warnln("Unable to start Sparkle: {}", error.localizedDescription.UTF8String);
    return adopt_own(*new SoftwareUpdater(move(sparkle)));
}

SoftwareUpdater::SoftwareUpdater(NonnullOwnPtr<Detail::SparkleUpdater> sparkle)
    : m_sparkle(move(sparkle))
{
    m_sparkle->delegate.willRelaunch = ^{
        if (on_will_relaunch)
            on_will_relaunch();
    };
}

SoftwareUpdater::~SoftwareUpdater() = default;

void SoftwareUpdater::install_update()
{
    [m_sparkle->updater checkForUpdates];
}

void SoftwareUpdater::install_latest_version()
{
    m_sparkle->delegate.offersLatestVersion = YES;
    [m_sparkle->updater checkForUpdates];
}

}

FILE: UI/Qt/SpellCheckerMac.mm
/*

 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

#include <AK/AtomicRefCounted.h>
#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/RefPtr.h>
#include <LibCore/EventLoop.h>
#include <LibWebView/StringConversionsMacOS.h>
#include <UI/Qt/SpellCheckerMac.h>

#import <AppKit/AppKit.h>

// Inline predictions are private AppKit API. Each selector is checked with "respondsToSelector:" before use, so if
// AppKit drops one, predictions stop showing and nothing else changes.
@interface NSSpellChecker (LadybirdInlinePredictions)
@property (class, readonly, getter=isAutomaticInlineCompletionEnabled) BOOL automaticInlineCompletionEnabled;
- (NSTextCheckingResult*)completionCandidateFromCandidates:(NSArray<NSTextCheckingResult*>*)candidates;
@end

namespace Ladybird {

using namespace WebView;

// The private text checking type that asks for a single completion of the word at the caret.
static constexpr NSTextCheckingTypes text_checking_type_single_completion = 1ULL << 29;

// Answers come back on an arbitrary queue. The callbacks that take them stay on the main thread, keyed by request, so
// only this atomically counted holder crosses threads.
struct PendingChecks : public AtomicRefCounted<PendingChecks> {
    HashMap<u64, Function<void(Vector<Web::SpellingError>)>> callbacks;
    u64 next_id { 0 };
};

struct PendingSuggestions : public AtomicRefCounted<PendingSuggestions> {
    HashMap<u64, Function<void(Optional<Web::WritingSuggestion>)>> callbacks;
    u64 next_id { 0 };
};

class MacSpellChecker final : public WebView::SpellChecker {
public:
    virtual DocumentTag create_document_tag() override
    {
        return [NSSpellChecker uniqueSpellDocumentTag];
    }

    virtual void close_document_tag(DocumentTag tag) override
    {
        [[NSSpellChecker sharedSpellChecker] closeSpellDocumentWithTag:tag];
    }

    virtual void check(DocumentTag tag, Utf16String const& text, Function<void(Vector<Web::SpellingError>)> on_complete) override
    {
        auto id = m_pending_checks->next_id++;
        m_pending_checks->callbacks.set(id, move(on_complete));
        RefPtr<PendingChecks> pending_checks = m_pending_checks;
        RefPtr<Core::WeakEventLoopReference> event_loop = Core::EventLoop::current_weak();
        auto* string = utf16_string_to_ns_string(text);
        auto handler = ^(NSInteger, NSArray<NSTextCheckingResult*>* results, NSOrthography*, NSInteger) {
            Vector<Web::SpellingError> errors;
            for (NSTextCheckingResult* result in results) {
                if (result.resultType != NSTextCheckingTypeSpelling)
                    continue;
                errors.append({ static_cast<u32>(result.range.location), static_cast<u32>(result.range.length) });
            }
            auto strong_event_loop = event_loop->take();
            if (!strong_event_loop)
                return;
            strong_event_loop->deferred_invoke([pending_checks, id, errors = move(errors)]() mutable {
                if (auto callback = pending_checks->callbacks.take(id); callback.has_value())
                    (*callback)(move(errors));
            });
        };
        [[NSSpellChecker sharedSpellChecker] requestCheckingOfString:string
                                                               range:NSMakeRange(0, string.length)
                                                               types:NSTextCheckingTypeSpelling
                                                             options:nil
                                              inSpellDocumentWithTag:tag
                                                   completionHandler:handler];
    }

    virtual void guesses(DocumentTag tag, Utf16String const& word, Function<void(Vector<Utf16String>)> on_complete) override
    {
        auto* string = utf16_string_to_ns_string(word);
        NSArray<NSString*>* guesses = [[NSSpellChecker sharedSpellChecker] guessesForWordRange:NSMakeRange(0, string.length)
                                                                                      inString:string
                                                                                      language:nil
                                                                        inSpellDocumentWithTag:tag];
        Vector<Utf16String> result;
        for (NSString* guess in guesses)
            result.append(ns_string_to_utf16_string(guess));
        on_complete(move(result));
    }

    virtual void ignore(DocumentTag tag, Utf16String const& word) override
    {
        [[NSSpellChecker sharedSpellChecker] ignoreWord:utf16_string_to_ns_string(word) inSpellDocumentWithTag:tag];
    }

    // NB: The system dictionary learns the word for every app, so the tab's tag plays no part.
    virtual void learn(DocumentTag, Utf16String const& word) override
    {
        [[NSSpellChecker sharedSpellChecker] learnWord:utf16_string_to_ns_string(word)];
    }

    virtual bool can_suggest() const override
    {
        return [NSSpellChecker respondsToSelector:@selector(isAutomaticInlineCompletionEnabled)]
            && [[NSSpellChecker sharedSpellChecker] respondsToSelector:@selector(completionCandidateFromCandidates:)];
    }

    virtual void suggest(DocumentTag tag, Utf16String const& text, u32 caret_offset, Function<void(Optional<Web::WritingSuggestion>)> on_complete) override
    {
        // The user's "Show inline predictive text" setting, which can change at any time.
        if (!can_suggest() || !NSSpellChecker.isAutomaticInlineCompletionEnabled) {
            on_complete({});
            return;
        }

        auto id = m_pending_suggestions->next_id++;
        m_pending_suggestions->callbacks.set(id, move(on_complete));
        RefPtr<PendingSuggestions> pending_suggestions = m_pending_suggestions;
        RefPtr<Core::WeakEventLoopReference> event_loop = Core::EventLoop::current_weak();
        auto* string = utf16_string_to_ns_string(text);
        auto handler = ^(NSInteger, NSArray<NSTextCheckingResult*>* candidates) {
            auto strong_event_loop = event_loop->take();
            if (!strong_event_loop)
                return;
            // The candidates arrive on an arbitrary queue, and the spellchecker picks among them on the main thread.
            strong_event_loop->deferred_invoke([pending_suggestions, id, candidates]() mutable {
                Optional<Web::WritingSuggestion> suggestion;
                NSTextCheckingResult* candidate = [[NSSpellChecker sharedSpellChecker] completionCandidateFromCandidates:candidates];
                if (candidate && candidate.replacementString && candidate.range.location != NSNotFound) {
                    suggestion = Web::WritingSuggestion {
                        static_cast<u32>(candidate.range.location),
                        static_cast<u32>(candidate.range.length),
                        ns_string_to_utf16_string(candidate.replacementString),
                    };
                }
                if (auto callback = pending_suggestions->callbacks.take(id); callback.has_value())
                    (*callback)(move(suggestion));
            });
        };
        // The platform's own candidate types go along with the completion type, which is how the system asks.
        NSTextCheckingTypes types = NSTextCheckingTypeSpelling | NSTextCheckingTypeReplacement | NSTextCheckingTypeCorrection | text_checking_type_single_completion;
        [[NSSpellChecker sharedSpellChecker] requestCandidatesForSelectedRange:NSMakeRange(caret_offset, 0)
                                                                      inString:string
                                                                         types:types
                                                                       options:nil
                                                        inSpellDocumentWithTag:tag
                                                             completionHandler:handler];
    }

private:
    NonnullRefPtr<PendingChecks> m_pending_checks { adopt_ref(*new PendingChecks) };
    NonnullRefPtr<PendingSuggestions> m_pending_suggestions { adopt_ref(*new PendingSuggestions) };
};

NonnullOwnPtr<WebView::SpellChecker> create_platform_spell_checker()
{
    return make<MacSpellChecker>();
}

}

#include <AK/StringBuilder.h>
#include <AK/Utf16StringBuilder.h>
#include <LibURL/Parser.h>
#include <UI/Qt/StringUtils.h>

AK::ByteString ak_byte_string_from_qstring(QString const& qstring)
{
    auto utf8_data = qstring.toUtf8();
    return AK::ByteString(utf8_data.data(), utf8_data.size());
}

AK::ByteString ak_byte_string_from_qbytearray(QByteArray const& qbytearray)
{
    return AK::ByteString(qbytearray.data(), qbytearray.size());
}

String ak_string_from_qstring(QString const& qstring)
{
    auto utf8_data = qstring.toUtf8();
    return MUST(String::from_utf8(StringView(utf8_data.data(), utf8_data.size())));
}

QString qstring_from_ak_string(StringView ak_string)
{
    return QString::fromUtf8(ak_string.characters_without_null_termination(), static_cast<qsizetype>(ak_string.length()));
}

Utf16String utf16_string_from_qstring(QString const& string)
{
    return Utf16String::from_utf16({ reinterpret_cast<char16_t const*>(string.utf16()), static_cast<size_t>(string.size()) });
}

QString qstring_from_utf16_string(Utf16View const& string)
{
    if (string.has_ascii_storage())
        return qstring_from_ak_string(string.ascii_bytes());
    if (string.has_latin1_storage()) {
        auto latin1 = string.latin1_span();
        return QString::fromLatin1(reinterpret_cast<char const*>(latin1.data()), static_cast<qsizetype>(latin1.size()));
    }
    return QString::fromUtf16(string.utf16_span().data(), static_cast<qsizetype>(string.length_in_code_units()));
}

QString vqformatted(StringView format, AK::TypeErasedFormatParams& parameters)
{
    Utf16StringBuilder builder;
    MUST(vformat(builder, format, parameters));
    return qstring_from_utf16_string(builder.view());
}

QByteArray qbytearray_from_ak_string(StringView ak_string)
{
    return { ak_string.characters_without_null_termination(), static_cast<qsizetype>(ak_string.length()) };
}

URL::URL ak_url_from_qurl(QUrl const& qurl)
{
    auto encoded_url = qurl.toEncoded();
    return URL::Parser::basic_parse(StringView(encoded_url.constData(), encoded_url.size())).value();
}

    : m_autocomplete(Application::the(), is_private)
{
    m_autocomplete.on_autocomplete_query_complete = [this](auto query_id, auto suggestions, auto kind) {

            on_suggestions(query_id, move(suggestions), kind);

    m_autocomplete.query_autocomplete_engine(query_id, move(query), max_suggestions, move(bookmarks));
}

{
    m_autocomplete.cancel_pending_query();
}

void SuggestionProvider::record_engagement(WebView::OmniboxEngagement engagement)
{
    m_autocomplete.record_engagement(move(engagement));
}

#include <AK/ByteString.h>
#include <AK/HashTable.h>
#include <AK/Platform.h>
#include <AK/kmalloc.h>
#include <UI/Qt/SystemAppearance.h>
#include <UI/Qt/Theme.h>

#include <QAccessibilityHints>
#include <QApplication>
#include <QStyleHints>
#include <QWidget>

#if defined(AK_OS_LINUX)
// NB: Qt's signals macro clashes with a member of the same name in GLib's D-Bus headers.
#    pragma push_macro("signals")
#    undef signals
#    include <gio/gio.h>
#    pragma pop_macro("signals")
#endif

namespace Ladybird {

SystemAppearance& SystemAppearance::the()
{
    static auto* appearance = new SystemAppearance;
    return *appearance;
}

// Widgets restyle themselves on palette changes, so a change to the chrome's colors that leaves the application palette
// as it is tells them about one.
static void notify_widgets_of_palette_change()
{
    QEvent application_event(QEvent::ApplicationPaletteChange);
    QCoreApplication::sendEvent(qApp, &application_event);
    for (auto* widget : QApplication::allWidgets()) {
        QEvent event(QEvent::PaletteChange);
        QCoreApplication::sendEvent(widget, &event);
    }
}

SystemAppearance::SystemAppearance()
{
    m_prefers_dark = query_system_prefers_dark();

    QObject::connect(QGuiApplication::styleHints(), &QStyleHints::colorSchemeChanged, this, [this] {
        update();
        // While the interface theme is Light or Dark, our windows keep their appearance whatever Qt reports.
        if (m_interface_theme == WebView::ThemePreference::System) {
            // NB: The chrome takes its appearance from Qt's color scheme, but Qt can deliver the new palette before it
            //     reports the new color scheme, so the chrome restyles again now.
            notify_widgets_of_palette_change();
            emit interface_appearance_changed();
        }
    });
    // The chrome's colors depend on the contrast preference, but changing it does not change the application palette.
    QObject::connect(QGuiApplication::styleHints()->accessibility(), &QAccessibilityHints::contrastPreferenceChanged, this, notify_widgets_of_palette_change);
    // Pages that follow the system's contrast preference learn of the change too.
    QObject::connect(QGuiApplication::styleHints()->accessibility(), &QAccessibilityHints::contrastPreferenceChanged, this, &SystemAppearance::contrast_changed);
    observe_platform_changes();
}

void SystemAppearance::update()
{
    auto prefers_dark = query_system_prefers_dark();
    if (prefers_dark == m_prefers_dark)
        return;

    m_prefers_dark = prefers_dark;
    emit changed();
}

void SystemAppearance::apply_interface_theme(WebView::ThemePreference theme)
{
    if (theme == m_interface_theme)
        return;
    auto was_dark = Theme::is_dark();
    m_interface_theme = theme;
    Theme::set_interface_theme(theme);

    switch (theme) {
    case WebView::ThemePreference::System:
        QGuiApplication::styleHints()->unsetColorScheme();
        break;
    case WebView::ThemePreference::Light:
        QGuiApplication::styleHints()->setColorScheme(Qt::ColorScheme::Light);
        break;
    case WebView::ThemePreference::Dark:
        QGuiApplication::styleHints()->setColorScheme(Qt::ColorScheme::Dark);
        break;
    }

    // NB: Some platform themes, such as KDE's, ignore requests for a color scheme. Qt then neither changes its color
    //     scheme nor tells anyone, so the chrome learns of the switch from us instead.
    update_interface_appearance(was_dark);
}

void SystemAppearance::update_interface_appearance(bool was_dark)
{
    if (Theme::is_dark() == was_dark)
        return;

    // NB: Qt's color scheme can't tell whether Qt restyles the widgets: it is unchanged where the request was ignored
    //     but the system already had the requested scheme, and elsewhere it only changes once the theme change has
    //     been delivered.
    notify_widgets_of_palette_change();
    emit interface_appearance_changed();
}

void SystemAppearance::apply_color_theme(WebView::ColorTheme theme)
{
    if (theme == m_color_theme)
        return;
    m_color_theme = theme;
    Theme::set_color_theme(theme);
    notify_widgets_of_palette_change();
}

#if !defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
#    if defined(AK_OS_LINUX)
// The color scheme the settings portal reports. Unlike Qt's, it stays the system's while the interface theme overrides
// Qt's color scheme.
static Optional<bool> s_portal_prefers_dark;
#    endif

bool SystemAppearance::query_system_prefers_dark() const
{
#    if defined(AK_OS_LINUX)
    if (s_portal_prefers_dark.has_value())
        return *s_portal_prefers_dark;
#    endif
    // FIXME: Ask the platform directly where there is no settings portal. While the interface theme overrides Qt's
    //        color scheme, Qt reports the override, so we keep the appearance we last saw from the system.
    if (m_interface_theme != WebView::ThemePreference::System)
        return m_prefers_dark;
    return QGuiApplication::styleHints()->colorScheme() == Qt::ColorScheme::Dark;
}

#    if defined(AK_OS_LINUX)
// https://flatpak.github.io/xdg-desktop-portal/docs/doc-org.freedesktop.portal.Settings.html
static constexpr auto PORTAL_BUS_NAME = "org.freedesktop.portal.Desktop";
static constexpr auto PORTAL_OBJECT_PATH = "/org/freedesktop/portal/desktop";
static constexpr auto SETTINGS_INTERFACE = "org.freedesktop.portal.Settings";
static constexpr auto APPEARANCE_NAMESPACE = "org.freedesktop.appearance"sv;
static constexpr auto COLOR_SCHEME_KEY = "color-scheme"sv;
static constexpr auto ACCENT_COLOR_KEY = "accent-color"sv;
static constexpr auto REDUCED_MOTION_KEY = "reduced-motion"sv;
// Portals older than the reduced-motion setting serve their desktop's own settings: GNOME's serve its interface
// settings, and KDE's those of kdeglobals.
static constexpr auto GNOME_INTERFACE_NAMESPACE = "org.gnome.desktop.interface"sv;
static constexpr auto ENABLE_ANIMATIONS_KEY = "enable-animations"sv;
static constexpr auto KDE_GLOBALS_NAMESPACE = "org.kde.kdeglobals.KDE"sv;
static constexpr auto ANIMATION_DURATION_FACTOR_KEY = "AnimationDurationFactor"sv;

// The motion settings the portal reports: its own reduced-motion setting, and where a portal has none, GNOME's switch
// for animations and KDE's animation speed, where 0 is "Instant". Either of those turned all the way down asks for less
// motion.
static Optional<bool> s_portal_prefers_reduced_motion;
static Optional<bool> s_portal_enables_animations;
static Optional<double> s_portal_animation_duration_factor;

// The accent color is three sRGB components from 0 to 1. Any component out of that range means that there is none.
static Optional<QColor> accent_color_from_variant(GVariant* value)
{
    if (!g_variant_is_of_type(value, G_VARIANT_TYPE("(ddd)")))
        return {};
    double red = 0;
    double green = 0;
    double blue = 0;
    g_variant_get(value, "(ddd)", &red, &green, &blue);
    for (auto component : { red, green, blue }) {
        if (component < 0 || component > 1)
            return {};
    }
    return QColor::fromRgbF(red, green, blue);
}

// The color scheme is 1 for dark and 2 for light. 0 means no preference, which portals also report on desktops that
// have no such setting, so Qt's color scheme decides then.
static Optional<bool> prefers_dark_from_variant(GVariant* value)
{
    if (!g_variant_is_of_type(value, G_VARIANT_TYPE_UINT32))
        return {};
    switch (g_variant_get_uint32(value)) {
    case 1:
        return true;
    case 2:
        return false;
    default:
        return {};
    }
}

// KDE's portal reports the settings of kdeglobals as it reads them from the file, so the factor can come as a string.
static Optional<double> animation_duration_factor_from_variant(GVariant* value)
{
    if (g_variant_is_of_type(value, G_VARIANT_TYPE_DOUBLE))
        return g_variant_get_double(value);
    if (g_variant_is_of_type(value, G_VARIANT_TYPE_STRING)) {
        gsize length = 0;
        auto const* characters = g_variant_get_string(value, &length);
        return StringView { characters, length }.to_number<double>();
    }
    return {};
}

void SystemAppearance::apply_portal_setting(StringView namespace_, StringView key, GVariant* value)
{
    if (namespace_ == APPEARANCE_NAMESPACE && key == COLOR_SCHEME_KEY) {
        s_portal_prefers_dark = prefers_dark_from_variant(value);
        update();
    } else if (namespace_ == APPEARANCE_NAMESPACE && key == ACCENT_COLOR_KEY) {
        auto accent = accent_color_from_variant(value);
        if (accent == Theme::desktop_accent())
            return;
        Theme::set_desktop_accent(move(accent));
        notify_widgets_of_palette_change();
    } else if ((namespace_ == APPEARANCE_NAMESPACE && key == REDUCED_MOTION_KEY) || (namespace_ == GNOME_INTERFACE_NAMESPACE && key == ENABLE_ANIMATIONS_KEY) || (namespace_ == KDE_GLOBALS_NAMESPACE && key == ANIMATION_DURATION_FACTOR_KEY)) {
        auto prefers_reduced_motion = SystemAppearance::prefers_reduced_motion();
        if (key == REDUCED_MOTION_KEY) {
            // The setting is 1 for reduced motion. Any other value means no preference.
            if (g_variant_is_of_type(value, G_VARIANT_TYPE_UINT32))
                s_portal_prefers_reduced_motion = g_variant_get_uint32(value) == 1;
            else
                s_portal_prefers_reduced_motion = {};
        } else if (key == ENABLE_ANIMATIONS_KEY) {
            if (g_variant_is_of_type(value, G_VARIANT_TYPE_BOOLEAN))
                s_portal_enables_animations = g_variant_get_boolean(value);
            else
                s_portal_enables_animations = {};
        } else {
            s_portal_animation_duration_factor = animation_duration_factor_from_variant(value);
        }
        if (SystemAppearance::prefers_reduced_motion() != prefers_reduced_motion)
            emit reduced_motion_changed();
    }
}

// NB: Settings.ReadOne is only in version 2 of the portal. Older portals have only Settings.Read, which wraps the
//     value in one more variant.
struct PortalSettingRead {
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    char* namespace_ { nullptr };
    char* key { nullptr };
    bool is_deprecated_read { false };
};

static void read_portal_setting(GDBusConnection*, PortalSettingRead*);

// The settings that changed since we asked for them, whose first read could otherwise undo the change.
static HashTable<ByteString> s_portal_settings_changed;

static ByteString portal_setting_name(StringView namespace_, StringView key)
{
    return ByteString::formatted("{}.{}", namespace_, key);
}

static void did_read_portal_setting(GObject* source, GAsyncResult* result, gpointer user_data)
{
    auto* read = static_cast<PortalSettingRead*>(user_data);
    auto* connection = G_DBUS_CONNECTION(source);
    auto* reply = g_dbus_connection_call_finish(connection, result, nullptr);
    if (!reply && !read->is_deprecated_read) {
        read->is_deprecated_read = true;
        read_portal_setting(connection, read);
        return;
    }
    if (reply) {
        GVariant* value = nullptr;
        g_variant_get(reply, "(v)", &value);
        if (read->is_deprecated_read && g_variant_is_of_type(value, G_VARIANT_TYPE_VARIANT)) {
            auto* inner_value = g_variant_get_variant(value);
            g_variant_unref(value);
            value = inner_value;
        }
        StringView namespace_ { read->namespace_, strlen(read->namespace_) };
        StringView key { read->key, strlen(read->key) };
        if (!s_portal_settings_changed.contains(portal_setting_name(namespace_, key)))
            SystemAppearance::the().apply_portal_setting(namespace_, key, value);
        g_variant_unref(value);
        g_variant_unref(reply);
    }
    g_free(read->namespace_);
    g_free(read->key);
    delete read;
}

static void read_portal_setting(GDBusConnection* connection, PortalSettingRead* read)
{
    g_dbus_connection_call(connection, PORTAL_BUS_NAME, PORTAL_OBJECT_PATH, SETTINGS_INTERFACE,
        read->is_deprecated_read ? "Read" : "ReadOne", g_variant_new("(ss)", read->namespace_, read->key),
        G_VARIANT_TYPE("(v)"), G_DBUS_CALL_FLAGS_NONE, -1, nullptr, did_read_portal_setting, read);
}

static void read_portal_setting(GDBusConnection* connection, StringView namespace_, StringView key)
{
    read_portal_setting(connection, new PortalSettingRead {
                                        .namespace_ = g_strndup(namespace_.characters_without_null_termination(), namespace_.length()),
                                        .key = g_strndup(key.characters_without_null_termination(), key.length()),
                                    });
}

static void portal_setting_changed(GDBusConnection*, char const*, char const*, char const*, char const*, GVariant* parameters, gpointer)
{
    char const* namespace_ = nullptr;
    char const* key = nullptr;
    GVariant* value = nullptr;
    g_variant_get(parameters, "(&s&sv)", &namespace_, &key, &value);
    StringView namespace_view { namespace_, strlen(namespace_) };
    StringView key_view { key, strlen(key) };
    s_portal_settings_changed.set(portal_setting_name(namespace_view, key_view));
    SystemAppearance::the().apply_portal_setting(namespace_view, key_view, value);
    g_variant_unref(value);
}

// NB: The connection is kept for the lifetime of the process, as the subscription below needs it.
static GDBusConnection* s_session_bus;

static void did_get_session_bus(GObject*, GAsyncResult* result, gpointer)
{
    auto* connection = g_bus_get_finish(result, nullptr);
    if (!connection)
        return;
    s_session_bus = connection;
    // The signal's first argument is the namespace, and the settings we read are in several, so every change arrives,
    // and apply_portal_setting() picks out the ones we read.
    g_dbus_connection_signal_subscribe(connection, PORTAL_BUS_NAME, SETTINGS_INTERFACE, "SettingChanged", PORTAL_OBJECT_PATH,
        nullptr, G_DBUS_SIGNAL_FLAGS_NONE, portal_setting_changed, nullptr, nullptr);
    read_portal_setting(connection, APPEARANCE_NAMESPACE, COLOR_SCHEME_KEY);
    read_portal_setting(connection, APPEARANCE_NAMESPACE, ACCENT_COLOR_KEY);
    read_portal_setting(connection, APPEARANCE_NAMESPACE, REDUCED_MOTION_KEY);
    read_portal_setting(connection, GNOME_INTERFACE_NAMESPACE, ENABLE_ANIMATIONS_KEY);
    read_portal_setting(connection, KDE_GLOBALS_NAMESPACE, ANIMATION_DURATION_FACTOR_KEY);
}

// NB: Qt's palette does not follow the accent color of desktops such as GNOME, and Qt's color scheme reports the
//     interface theme's override instead of the system's. The settings portal reports both. Everything here is
//     asynchronous, so a missing portal or session bus never holds up startup.
void SystemAppearance::observe_platform_changes()
{
    g_bus_get(G_BUS_TYPE_SESSION, nullptr, did_get_session_bus, nullptr);

    // KDE's portals report no change to the animation speed, which is set in another application. So where the portal
    // has no reduced-motion setting, the speed is read again whenever we become the active application.
    QObject::connect(qGuiApp, &QGuiApplication::applicationStateChanged, this, [](Qt::ApplicationState state) {
        if (state == Qt::ApplicationActive && s_session_bus && !s_portal_prefers_reduced_motion.has_value())
            read_portal_setting(s_session_bus, KDE_GLOBALS_NAMESPACE, ANIMATION_DURATION_FACTOR_KEY);
    });
}
#    else
void SystemAppearance::observe_platform_changes()
{
}
#    endif

#    if defined(AK_OS_LINUX)
bool SystemAppearance::prefers_reduced_motion()
{
    if (s_portal_prefers_reduced_motion.has_value())
        return *s_portal_prefers_reduced_motion;
    if (s_portal_enables_animations == false)
        return true;
    return s_portal_animation_duration_factor.has_value() && *s_portal_animation_duration_factor <= 0;
}
#    else
bool SystemAppearance::prefers_reduced_motion()
{
    // FIXME: Ask the platform.
    return false;
}
#    endif
#endif

}

#pragma once

#include <AK/Platform.h>
#include <AK/StringView.h>
#include <LibWebView/Settings.h>

#include <QObject>

#if defined(AK_OS_LINUX)
typedef struct _GVariant GVariant;
#endif

namespace Ladybird {

// The light or dark appearance chosen in the system's settings. The interface theme setting overrides the appearance
// of our own windows, so this tracks the system separately: websites follow it while their color scheme setting is
// left on System.
class SystemAppearance final : public QObject {
    Q_OBJECT

public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    static SystemAppearance& the();

    bool prefers_dark() const { return m_prefers_dark; }
    // Whether the system asks for less motion. The chrome then moves nothing, though it still fades, and pages whose
    // motion preference is Auto see prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
    static bool prefers_reduced_motion();

    void apply_interface_theme(WebView::ThemePreference);
    void apply_color_theme(WebView::ColorTheme);

#if defined(AK_OS_LINUX)
    // Takes in a setting that the desktop's settings portal reported.
    void apply_portal_setting(StringView namespace_, StringView key, GVariant* value);
#endif

signals:
    void changed();
    // The system started or stopped asking for less motion.
    void reduced_motion_changed();
    // The system started or stopped asking for more contrast.
    void contrast_changed();
    // Our windows switched between the light and dark appearance, whether the system or the interface theme switched
    // them.
    void interface_appearance_changed();

private:
    SystemAppearance();

    void update();
    void update_interface_appearance(bool was_dark);
    bool query_system_prefers_dark() const;
    void observe_platform_changes();

    bool m_prefers_dark { false };
    WebView::ThemePreference m_interface_theme { WebView::ThemePreference::System };
    WebView::ColorTheme m_color_theme { WebView::ColorTheme::Neutral };
};

}

FILE: UI/Qt/SystemAppearanceMac.mm
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

#include <UI/Qt/SystemAppearance.h>

#import <AppKit/AppKit.h>
#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>

#include <QMetaObject>

namespace Ladybird {

// NB: The application's own appearance follows the interface theme, so the system's choice is read from the global
//     defaults instead. The key only exists while the system is dark, including while Auto has made it dark.
bool SystemAppearance::query_system_prefers_dark() const
{
    auto* style = [[NSUserDefaults standardUserDefaults] stringForKey:@"AppleInterfaceStyle"];
    return [style isEqualToString:@"Dark"];
}

bool SystemAppearance::prefers_reduced_motion()
{
    return [[NSWorkspace sharedWorkspace] accessibilityDisplayShouldReduceMotion];
}

void SystemAppearance::observe_platform_changes()
{
    [[NSDistributedNotificationCenter defaultCenter] addObserverForName:@"AppleInterfaceThemeChangedNotification"
                                                                 object:nil
                                                                  queue:[NSOperationQueue mainQueue]
                                                             usingBlock:^(NSNotification*) {
                                                                 // The defaults are updated after the notification is posted.
                                                                 QMetaObject::invokeMethod(this, [this] { update(); }, Qt::QueuedConnection);
                                                             }];
    // The notification comes for a change to any of the display options, such as the contrast.
    __block auto prefers_reduced_motion = SystemAppearance::prefers_reduced_motion();
    [[[NSWorkspace sharedWorkspace] notificationCenter] addObserverForName:NSWorkspaceAccessibilityDisplayOptionsDidChangeNotification
                                                                    object:nil
                                                                     queue:[NSOperationQueue mainQueue]
                                                                usingBlock:^(NSNotification*) {
                                                                    if (SystemAppearance::prefers_reduced_motion() == prefers_reduced_motion)
                                                                        return;
                                                                    prefers_reduced_motion = !prefers_reduced_motion;
                                                                    emit reduced_motion_changed();
                                                                }];
}

}
