void TabWidget::update_vertical_tabs_hover_expanded()
{
    if (!m_vertical_tabs_hover_expanded && !m_vertical_tabs_hover_expand_timer->isActive())
        return;

    if (!cursor_is_over_vertical_tabs())
        set_vertical_tabs_hover_expanded(false);
}

void TabWidget::update_window_button_icons()
{
    if (m_minimize_window_button && m_maximize_window_button && m_close_window_button) {
        auto is_maximized = window()->isMaximized();
        m_minimize_window_button->setIcon(create_chrome_icon(ChromeIcon::WindowMinimize, Theme::chrome_palette(*this)));
        m_maximize_window_button->setIcon(create_chrome_icon(is_maximized ? ChromeIcon::WindowRestore : ChromeIcon::WindowMaximize, Theme::chrome_palette(*this)));
        m_maximize_window_button->setToolTip(is_maximized ? "Restore" : "Maximize");
        m_close_window_button->setIcon(create_chrome_icon(ChromeIcon::WindowClose, Theme::chrome_palette(*this)));
    }

    m_toolbar->update_window_control_icons();
}

void TabWidget::toggle_window_maximized()
{
    auto* top_level_window = window();
    if (top_level_window->isMaximized())
        top_level_window->showNormal();
    else
        top_level_window->showMaximized();
    update_window_button_icons();
}

bool TabWidget::start_window_move()
{
    auto* handle = window()->windowHandle();
    if (!handle)
        return false;
#if defined(AK_OS_MACOS)
    if (start_appkit_window_drag(*this))
        return true;
#endif
    return handle->startSystemMove();
}

void TabBarButton::set_placement(Placement placement)
{
    if (m_placement == placement)
        return;

    m_placement = placement;
    update_size();
    update();
}

TabBarButton::TabBarButton(QIcon const& icon, Role role, QWidget* parent)
    : QPushButton(icon, {}, parent)
    , m_role(role)
{
    setObjectName("LadybirdTabButton");
    update_size();
    setFocusPolicy(Qt::NoFocus);
    setFlat(true);
    hide();
}

void TabBarButton::update_size()
{
    auto icon_size = TAB_BUTTON_ICON_SIZE;
    switch (m_placement) {
    case Placement::Tab:
    case Placement::SidebarRow:
        if (m_role == Role::Close) {
            setFixedSize(TAB_CLOSE_BUTTON_HIT_SIZE);
        } else if (m_placement == Placement::SidebarRow) {
            setFixedSize(SIDEBAR_ROW_AUDIO_BUTTON_SIZE, SIDEBAR_ROW_AUDIO_BUTTON_SIZE);
            icon_size = SIDEBAR_ROW_AUDIO_ICON_SIZE;
        } else {
            setFixedSize(TAB_AUDIO_BUTTON_SIZE, TAB_AUDIO_BUTTON_SIZE);
        }
        break;
    case Placement::RailBadge:
        setFixedSize(RAIL_BADGE_SIZE, RAIL_BADGE_SIZE);
        icon_size = m_role == Role::Close ? RAIL_BADGE_CLOSE_ICON_SIZE : RAIL_BADGE_AUDIO_ICON_SIZE;
        break;
    }
    setIconSize({ icon_size, icon_size });
}

// The close button fades into the slot its tab keeps for it, and out of it, so that nothing else on the tab moves.
// NB: Other layouts show and hide the button outright, so it is left opaque whenever it is not fading.
void TabBarButton::set_revealed(bool revealed, Reveal reveal)
{
    if (revealed && reveal == Reveal::AtOnce) {
        if (m_reveal_animation)
            m_reveal_animation->stop();
        m_revealed = true;
        if (m_opacity != 1) {
            m_opacity = 1;
            update();
        }
        if (!isVisible())
            show();
        return;
    }
    auto is_fading = m_reveal_animation && m_reveal_animation->state() == QAbstractAnimation::Running;
    if (revealed == m_revealed && (is_fading || isVisible() == revealed))
        return;
    auto was_revealed = m_revealed;
    m_revealed = revealed;

    // NB: A button that was never revealed can still show, as when its tab bar shows all of its buttons to lay them
    //     out again. It hides at once rather than fading out, so that it never appears.
    if (!revealed && (!isVisible() || (!was_revealed && !is_fading))) {
        if (isVisible())
            hide();
        if (m_reveal_animation)
            m_reveal_animation->stop();
        m_opacity = 1;
        return;
    }

    if (SystemAppearance::prefers_reduced_motion()) {
        m_opacity = 1;
        setVisible(revealed);
        return;
    }

    if (!m_reveal_animation) {
        m_reveal_animation = new QVariantAnimation(this);
        m_reveal_animation->setDuration(Motion::FAST);
        m_reveal_animation->setEasingCurve(Motion::move_easing());
        QObject::connect(m_reveal_animation, &QVariantAnimation::valueChanged, this, [this](QVariant const& value) {
            m_opacity = value.toReal();
            update();
        });
        QObject::connect(m_reveal_animation, &QVariantAnimation::finished, this, [this] {
            if (!m_revealed)
                hide();
            m_opacity = 1;
        });
    }

    auto from = isVisible() ? m_opacity : 0.0;
    m_reveal_animation->stop();
    m_reveal_animation->setStartValue(from);
    m_reveal_animation->setEndValue(revealed ? 1.0 : 0.0);
    m_opacity = from;
    if (revealed)
        show();
    m_reveal_animation->start();
}

void TabBarButton::set_tab_emphasized(bool emphasized)
{
    if (m_tab_emphasized == emphasized)
        return;
    m_tab_emphasized = emphasized;
    update();
}

bool TabBarButton::event(QEvent* event)
{
    if (event->type() == QEvent::Enter)
        setFlat(false);
    if (event->type() == QEvent::Leave)
        setFlat(true);

    return QPushButton::event(event);
}

void TabBarButton::paintEvent(QPaintEvent*)
{
    QStyleOptionButton option;
    initStyleOption(&option);

    // The speaker in the sidebar and both badges in the collapsed sidebar take the icon color, rather than the tabs'
    // quieter one.
    auto takes_icon_color = m_placement == Placement::RailBadge || (m_placement == Placement::SidebarRow && m_role == Role::Audio);
    auto icon_mode = isEnabled() ? QIcon::Normal : QIcon::Disabled;
    if (takes_icon_color && isEnabled() && ChromeStyle::window_activity(*this) == ChromeStyle::WindowActivity::Active)
        icon_mode = QIcon::Active;

    // NB: The style would draw the icon into a whole number of logical pixels. Where that isn't a whole number of device
    //     pixels, 14 px at 1.25x for one, the picture is resampled to fit and comes out blurry, so it is drawn here.
    auto icon_pixmap = icon().pixmap(iconSize(), devicePixelRatioF(), icon_mode);
    option.icon = {};

    // Every tab shows its close button, so the ones on the other tabs are dimmed, but on the hovered and the selected
    // tabs, and on the button under the pointer. With increased contrast, none are.
    // NB: The icon is dimmed as a whole, rather than drawn in a lighter color, so that it steps back as far on every
    //     surface it sits on.
    auto is_hovered = isDown() || (underMouse() && rect().contains(mapFromGlobal(QCursor::pos())));
    auto is_quiet = m_placement != Placement::RailBadge && m_role == Role::Close && !m_tab_emphasized && !is_hovered && isEnabled() && !Theme::has_increased_contrast();
    auto quiet_opacity = Theme::is_dark(*this) ? QUIET_TAB_CLOSE_BUTTON_OPACITY_DARK : QUIET_TAB_CLOSE_BUTTON_OPACITY_LIGHT;

    QStylePainter painter(this);
    painter.setOpacity(is_quiet ? m_opacity * quiet_opacity : m_opacity);

    if (m_placement == Placement::RailBadge) {
        ChromeStyle::paint_control_frame(painter, *this, ChromeStyle::ControlFrameStyle::ActiveTabOverlay);
    } else if (m_role == Role::Close) {
        if (is_hovered) {
            // A tab's close button is a small rounded square that lights up over the tab's own fill.
            painter.setRenderHint(QPainter::Antialiasing, true);
            painter.setPen(Qt::NoPen);
            painter.setBrush(isDown() ? Theme::panel().pressed : Theme::chrome(*this).hover);
            QRectF square { (width() - TAB_CLOSE_BUTTON_SIZE) / 2.0, (height() - TAB_CLOSE_BUTTON_SIZE) / 2.0, TAB_CLOSE_BUTTON_SIZE, TAB_CLOSE_BUTTON_SIZE };
            painter.drawRoundedRect(square, TAB_BUTTON_RADIUS, TAB_BUTTON_RADIUS);
        }
    } else {
        ChromeStyle::paint_control_frame(painter, *this);
    }

    painter.drawControl(QStyle::CE_PushButton, option);
    painter.drawPixmap(QStyle::alignedRect(layoutDirection(), Qt::AlignCenter, iconSize(), rect()).topLeft(), icon_pixmap);
}

TabMicrophoneIndicator::TabMicrophoneIndicator(QWidget* parent)
    : QLabel(parent)
{
    setObjectName("LadybirdTabMicrophone");
    setToolTip("Using your microphone");
    setAccessibleName("Using your microphone");
    setFocusPolicy(Qt::NoFocus);
    set_placement(m_placement);
    hide();
}

// The microphone has no button around it, so it is only as wide as its glyph beside the speaker, except as a badge.
void TabMicrophoneIndicator::set_placement(TabBarButton::Placement placement)
{
    m_placement = placement;
    switch (placement) {
    case TabBarButton::Placement::Tab:
        setFixedSize(TAB_BUTTON_ICON_SIZE, TAB_AUDIO_BUTTON_SIZE);
        break;
    case TabBarButton::Placement::SidebarRow:
        setFixedSize(SIDEBAR_ROW_AUDIO_ICON_SIZE, SIDEBAR_ROW_AUDIO_BUTTON_SIZE);
        break;
    case TabBarButton::Placement::RailBadge:
        setFixedSize(RAIL_BADGE_SIZE, RAIL_BADGE_SIZE);
        break;
    }
    update();
}

// The microphone is drawn like the speaker in each place, in the same color and at the same size.
void TabMicrophoneIndicator::paintEvent(QPaintEvent*)
{
    QPainter painter(this);

    auto glyph_size = TAB_BUTTON_ICON_SIZE;
    switch (m_placement) {
    case TabBarButton::Placement::Tab:
        break;
    case TabBarButton::Placement::SidebarRow:
        glyph_size = SIDEBAR_ROW_AUDIO_ICON_SIZE;
        break;
    case TabBarButton::Placement::RailBadge:
        ChromeStyle::paint_tab_badge_frame(painter, *this);
        glyph_size = RAIL_BADGE_AUDIO_ICON_SIZE;
        break;
    }

    auto const& chrome = Theme::chrome(*this);
    auto takes_icon_color = m_placement != TabBarButton::Placement::Tab && ChromeStyle::window_activity(*this) == ChromeStyle::WindowActivity::Active;
    QRect glyph_rect { (width() - glyph_size) / 2, (height() - glyph_size) / 2, glyph_size, glyph_size };
    create_chrome_icon(ChromeIcon::Microphone, takes_icon_color ? chrome.icon : chrome.muted).paint(&painter, glyph_rect);
}

}

static constexpr int TAB_ICON_SIZE = 16;

// How much further the first and last horizontal tabs reach toward the ends of the strip, to make room for the selected
// tab's foot there.
struct HorizontalTabEndRoom {
    qreal left { 0 };
    qreal right { 0 };
};

enum class TabLayout : u8 {
    Horizontal,
    VerticalCollapsed,
    VerticalExpanded,
};

class TabBar final : public QTabBar {
    Q_OBJECT

public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    explicit TabBar(TabWidget*);

    void set_available_width(int width);

    Optional<ToolTipContent> tooltip_at(QPoint) const;

    TabWidget* tab_widget() const { return m_tab_widget; }
    TabLayout tab_layout() const { return m_tab_layout; }
    void set_tab_layout(TabLayout);
    // While collapsed vertical tabs only peek open on hover, the pinned tabs keep their rows, one tab each, rather than
    // forming the grid, so no tab moves out from under the pointer.
    void set_pinned_tabs_in_rows(bool);
    void set_vertical_tabs_position(WebView::VerticalTabsPosition);
    void refresh_tab_layout();
    void did_replace_tab(Tab const& old_tab, Tab& new_tab);
    // After a tab is closed with a click, the tabs keep their width until the pointer leaves the tab bar, so the next
    // close button lands under the pointer.
    void lock_tab_widths();
    void recreate_icons();
    int pinned_tab_count() const;

    TabBarButton* tab_close_button(int index) const;
    void set_tab_close_button(int index, TabBarButton*);
    TabBarButton* tab_audio_button(int index) const;
    void set_tab_audio_button(int index, TabBarButton*);

    void update_loading_ring_animation();
    void update_microphone_indicators();
    // How far the end of the horizontal tabs is from where it settles, while tabs open and close.
    int horizontal_tabs_end_offset() const;
    // A horizontal tab that closes shrinks away as the others close the gap.
    void prepare_for_tab_removal(int index);

    int drop_index_at(QPoint const&) const;
    void update_drop_preview(QPoint const&);
    void hide_drop_preview();

private:
    virtual QSize sizeHint() const override;
    virtual QSize minimumSizeHint() const override;
    virtual QSize tabSizeHint(int index) const override;

    virtual void resizeEvent(QResizeEvent*) override;
    virtual void tabLayoutChange() override;
    virtual void tabInserted(int index) override;
    virtual void tabRemoved(int index) override;

    virtual bool event(QEvent*) override;
    virtual void paintEvent(QPaintEvent*) override;
    virtual void contextMenuEvent(QContextMenuEvent* event) override;
    virtual void dragEnterEvent(QDragEnterEvent*) override;
    virtual void dragLeaveEvent(QDragLeaveEvent*) override;
    virtual void dragMoveEvent(QDragMoveEvent*) override;
    virtual void dropEvent(QDropEvent*) override;
    virtual bool eventFilter(QObject*, QEvent*) override;
    virtual void enterEvent(QEnterEvent*) override;
    virtual void leaveEvent(QEvent*) override;
    virtual void mouseDoubleClickEvent(QMouseEvent*) override;
    virtual void mousePressEvent(QMouseEvent*) override;
    virtual void mouseMoveEvent(QMouseEvent*) override;
    virtual void mouseReleaseEvent(QMouseEvent*) override;
    virtual void wheelEvent(QWheelEvent*) override;

    // How far a tab moves, and how much it grows, while tabs make way for a dragged tab.
    struct TabShift {
        qreal x_offset { 0 };
        qreal y_offset { 0 };
        qreal width_delta { 0 };
        qreal height_delta { 0 };
    };
    struct DropPreview {
        Vector<TabShift> tab_shifts;
        qreal strip_growth { 0 };
        qreal pinned_region_growth { 0 };
    };

    Optional<int> dragged_tab_index() const;
    bool dragging_pinned_tab() const;
    QRect incoming_drop_layout_rect(int position) const;
    int drop_slot_at(QPoint const&) const;
    void set_drop_slot(Optional<int>);
    void clear_drop_preview();
    DropPreview drop_preview_for_slot(Optional<int>) const;
    DropPreview current_drop_preview() const;
    TabShift current_tab_shift(int index) const;
    qreal current_strip_growth() const;
    qreal current_pinned_region_growth() const;
    QRect shifted_tab_rect(int index) const;
    qreal selection_of(int index) const;
    bool is_growing_horizontal_tab(int index, QRect const& tab_rect) const;
    QRectF horizontal_tab_contents_rect(int index, QRect const& tab_rect) const;
    QRect tab_drag_card_rect(int index) const;
    qreal tab_drag_card_radius() const;
    QPixmap render_tab_drag_pixmap(int index) const;
    void toggle_window_maximized();
    bool start_window_move();
    void start_tab_drag(int index);
    QPoint tab_drag_hot_spot() const;
    void start_strip_drag(int index);
    void update_strip_drag(QPoint position);
    void end_strip_drag();
    void drag_tab_loose(Tab&, QPixmap card);
    void drag_tab_in_own_window(Tab&);
    void start_hover_animation(int tab_index, qreal target_progress);
    void update_layout_animation();
    QRect animated_tab_rect(int index, QRect const& target) const;
    HorizontalTabEndRoom horizontal_tab_end_room(int index) const;

    // Where the pinned tabs sit in vertical tabs: a grid of tiles when expanded, one icon column when collapsed, and a
    // separator below. Its height is 0 when there's no pinned tab.
    struct PinnedRegion {
        int count { 0 };
        int columns { 1 };
        int tile_width { 0 };
        int height { 0 };
        // While the sidebar opens or closes, the tiles move between their grid in the open sidebar, at 0, and the
        // collapsed sidebar's one column, at 1, whose rows are this wide.
        qreal collapsedness { 0 };
        int collapsed_row_width { 0 };
        // The pinned tabs stay in place only while they fit in half the bar's height. Past that, they scroll with the
        // unpinned tabs, so every tab stays within reach.
        bool scrolls { false };

        int fixed_height() const { return scrolls ? 0 : height; }
    };
    PinnedRegion pinned_region() const;
    PinnedRegion pinned_region_for(int pinned_count) const;
    QRect vertical_tab_rect(int index, PinnedRegion const&) const;
    bool pinned_tabs_are_tiles() const;
    int vertical_bar_width() const;
    int vertical_tabs_left() const;

    QRect visual_tab_rect(int index) const;
    int tab_index_at(QPoint const&) const;
    QSize vertical_size_hint(int tab_count) const;
    bool vertical_tabs_are_on_right() const;

    int max_scroll_offset() const;
    void set_scroll_offset(int);

    void set_hovered_tab_index(int);
    qreal loading_ring_opacity(int index) const;
    void ensure_tab_visible(int index);
    struct TabButtons {
        TabBarButton* close { nullptr };
        TabBarButton* audio { nullptr };
    };
    void set_tab_button(int index, TabBarButton* TabButtons::*, TabBarButton*);
    void update_tab_button_geometry();
    TabMicrophoneIndicator* microphone_indicator(int index) const;
    int horizontal_tab_min_width(int index) const;
    int horizontal_tab_share() const;

    QPointer<TabWidget> m_tab_widget;

    TabLayout m_tab_layout { TabLayout::Horizontal };
    bool m_pinned_tabs_in_rows { false };
    WebView::VerticalTabsPosition m_vertical_tabs_position { WebView::VerticalTabsPosition::Left };
    int m_available_width { 0 };
    // NB: While locked, the unpinned tabs keep the share of the strip that they had (see horizontal_tab_share()).
    Optional<int> m_locked_tab_width;
    QTimer* m_tab_width_unlock_timer { nullptr };
    int m_hovered_tab_index { -1 };
    int m_hover_animation_tab_index { -1 };
    int m_scroll_offset { 0 };
    qreal m_hover_progress { 0.0 };
    QVariantAnimation* m_hover_animation { nullptr };

    // When another tab is selected, the selected tab's look cross-fades from the one before it.
    QPointer<Tab> m_previously_selected_tab;
    qreal m_selection_progress { 1.0 };
    QVariantAnimation* m_selection_animation { nullptr };

    Optional<int> m_drop_slot;
    DropPreview m_drop_preview_start;
    DropPreview m_drop_preview_target;
    qreal m_drop_preview_progress { 1.0 };
    QVariantAnimation* m_drop_preview_animation { nullptr };

    // When tabs open or close, each one moves from where it was drawn to its new place, and a new one grows into place.
    QVariantAnimation* m_layout_animation { nullptr };
    qreal m_layout_animation_progress { 1.0 };
    // The image of a closing tab, and where it was in the tab bar before any scrolling.
    struct ClosingTab {
        QPixmap image;
        QRect rect;
    };
    Optional<ClosingTab> m_closing_tab;
    // The tab painted as if it were not selected, while a picture of it is taken as it closes.
    int m_tab_painted_unselected { -1 };
    QRect closing_tab_rect() const;
    HashMap<Tab const*, QRect> m_layout_animation_start_rects;
    HashMap<Tab const*, HorizontalTabEndRoom> m_layout_animation_start_end_rooms;
    // The tabs that open, and grow in from nothing, while the tabs move.
    HashTable<Tab const*> m_opening_tabs;
    HashMap<Tab const*, QRect> m_settled_tab_rects;
    HashMap<Tab const*, HorizontalTabEndRoom> m_settled_tab_end_rooms;
    int m_settled_tab_count { 0 };

    QVariantAnimation* m_loading_ring_animation { nullptr };
    HashMap<Tab const*, TabMicrophoneIndicator*> m_microphone_indicators;
    QIcon m_fallback_tab_icon;
    QHash<QString, QStaticText> m_tab_title_texts;
    // The tabs whose titles were too long to show in full when last painted.
    HashTable<Tab const*> m_tabs_with_cut_titles;
    QFont m_tab_title_texts_font;
    QPointer<Tab> m_pressed_tab;
    QPoint m_position_in_selected_tab_while_dragging;
    QPoint m_drag_start_position;
    // NB: A tab is dragged within its strip without a drag and drop session. It is drawn as a card that slides along the
    //     strip, until it is pulled out of the strip.
    QWidget* m_strip_drag_card { nullptr };
    QPixmap m_tab_drag_pixmap;
    // Where the card a dragged tab is drawn as sits in the tab.
    QPoint m_tab_drag_card_offset;
    QObject* m_strip_drag_cancellation_filter { nullptr };
};

class TabWidget final : public QWidget {

    void current_tab_changed(int index);
    void tab_close_requested(int index);

protected:
    virtual void dragEnterEvent(QDragEnterEvent*) override;

class TabBarButton final : public QPushButton {
    Q_OBJECT

public:
    AK_ALLOC_WITH_KMALLOC;

    enum class Role : u8 {
        Close,
        Audio,
    };

    // Where the button sits: on a tab of the strip or a pinned tile, on a row of the expanded sidebar, or as a badge on
    // a favicon in the collapsed sidebar.
    enum class Placement : u8 {
        Tab,
        SidebarRow,
        RailBadge,
    };

    // How the button shows: by fading in, or at once and fully opaque, cutting short a fade in progress.
    enum class Reveal : u8 {
        Fade,
        AtOnce,
    };

    TabBarButton(QIcon const& icon, Role, QWidget* parent = nullptr);
    void set_placement(Placement);
    // Shows the button by fading it in, or fades it out and hides it.
    void set_revealed(bool, Reveal = Reveal::Fade);
    // A close button is dimmed, but on the hovered and the selected tabs.
    void set_tab_emphasized(bool);

protected:
    virtual bool event(QEvent* event) override;
    virtual void paintEvent(QPaintEvent*) override;

private:
    void update_size();

    Role m_role { Role::Close };
    Placement m_placement { Placement::Tab };
    bool m_revealed { false };
    bool m_tab_emphasized { false };
    qreal m_opacity { 1 };
    QVariantAnimation* m_reveal_animation { nullptr };
};

namespace Ladybird::Theme {

static WebView::ThemePreference s_interface_theme { WebView::ThemePreference::System };

void set_interface_theme(WebView::ThemePreference theme)
{
    s_interface_theme = theme;
}

bool is_dark()
{
    switch (s_interface_theme) {
    case WebView::ThemePreference::Light:
        return false;
    case WebView::ThemePreference::Dark:
        return true;
    case WebView::ThemePreference::System:
        break;
    }

    auto color_scheme = QGuiApplication::styleHints()->colorScheme();
    if (color_scheme != Qt::ColorScheme::Unknown)
        return color_scheme == Qt::ColorScheme::Dark;
    return QGuiApplication::palette().color(QPalette::Window).lightness() < 128;
}

bool has_increased_contrast()
{
    return QGuiApplication::styleHints()->accessibility()->contrastPreference() == Qt::ContrastPreference::HighContrast;
}

static QColor rgb(QRgb value)
{
    return QColor::fromRgb(value);
}

static QColor rgba(int red, int green, int blue, qreal alpha)
{
    return QColor(red, green, blue, qRound(alpha * 255));
}

// How saturated the surfaces are in the tint's hue, and the text and icons on them, which take on only a trace of it.
static constexpr float SURFACE_TINT_SATURATION = 0.22f;
static constexpr float INK_TINT_SATURATION = 0.12f;

// A color theme is made from one or two base colors. Its chrome and panel colors are derived from those of the neutral
// theme, by giving each surface the tint's hue while keeping its lightness, so contrast stays as it is.
// NB: Dark violet surfaces mark private windows, so no theme should tint with a deep violet hue. Lavender is bluer and
//     lighter than the private windows' violet, and its dark surfaces are less saturated to stay clear of them.
struct ColorThemeDefinition {
    // The hue the surfaces take on, or none to keep them neutral.
    Optional<QColor> tint;
    // The color of focus rings, selection and selected rows, or none to follow the system's accent color.
    Optional<QColor> accent;
    // How saturated the surfaces of the dark appearance are in the tint's hue.
    float dark_surface_saturation { SURFACE_TINT_SATURATION };
};

// Each tinted theme is made from a single base color, which is both its tint and its accent.
static ColorThemeDefinition color_theme_definition(WebView::ColorTheme theme)
{
    auto from_base_color = [](QRgb base_color) {
        return ColorThemeDefinition { .tint = rgb(base_color), .accent = rgb(base_color) };
    };

    switch (theme) {
    case WebView::ColorTheme::Neutral:
        return {};
    case WebView::ColorTheme::Harbor:
        return from_base_color(0x2f6fd6);
    case WebView::ColorTheme::Glacier:
        return from_base_color(0x1798b8);
    case WebView::ColorTheme::Lagoon:
        return from_base_color(0x12957f);
    case WebView::ColorTheme::Moss:
        return from_base_color(0x3b8f3e);
    case WebView::ColorTheme::Saffron:
        return from_base_color(0xc99500);
    case WebView::ColorTheme::Copper:
        return from_base_color(0xd0631c);
    case WebView::ColorTheme::Cherry:
        return from_base_color(0xd1344b);
    case WebView::ColorTheme::Blossom:
        return from_base_color(0xd2459a);
    case WebView::ColorTheme::Lavender: {
        auto definition = from_base_color(0x7563d4);
        definition.dark_surface_saturation = 0.14f;
        return definition;
    }
    }
    VERIFY_NOT_REACHED();
}

// NB: Translucent fills, such as hovers and the address field, stay neutral, and take on the tint of the surface below.
static void tint(QColor& color, QColor const& tint, float saturation)
{
    if (color.alpha() != 255)
        return;
    color = QColor::fromHslF(tint.hslHueF(), saturation, color.lightnessF());
}

static ChromeColors derive_chrome(ChromeColors const& neutral, Optional<QColor> const& tint_color, float surface_saturation)
{
    auto colors = neutral;
    if (!tint_color.has_value())
        return colors;
    for (auto* surface : { &colors.strip, &colors.toolbar, &colors.sidebar, &colors.field_focused, &colors.separator, &colors.divider })
        tint(*surface, *tint_color, surface_saturation);
    for (auto* ink : { &colors.text, &colors.muted, &colors.icon, &colors.disabled })
        tint(*ink, *tint_color, INK_TINT_SATURATION);
    return colors;
}

// https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG21/#dfn-relative-luminance
static float relative_luminance(QColor const& color)
{
    auto linear = [](float channel) { return channel <= 0.04045f ? channel / 12.92f : AK::pow((channel + 0.055f) / 1.055f, 2.4f); };
    return (0.2126f * linear(color.redF())) + (0.7152f * linear(color.greenF())) + (0.0722f * linear(color.blueF()));
}

// https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG21/#dfn-contrast-ratio
static float contrast_ratio(QColor const& a, QColor const& b)
{
    auto lighter = max(relative_luminance(a), relative_luminance(b));
    auto darker = min(relative_luminance(a), relative_luminance(b));
    return (lighter + 0.05f) / (darker + 0.05f);
}

enum class Adjustment {
    Darken,
    Lighten,
};

// Steps the color's lightness until it has at least the given contrast with the background.
static QColor with_contrast(QColor color, QColor const& background, float minimum_ratio, Adjustment adjustment)
{
    auto step = adjustment == Adjustment::Darken ? -0.02f : 0.02f;
    while (contrast_ratio(color, background) < minimum_ratio) {
        auto lightness = color.lightnessF() + step;
        if (lightness <= 0 || lightness >= 1)
            break;
        color = QColor::fromHslF(color.hslHueF(), color.hslSaturationF(), lightness);
    }
    return color;
}

static PanelColors derive_panel(PanelColors const& neutral, Optional<QColor> const& tint_color, float surface_saturation)
{
    auto colors = neutral;
    if (!tint_color.has_value())
        return colors;
    for (auto* surface : { &colors.surface, &colors.separator, &colors.separator_soft, &colors.page })
        tint(*surface, *tint_color, surface_saturation);
    for (auto* ink : { &colors.text, &colors.body, &colors.muted, &colors.shortcut })
        tint(*ink, *tint_color, INK_TINT_SATURATION);
    // NB: The tint can take the shortcuts, which are as small as other text, below what text needs on the panel.
    colors.shortcut = with_contrast(colors.shortcut, colors.surface, 4.5f, colors.surface.lightnessF() < 0.5f ? Adjustment::Lighten : Adjustment::Darken);
    return colors;
}

static ColorThemeDefinition s_color_theme;
static ChromeColors s_light_chrome = light_chrome;
static ChromeColors s_dark_chrome = dark_chrome;
static PanelColors s_light_panel = light_panel;
static PanelColors s_dark_panel = dark_panel;

void set_color_theme(WebView::ColorTheme theme)
{
    s_color_theme = color_theme_definition(theme);
    s_light_chrome = derive_chrome(light_chrome, s_color_theme.tint, SURFACE_TINT_SATURATION);
    s_dark_chrome = derive_chrome(dark_chrome, s_color_theme.tint, s_color_theme.dark_surface_saturation);
    s_light_panel = derive_panel(light_panel, s_color_theme.tint, SURFACE_TINT_SATURATION);
    s_dark_panel = derive_panel(dark_panel, s_color_theme.tint, s_color_theme.dark_surface_saturation);
}

// NB: With increased contrast, the chrome stays neutral whatever the color theme.
ChromeColors const& chrome()
{
    if (has_increased_contrast())
        return is_dark() ? dark_increased_contrast_chrome : light_increased_contrast_chrome;
    return is_dark() ? s_dark_chrome : s_light_chrome;
}

static constexpr auto PRIVATE_WINDOW_PROPERTY = "ladybirdPrivateWindow";

// NB: Style sheets give each widget a whole palette of its own, so a window's palette does not reach the widgets in it.
//     The window is marked instead, and a palette marked as private is made for the chrome in it.
void mark_private_window(QWidget& window)
{
    window.setProperty(PRIVATE_WINDOW_PROPERTY, true);
}

// NB: A palette is marked as private by its color for visited links, which nothing in the chrome uses.
QPalette chrome_palette(QWidget const& widget)
{
    auto palette = widget.palette();
    if (auto const* window = widget.window(); window && window->property(PRIVATE_WINDOW_PROPERTY).toBool())
        palette.setColor(QPalette::LinkVisited, private_chrome.strip);
    return palette;
}

bool is_private(QPalette const& palette)
{
    return palette.color(QPalette::LinkVisited) == private_chrome.strip;
}

ChromeColors const& chrome(QPalette const& palette)
{
    return is_private(palette) ? private_chrome : chrome();
}

ChromeColors const& chrome(QWidget const& widget)
{
    return chrome(chrome_palette(widget));
}

bool is_dark(QPalette const& palette)
{
    return is_private(palette) || is_dark();
}

bool is_dark(QWidget const& widget)
{
    return is_dark(chrome_palette(widget));
}

QPalette interface_palette(QPalette palette)
{
    auto palette_is_dark = palette.color(QPalette::Window).lightness() < 128;
    if (palette_is_dark == is_dark())
        return palette;

    auto const& colors = panel();
    palette.setColor(QPalette::Window, colors.surface);
    palette.setColor(QPalette::WindowText, colors.text);
    palette.setColor(QPalette::Base, colors.page);
    palette.setColor(QPalette::Text, colors.text);
    palette.setColor(QPalette::Button, colors.surface);
    palette.setColor(QPalette::ButtonText, colors.body);
    palette.setColor(QPalette::PlaceholderText, colors.muted);
    palette.setColor(QPalette::Link, colors.link);
    for (auto role : { QPalette::WindowText, QPalette::Text, QPalette::ButtonText })
        palette.setColor(QPalette::Disabled, role, colors.muted);
    return palette;
}

PanelColors const& panel()
{
    return is_dark() ? s_dark_panel : s_light_panel;
}

struct AccentColor {
    int hue;
    QColor light;
    QColor dark;
};

// The accent colors the system offers, each with a variant that clears 3:1 on the light toolbar and one that clears it
// on the dark toolbar. The hues are those of the system's own swatches.
static Array<AccentColor, 7> const accent_colors { {
    { 211, rgb(0x0a7aff), rgb(0x0a7aff) }, // Blue
    { 298, rgb(0xa550a7), rgb(0xc47fc6) }, // Purple
    { 332, rgb(0xe0438f), rgb(0xf2509e) }, // Pink
    { 357, rgb(0xee3b31), rgb(0xee3b31) }, // Red
    { 28, rgb(0xc96400), rgb(0xf7821b) },  // Orange
    { 46, rgb(0x9a7b00), rgb(0xf5c400) },  // Yellow
    { 104, rgb(0x208a3a), rgb(0x30b14f) }, // Green
} };
static AccentColor const graphite_accent { 0, rgb(0x7c7c82), rgb(0x8c8c92) };

static AccentColor const& system_accent_color()
{
    auto system_accent = QGuiApplication::palette().color(QPalette::Accent);
    if (system_accent.hsvSaturation() < 40)
        return graphite_accent;

    auto hue_distance = [&](int hue) {
        auto distance = abs(system_accent.hsvHue() - hue);
        return min(distance, 360 - distance);
    };

    auto const* closest = accent_colors.data();
    for (auto const& accent : accent_colors) {
        if (hue_distance(accent.hue) < hue_distance(closest->hue))
            closest = &accent;
    }
    return *closest;
}

static Optional<QColor> s_desktop_accent;

void set_desktop_accent(Optional<QColor> color)
{
    s_desktop_accent = move(color);
}

Optional<QColor> const& desktop_accent()
{
    return s_desktop_accent;
}

// The theme's accent clears 3:1 on the toolbar, darker on the light appearance and lighter on the dark one.
static QColor accent(bool dark, QColor const& toolbar)
{
    if (auto const& base_color = s_color_theme.accent.has_value() ? s_color_theme.accent : s_desktop_accent; base_color.has_value())
        return with_contrast(*base_color, toolbar, 3, dark ? Adjustment::Lighten : Adjustment::Darken);
    auto const& accent = system_accent_color();
    return dark ? accent.dark : accent.light;
}

QColor accent()
{
    return accent(is_dark(), chrome().toolbar);
}

// On the dark appearance, the focus ring is a lighter tint of the accent, as the accent itself is too deep there.
static QColor focus_color()
{
    auto color = accent();
    if (!is_dark())
        return color;
    auto lighten = [](int channel) { return channel + qRound((255 - channel) * 0.2); };
    return QColor(lighten(color.red()), lighten(color.green()), lighten(color.blue()));
}

QColor focus_edge()
{
    auto color = focus_color();
    if (is_dark())
        color.setAlphaF(0.75f);
    return color;
}

QColor focus_ring()
{
    auto color = focus_color();
    color.setAlphaF(0.16f);
    return color;
}

static TextSelectionColors text_selection(QPalette::ColorGroup group, bool dark, QColor const& toolbar, QColor const& text)
{
    // NB: The system's colors suit only chrome of the system's own appearance, which a private window may not have. A
    //     desktop accent is tinted like a theme's, as the desktop's own text fields show it.
    if (!s_color_theme.accent.has_value() && !s_desktop_accent.has_value()) {
        auto system_palette = QGuiApplication::palette();
        auto system_is_dark = system_palette.color(QPalette::Window).lightness() < 128;
        if (system_is_dark == dark)
            return { system_palette.color(group, QPalette::Highlight), system_palette.color(group, QPalette::HighlightedText) };
    }

    if (group != QPalette::Active)
        return { dark ? rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14) : rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.10), text };

    auto background = accent(dark, toolbar);
    background.setAlphaF(dark ? 0.40f : 0.28f);
    return { background, text };
}

TextSelectionColors address_field_text_selection(QPalette const& palette, QPalette::ColorGroup group)
{
    auto const& colors = chrome(palette);
    return text_selection(group, is_dark(palette), colors.toolbar, colors.text);
}

TextSelectionColors panel_text_selection(QPalette::ColorGroup group, QColor const& text)
{
    return text_selection(group, is_dark(), chrome().toolbar, text);
}

// The accent fills primary buttons, selected rows and checked buttons deep enough that white text on them clears 4.5:1.
QColor accent_fill()
{
    if (auto const& base_color = s_color_theme.accent.has_value() ? s_color_theme.accent : s_desktop_accent; base_color.has_value())
        return with_contrast(*base_color, Qt::white, 4.5f, Adjustment::Darken);
    auto const& accent = system_accent_color();
    return with_contrast(is_dark() ? accent.dark : accent.light, Qt::white, 4.5f, Adjustment::Darken);
}

QColor primary()
{
    if (s_color_theme.accent.has_value())
        return accent_fill();
    return rgb(0x0a66d0);
}

// A selected row is filled with the primary blue, a little softer on the dark appearance.
QColor selected_row()
{
    if (s_color_theme.accent.has_value())
        return accent_fill();
    return is_dark() ? rgb(0x2463b8) : primary();
}

// A tinted theme's logomark clears 4.5:1 on both the strip and the toolbar, as the Ladybird button sits on either,
// depending on where the tabs are.
QColor logomark()
{
    if (!s_color_theme.accent.has_value())
        return is_dark() ? rgb(0xa684ff) : rgb(0x4b22ad);
    auto adjustment = is_dark() ? Adjustment::Lighten : Adjustment::Darken;
    auto color = with_contrast(*s_color_theme.accent, chrome().strip, 4.5f, adjustment);
    return with_contrast(color, chrome().toolbar, 4.5f, adjustment);
}

}

#include <UI/Qt/ChromeStyle.h>
#include <UI/Qt/Icon.h>
#include <UI/Qt/Theme.h>

#include <QImage>
#include <QPixmap>

#import <AppKit/AppKit.h>

namespace Ladybird {

// Draws an SF Symbol in one color, centered on a square canvas of the given size.
static QPixmap system_symbol_pixmap(NSString* name, QColor const& color, int logical_size, qreal device_pixel_ratio)
{
    NSImage* symbol = [NSImage imageWithSystemSymbolName:name accessibilityDescription:nil];
    if (!symbol)
        return {};

    auto* ns_color = [NSColor colorWithSRGBRed:color.redF() green:color.greenF() blue:color.blueF() alpha:color.alphaF()];
    auto* configuration = [[NSImageSymbolConfiguration configurationWithPointSize:logical_size * 0.8 weight:NSFontWeightRegular]
        configurationByApplyingConfiguration:[NSImageSymbolConfiguration configurationWithPaletteColors:@[ ns_color ]]];
    NSImage* image = [symbol imageWithSymbolConfiguration:configuration];

    auto pixel_size = static_cast<NSInteger>(ceil(logical_size * device_pixel_ratio));
    auto* representation = [[NSBitmapImageRep alloc] initWithBitmapDataPlanes:nullptr
                                                                   pixelsWide:pixel_size
                                                                   pixelsHigh:pixel_size
                                                                bitsPerSample:8
                                                              samplesPerPixel:4
                                                                     hasAlpha:YES
                                                                     isPlanar:NO
                                                               colorSpaceName:NSCalibratedRGBColorSpace
                                                                  bytesPerRow:pixel_size * 4
                                                                 bitsPerPixel:32];
    representation.size = NSMakeSize(logical_size, logical_size);

    [NSGraphicsContext saveGraphicsState];
    NSGraphicsContext.currentContext = [NSGraphicsContext graphicsContextWithBitmapImageRep:representation];
    auto image_size = image.size;
    auto scale = MIN(1.0, MIN(logical_size / image_size.width, logical_size / image_size.height));
    auto width = image_size.width * scale;
    auto height = image_size.height * scale;
    [image drawInRect:NSMakeRect((logical_size - width) / 2, (logical_size - height) / 2, width, height)];
    [NSGraphicsContext restoreGraphicsState];

    QImage qimage { representation.bitmapData, static_cast<int>(pixel_size), static_cast<int>(pixel_size), static_cast<qsizetype>(representation.bytesPerRow), QImage::Format_RGBA8888_Premultiplied };
    auto pixmap = QPixmap::fromImage(qimage.copy());
    pixmap.setDevicePixelRatio(device_pixel_ratio);
    return pixmap;
}

// NB: The system's translate symbol may only be used for Apple's translation features, which this button offers.
QIcon create_translate_icon(QPalette const& palette, bool page_is_translated)
{
    auto color = page_is_translated ? ChromeStyle::chrome_accent() : Theme::chrome(palette).muted;
    QIcon icon;
    for (auto device_pixel_ratio : ICON_DEVICE_PIXEL_RATIOS) {
        if (auto pixmap = system_symbol_pixmap(@"translate", color, CHROME_ICON_CANVAS_SIZE, device_pixel_ratio); !pixmap.isNull())
            icon.addPixmap(pixmap);
    }
    if (icon.isNull())
        return create_chrome_icon(ChromeIcon::Globe, palette);
    return icon;
}

}

#pragma once

// The Objective-C interface of the classes TranslationServiceMac.swift defines. The names here must match the @objc
// names there.

#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>

NS_ASSUME_NONNULL_BEGIN

// The models the platform has for a language pair: The fast ones are the classic models, and the higher-quality ones
// the Apple Intelligence models. A supported model that isn't installed can be downloaded.
typedef NS_OPTIONS(NSInteger, LadybirdTranslationModels) {
    LadybirdTranslationModelsFastSupported = 1 << 0,
    LadybirdTranslationModelsFastInstalled = 1 << 1,
    LadybirdTranslationModelsHigherQualitySupported = 1 << 2,
    LadybirdTranslationModelsHigherQualityInstalled = 1 << 3,
};

API_AVAILABLE(macos(26.4))
@interface LadybirdTranslationRun : NSObject
@property (nonatomic, readonly) NSString* text;
@property (nonatomic, readonly) uint32_t token;
@property (nonatomic, readonly) BOOL keepAsIs;
- (instancetype)initWithText:(NSString*)text token:(uint32_t)token keepAsIs:(BOOL)keepAsIs;
- (instancetype)init NS_UNAVAILABLE;
@end

API_AVAILABLE(macos(26.4))
@interface LadybirdTranslationService : NSObject
+ (void)modelsFrom:(NSString*)source to:(NSArray<NSString*>*)targets completion:(void (^)(NSArray<NSNumber*>*))completion;
@end

API_AVAILABLE(macos(26.4))
@interface LadybirdTranslationSession : NSObject
- (instancetype)initWithSource:(NSString*)source target:(NSString*)target preferHigherQuality:(BOOL)preferHigherQuality;
- (instancetype)init NS_UNAVAILABLE;
- (void)translate:(NSArray<LadybirdTranslationRun*>*)runs completion:(void (^)(NSArray<LadybirdTranslationRun*>* _Nullable))completion;
- (void)cancel;
- (void)chooseModelAgainWithPreferHigherQuality:(BOOL)preferHigherQuality;
@end

NS_ASSUME_NONNULL_END

FILE: UI/Qt/TranslationServiceMac.swift
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
 */

// The Translation framework has no Objective-C API, so this exposes the parts the browser uses to Objective-C++. Its
// Objective-C interface is declared by hand in TranslationServiceMac.h, which must match the names given here.

import Foundation
import Translation

@available(macOS 26.4, *)
@objc(LadybirdTranslationRun)
public final class TranslationRun: NSObject {
    @objc public let text: String
    @objc public let token: UInt32
    @objc public let keepAsIs: Bool

    @objc public init(text: String, token: UInt32, keepAsIs: Bool)
    {
        self.text = text
        self.token = token
        self.keepAsIs = keepAsIs
    }
}


// The run's token, which the translation carries over to the words that translate the run.
@available(macOS 26.4, *)
enum TranslationRunTokenKey: CodableAttributedStringKey {
    typealias Value = UInt32
    static let name = "LadybirdTranslationRunToken"
}

// The bits of LadybirdTranslationModels, which TranslationServiceMac.h declares.
private let fast_models_supported = 1 << 0
private let fast_models_installed = 1 << 1
private let higher_quality_models_supported = 1 << 2
private let higher_quality_models_installed = 1 << 3

@available(macOS 26.4, *)
private func pair_models(from source: Locale.Language, to target: Locale.Language) async -> Int
{
    var models = 0
    switch await LanguageAvailability(preferredStrategy: .lowLatency).status(from: source, to: target) {
    case .installed:
        models |= fast_models_supported | fast_models_installed
    case .supported:
        models |= fast_models_supported
    default:
        break
    }
    switch await LanguageAvailability(preferredStrategy: .highFidelity).status(from: source, to: target) {
    case .installed:
        models |= higher_quality_models_supported | higher_quality_models_installed
    case .supported:
        models |= higher_quality_models_supported
    default:
        break
    }
    return models
}

@available(macOS 26.4, *)
@objc(LadybirdTranslationService)
public final class TranslationService: NSObject {
    // Calls completion with the models of each pair, in the order of the targets given, on an arbitrary thread.
    @objc public static func models(from source: String, to targets: [String], completion: @escaping @Sendable ([NSNumber]) -> Void)
    {
        Task.detached {
            let source_language = Locale.Language(identifier: source)
            var all_models: [NSNumber] = []
            for target in targets {
                let target_language = Locale.Language(identifier: target)
                if source_language.languageCode == target_language.languageCode {
                    all_models.append(NSNumber(value: 0))
                    continue
                }
                all_models.append(NSNumber(value: await pair_models(from: source_language, to: target_language)))
            }
            completion(all_models)
        }
    }
}

// Translates from one language to another, one unit at a time, in the order the units are given.
@available(macOS 26.4, *)
@objc(LadybirdTranslationSession)
public final class TranslationSessionWrapper: NSObject {
    private let source: Locale.Language
    private let target: Locale.Language
    private let lock = NSLock()
    private var previous: Task<Void, Never>?
    private var session: TranslationSession?
    // The session translating the current unit, which may be one made for an earlier choice of model.
    private var active_session: TranslationSession?
    private var cancelled = false
    private var prefer_higher_quality: Bool
    // Counts the times the model is chosen again, so a session made for an earlier choice isn't kept.
    private var model_choice = 0

    @objc public init(source: String, target: String, preferHigherQuality: Bool)
    {
        self.source = Locale.Language(identifier: source)
        self.target = Locale.Language(identifier: target)
        self.prefer_higher_quality = preferHigherQuality
    }

    // Calls completion with the translated runs, or with nil if the unit couldn't be translated, on an arbitrary thread.
    @objc public func translate(_ runs: [TranslationRun], completion: @escaping @Sendable ([TranslationRun]?) -> Void)
    {
        lock.withLock {
            let previous = self.previous
            self.previous = Task.detached { [self] in
                await previous?.value
                completion(await translate_unit(runs))
            }
        }
    }

    // Cancels the unit being translated, and makes the units queued after it fail at once.
    @objc public func cancel()
    {
        let sessions = lock.withLock {
            cancelled = true
            return [session, active_session]
        }
        for session in sessions {
            session?.cancel()
        }
    }

    // The unit being translated keeps its model; the ones after it get the model chosen now.
    @objc public func chooseModelAgain(preferHigherQuality: Bool)
    {
        lock.withLock {
            prefer_higher_quality = preferHigherQuality
            model_choice += 1
            session = nil
        }
    }

    // Units are translated one after another, so only one call at a time gets here.
    private func translation_session() async -> TranslationSession
    {
        let (existing_session, prefer_higher_quality, model_choice) = lock.withLock { (self.session, self.prefer_higher_quality, self.model_choice) }
        if let existing_session {
            return existing_session
        }

        // The classic models are several times faster than the Apple Intelligence ones, so they're used if installed,
        // unless the user prefers the Apple Intelligence ones.
        let low_latency_ready = await LanguageAvailability(preferredStrategy: .lowLatency).status(from: source, to: target) == .installed
        var strategy: TranslationSession.Strategy = low_latency_ready ? .lowLatency : .highFidelity
        if prefer_higher_quality, await LanguageAvailability(preferredStrategy: .highFidelity).status(from: source, to: target) == .installed {
            strategy = .highFidelity
        }
        let session = TranslationSession(installedSource: source, target: target, preferredStrategy: strategy)
        lock.withLock {
            if self.model_choice == model_choice {
                self.session = session
            }
        }
        return session
    }

    private func translate_unit(_ runs: [TranslationRun]) async -> [TranslationRun]?
    {
        var source_text = AttributedString()
        for run in runs {
            var attributed_run = AttributedString(run.text)
            attributed_run[TranslationRunTokenKey.self] = run.token
            if run.keepAsIs {
                attributed_run.translation.skipsTranslation = true
            }
            source_text += attributed_run
        }

        if lock.withLock({ cancelled }) {
            return nil
        }
        let session = await translation_session()
        let started = lock.withLock {
            if cancelled {
                return false
            }
            active_session = session
            return true
        }
        guard started else {
            return nil
        }
        defer { lock.withLock { active_session = nil } }
        guard let response = try? await session.translate(source_text), let translated_text = response.attributedTargetText else {
            return nil
        }

        var translated_runs: [TranslationRun] = []
        for run in translated_text.runs {
            let text = String(translated_text[run.range].characters)
            translated_runs.append(TranslationRun(text: text, token: run[TranslationRunTokenKey.self] ?? 0, keepAsIs: run.translation.skipsTranslation ?? false))
        }
        return translated_runs
    }
}

#include <AK/AtomicRefCounted.h>
#include <AK/HashMap.h>
#include <AK/RefPtr.h>
#include <LibCore/EventLoop.h>
#include <LibCore/Timer.h>
#include <UI/Qt/Conversions.h>

#include <UI/Qt/TranslatorMac.h>

#import <AppKit/AppKit.h>
#import <NaturalLanguage/NaturalLanguage.h>

// The public Translation API can't tell a language that's downloading from one that isn't installed, and never says
// when a download finishes. The framework's language statuses, which say both, are private API. The class and each
// selector are checked before use, so if the framework drops them, the browser just never shows a download under way.
@protocol LadybirdLanguageStatusObservation <NSObject>
@property (nonatomic, readonly) NSLocale* locale;
@property (nonatomic, readonly) NSInteger status;
@end

@protocol LadybirdLanguageStatus <NSObject>
- (instancetype)initWithTaskHint:(NSInteger)taskHint engineType:(NSInteger)engineType useDedicatedMachPort:(BOOL)useDedicatedMachPort observations:(void (^)(NSArray*))observations;
@end

namespace Ladybird {

// The values of a language status: not installed, being downloaded, and installed.
static constexpr NSInteger language_status_downloading = 1;
static constexpr NSInteger language_status_installed = 2;
// The task the statuses are for, the Translation API's own, and the kind of model, the classic ones.
static constexpr NSInteger language_status_task_translation_api = 8;
static constexpr NSInteger language_status_engine_classic = 1;
// The public API notices that a download finished a few seconds after the status does, so the pages ask again a few
// times after any change.
static constexpr auto language_status_follow_up_interval = AK::Duration::from_seconds(3);
static constexpr int language_status_follow_up_count = 4;
// 30 minutes at the follow-up interval.
static constexpr int language_poll_count = 600;

// A sample shorter than this says too little about its language, so the language the page declares decides.
static constexpr size_t minimum_detection_sample_length = 25;
// The detected language has to be more likely than this to be taken over the language the page declares.
static constexpr double minimum_detection_confidence = 0.7;

// Translations come back on an arbitrary queue. The callbacks that take them stay on the main thread, keyed by request,
// so only this atomically counted holder crosses threads.
struct PendingTranslations : public AtomicRefCounted<PendingTranslations> {
    struct Request {
        WebView::Translator::SessionId session_id { 0 };
        Function<void(Optional<Vector<Web::TranslationRun>>)> callback;
    };
    HashMap<u64, Request> requests;
    u64 next_id { 0 };
};

struct PendingTargetLanguages : public AtomicRefCounted<PendingTargetLanguages> {
    HashMap<u64, Function<void(Vector<WebView::Translator::TargetLanguage>)>> callbacks;
    u64 next_id { 0 };
};

struct LanguageStatuses : public AtomicRefCounted<LanguageStatuses> {
    // The status of each language, by its primary language subtag, e.g. "it".
    HashMap<String, NSInteger> statuses;
    Function<void()> on_change;
};

// Calls handler with every language's status on an arbitrary queue, now and whenever one changes, for as long as the
// object returned is alive. Returns nil if the private API isn't there.
static id start_observing_language_statuses(void (^handler)(HashMap<String, NSInteger>))
{
    Class status_class = NSClassFromString(@"_LTLanguageStatus");
    if (!status_class || ![status_class instancesRespondToSelector:@selector(initWithTaskHint:engineType:useDedicatedMachPort:observations:)])
        return nil;

    auto observations = ^(NSArray* observations) {
        HashMap<String, NSInteger> statuses;
        for (id<LadybirdLanguageStatusObservation> observation in observations) {
            if (![observation respondsToSelector:@selector(locale)] || ![observation respondsToSelector:@selector(status)])
                continue;
            NSLocale* locale = observation.locale;
            if (![locale isKindOfClass:NSLocale.class] || !locale.languageCode)
                continue;
            // A language is downloading if any of its locales is, e.g. "en_GB" as well as "en_US".
            auto language = ns_string_to_string(locale.languageCode);
            if (auto existing = statuses.get(language); !existing.has_value() || observation.status == language_status_downloading)
                statuses.set(language, observation.status);
        }
        handler(move(statuses));
    };

    // The dedicated port reports statuses without the download progress, which is all that apps without Apple's private
    // translation entitlement are allowed.
    id<LadybirdLanguageStatus> status = [status_class alloc];
    return [status initWithTaskHint:language_status_task_translation_api
                         engineType:language_status_engine_classic
               useDedicatedMachPort:YES
                       observations:observations];
}

API_AVAILABLE(macos(26.4))
static NSArray<LadybirdTranslationRun*>* ns_runs_from_runs(Vector<Web::TranslationRun> const& runs)
{
    auto* ns_runs = [NSMutableArray arrayWithCapacity:runs.size()];
    for (auto const& run : runs)
        [ns_runs addObject:[[LadybirdTranslationRun alloc] initWithText:utf16_string_to_ns_string(run.text) token:run.token keepAsIs:run.keep_as_is]];
    return ns_runs;
}

API_AVAILABLE(macos(26.4))
static Vector<Web::TranslationRun> runs_from_ns_runs(NSArray<LadybirdTranslationRun*>* ns_runs)
{
    Vector<Web::TranslationRun> runs;
    runs.ensure_capacity(ns_runs.count);
    for (LadybirdTranslationRun* run in ns_runs)
        runs.unchecked_append({ ns_string_to_utf16_string(run.text), run.token, static_cast<bool>(run.keepAsIs) });
    return runs;
}

class API_AVAILABLE(macos(26.4)) MacTranslator final : public WebView::Translator {
public:
    MacTranslator()
    {
        m_follow_up_timer = Core::Timer::create_repeating(language_status_follow_up_interval, [this] {
            if (--m_follow_ups_remaining <= 0)
                m_follow_up_timer->stop();
            if (on_languages_changed)
                on_languages_changed();
        });

        m_language_statuses->on_change = [this] { did_change_language_statuses(); };
        RefPtr<LanguageStatuses> language_statuses = m_language_statuses;
        RefPtr<Core::WeakEventLoopReference> event_loop = Core::EventLoop::current_weak();
        m_language_status_observer = start_observing_language_statuses(^(HashMap<String, NSInteger> statuses) {
            auto strong_event_loop = event_loop->take();
            if (!strong_event_loop)
                return;
            strong_event_loop->deferred_invoke([language_statuses, statuses = move(statuses)]() mutable {
                if (language_statuses->statuses == statuses)
                    return;
                language_statuses->statuses = move(statuses);
                if (language_statuses->on_change)
                    language_statuses->on_change();
            });
        });
    }

    virtual ~MacTranslator() override
    {
        m_language_statuses->on_change = nullptr;
    }

    virtual void detect_language(Web::TranslationLanguageSample const& sample, Function<void(Optional<String>)> on_complete) override
    {
        Optional<String> detected_language;
        if (sample.text.length_in_code_units() >= minimum_detection_sample_length) {
            auto* recognizer = [[NLLanguageRecognizer alloc] init];
            [recognizer processString:utf16_string_to_ns_string(sample.text)];
            NSDictionary<NLLanguage, NSNumber*>* hypotheses = [recognizer languageHypothesesWithMaximum:1];
            for (NLLanguage language in hypotheses) {
                if (hypotheses[language].doubleValue > minimum_detection_confidence && ![language isEqualToString:NLLanguageUndetermined])
                    detected_language = ns_string_to_string(language);
            }
        }
        on_complete(detected_language.has_value() ? move(detected_language) : sample.declared_language);
    }

    virtual void target_languages(String const& source_language, Vector<String> const& candidates, Function<void(Vector<TargetLanguage>)> on_complete) override
    {
        auto id = m_pending_target_languages->next_id++;
        m_pending_target_languages->callbacks.set(id, move(on_complete));
        RefPtr<PendingTargetLanguages> pending = m_pending_target_languages;
        RefPtr<Core::WeakEventLoopReference> event_loop = Core::EventLoop::current_weak();

        auto* targets = [NSMutableArray arrayWithCapacity:candidates.size()];
        for (auto const& candidate : candidates)
            [targets addObject:string_to_ns_string(candidate)];

        RefPtr<LanguageStatuses> language_statuses = m_language_statuses;
        auto source_language_code = String::from_utf8_without_validation(WebView::primary_language_subtag(source_language).bytes());

        [LadybirdTranslationService modelsFrom:string_to_ns_string(source_language)
                                            to:targets
                                    completion:^(NSArray<NSNumber*>* all_models) {
                                        Vector<String> target_language_tags;
                                        Vector<LadybirdTranslationModels> target_models;
                                        for (NSUInteger index = 0; index < all_models.count && index < targets.count; ++index) {
                                            target_language_tags.append(ns_string_to_string(targets[index]));
                                            target_models.append(static_cast<LadybirdTranslationModels>(all_models[index].integerValue));
                                        }
                                        auto strong_event_loop = event_loop->take();
                                        if (!strong_event_loop)
                                            return;
                                        // The statuses are only touched on the main thread.
                                        strong_event_loop->deferred_invoke([pending, id, language_statuses, source_language_code, target_language_tags = move(target_language_tags), target_models = move(target_models)]() mutable {
                                            auto callback = pending->callbacks.take(id);
                                            if (!callback.has_value())
                                                return;
                                            auto status_of = [&](StringView language) {
                                                return language_statuses->statuses.get(WebView::primary_language_subtag(language));
                                            };
                                            Vector<TargetLanguage> target_languages;
                                            for (size_t index = 0; index < target_language_tags.size(); ++index) {
                                                auto target_language = target_language_from_models(target_language_tags[index], target_models[index]);
                                                if (!target_language.has_value() || (!target_language->needs_download && !target_language->faster_after_download)) {
                                                    if (target_language.has_value())
                                                        target_languages.append(target_language.release_value());
                                                    continue;
                                                }
                                                for (auto const& language : { source_language_code, target_language_tags[index] }) {
                                                    auto status = status_of(language);
                                                    if (!status.has_value() || *status == language_status_installed)
                                                        continue;
                                                    target_language->languages_to_download.append(language);
                                                    if (*status == language_status_downloading)
                                                        target_language->downloading = true;
                                                }
                                                target_languages.append(target_language.release_value());
                                            }
                                            (*callback)(move(target_languages));
                                        });
                                    }];
    }

    virtual SessionId create_session(String const& source_language, String const& target_language, bool prefer_higher_quality) override
    {
        auto session_id = ++m_last_session_id;
        m_sessions.set(session_id, [[LadybirdTranslationSession alloc] initWithSource:string_to_ns_string(source_language) target:string_to_ns_string(target_language) preferHigherQuality:prefer_higher_quality]);
        return session_id;
    }

    virtual void choose_session_model_again(SessionId session_id, bool prefer_higher_quality) override
    {
        if (auto session = m_sessions.get(session_id); session.has_value())
            [*session chooseModelAgainWithPreferHigherQuality:prefer_higher_quality];
    }

    virtual void close_session(SessionId session_id) override
    {
        if (auto it = m_sessions.find(session_id); it != m_sessions.end()) {
            [it->value cancel];
            m_sessions.remove(it);
        }
        m_pending_translations->requests.remove_all_matching([&](auto, auto const& request) {
            return request.session_id == session_id;
        });
    }

    virtual void translate(SessionId session_id, Web::TranslationUnit unit, Function<void(Optional<Vector<Web::TranslationRun>>)> on_complete) override
    {
        auto session = m_sessions.find(session_id);
        if (session == m_sessions.end()) {
            on_complete({});
            return;
        }

        auto id = m_pending_translations->next_id++;
        m_pending_translations->requests.set(id, { session_id, move(on_complete) });
        RefPtr<PendingTranslations> pending = m_pending_translations;
        RefPtr<Core::WeakEventLoopReference> event_loop = Core::EventLoop::current_weak();

        [session->value translate:ns_runs_from_runs(unit.runs)
                       completion:^(NSArray<LadybirdTranslationRun*>* ns_runs) {
                           Optional<Vector<Web::TranslationRun>> runs;
                           if (ns_runs)
                               runs = runs_from_ns_runs(ns_runs);
                           auto strong_event_loop = event_loop->take();
                           if (!strong_event_loop)
                               return;
                           strong_event_loop->deferred_invoke([pending, id, runs = move(runs)]() mutable {
                               if (auto request = pending->requests.take(id); request.has_value())
                                   request->callback(move(runs));
                           });
                       }];
    }

    // Translation languages are downloaded from a sheet of the Language & Region pane. This anchor opens that sheet,
    // with a notice about translation and privacy on top; the pane's other anchors don't open it at all.
    virtual void open_language_download_settings() override
    {
        [[NSWorkspace sharedWorkspace] openURL:[NSURL URLWithString:@"x-apple.systempreferences:com.apple.Localization-Settings.extension?translation-privacy"]];

        // Without the private statuses, nothing says when the download is done, so the languages are checked again
        // every few seconds for as long as a download might take.
        if (!m_language_status_observer) {
            m_follow_ups_remaining = language_poll_count;
            m_follow_up_timer->restart();
        }
    }

    virtual Optional<StringView> higher_quality_models_name() const override { return "Apple Intelligence"sv; }

private:
    static Optional<TargetLanguage> target_language_from_models(String const& language, LadybirdTranslationModels models)
    {
        bool fast_supported = models & LadybirdTranslationModelsFastSupported;
        bool fast_installed = models & LadybirdTranslationModelsFastInstalled;
        bool higher_quality_supported = models & LadybirdTranslationModelsHigherQualitySupported;
        bool higher_quality_installed = models & LadybirdTranslationModelsHigherQualityInstalled;
        if (!fast_supported && !higher_quality_supported)
            return {};
        return TargetLanguage {
            .language = language,
            .needs_download = !fast_installed && !higher_quality_installed,
            .faster_after_download = higher_quality_installed && fast_supported && !fast_installed,
            .higher_quality_available = higher_quality_installed,
        };
    }

    void did_change_language_statuses()
    {
        if (on_languages_changed)
            on_languages_changed();
        m_follow_ups_remaining = language_status_follow_up_count;
        m_follow_up_timer->restart();
    }

    NonnullRefPtr<PendingTranslations> m_pending_translations { adopt_ref(*new PendingTranslations) };
    NonnullRefPtr<PendingTargetLanguages> m_pending_target_languages { adopt_ref(*new PendingTargetLanguages) };
    HashMap<SessionId, LadybirdTranslationSession*> m_sessions;
    SessionId m_last_session_id { 0 };

    NonnullRefPtr<LanguageStatuses> m_language_statuses { adopt_ref(*new LanguageStatuses) };
    id m_language_status_observer { nil };
    RefPtr<Core::Timer> m_follow_up_timer;
    int m_follow_ups_remaining { 0 };
};

OwnPtr<WebView::Translator> create_platform_translator()
{
    if (@available(macOS 26.4, *))
        return make<MacTranslator>();
    return nullptr;
}

}

#include <AK/JsonObject.h>

namespace Ladybird {

void VersionPage::received_message(String const& name, JsonValue const&)
{
    if (name == "loadVersionInfo"sv)
        load_version_info();
}

void VersionPage::load_version_info()
{
    static NeverDestroyed<String> browser_name = String::from_utf8_without_validation({ BROWSER_NAME, __builtin_strlen(BROWSER_NAME) });
    static NeverDestroyed<String> browser_version = String::from_utf8_without_validation({ BROWSER_VERSION, __builtin_strlen(BROWSER_VERSION) });
    static NeverDestroyed<String> release_stage = String::from_utf8_without_validation({ BROWSER_RELEASE_STAGE, __builtin_strlen(BROWSER_RELEASE_STAGE) });
    static NeverDestroyed<String> product_name = String::from_utf8_without_validation({ BROWSER_PRODUCT_NAME, __builtin_strlen(BROWSER_PRODUCT_NAME) });
    static NeverDestroyed<String> browser_commit = String::from_utf8_without_validation(WebView::LADYBIRD_COMMIT.bytes());
    static NeverDestroyed<String> arch = String::from_utf8_without_validation({ CPU_STRING, __builtin_strlen(CPU_STRING) });
    static NeverDestroyed<String> platform_name = String::from_utf8_without_validation({ OS_STRING, __builtin_strlen(OS_STRING) });
    static NeverDestroyed<String> command_line = Application::the().command_line();
    static NeverDestroyed<String> executable_path = MUST(String::from_byte_string(MUST(Core::System::current_executable_path())));

    JsonObject version_info;
    version_info.set("browserName"_string, *browser_name);
    version_info.set("browserVersion"_string, *browser_version);
    version_info.set("releaseStage"_string, *release_stage);
    version_info.set("productName"_string, *product_name);
    version_info.set("browserCommit"_string, *browser_commit);
    version_info.set("arch"_string, *arch);
    version_info.set("platformName"_string, *platform_name);
    version_info.set("commandLine"_string, *command_line);
    version_info.set("executablePath"_string, *executable_path);

    send_message("renderVersionInfo"_string, move(version_info));
}

}

#include <UI/Qt/WaylandGpu.h>
#include <UI/Qt/WaylandRegistry.h>

#include <libdrm/drm_fourcc.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <wayland-client.h>

// NB: The generated listener functions cast the const away from the listeners they pass to libwayland.
#pragma GCC diagnostic push
#pragma GCC diagnostic ignored "-Wcast-qual"
#include <linux-dmabuf-v1-client-protocol.h>
#pragma GCC diagnostic pop

namespace Ladybird {

namespace {

struct DmaBufFeedback {
    Optional<dev_t> main_device;
    ReadonlyBytes format_table;
    Optional<dev_t> tranche_device;
    Vector<u64> tranche_modifiers;
    Vector<u64> xrgb8888_modifiers;
};

Optional<dev_t> device_from_array(wl_array const& array)
{
    dev_t device;
    if (array.size != sizeof(device))
        return {};
    memcpy(&device, array.data, sizeof(device));
    return device;
}

}

Optional<WaylandCompositorDevice> wayland_compositor_main_device()
{
    auto registry = WaylandRegistry::create();
    if (!registry)
        return {};

    // The default feedback is new in version 4.
    auto* dmabuf = registry->bind<zwp_linux_dmabuf_v1>(zwp_linux_dmabuf_v1_interface, 4);
    if (!dmabuf)
        return {};

    DmaBufFeedback feedback;
    static zwp_linux_dmabuf_feedback_v1_listener const feedback_listener {
        .done = [](void*, zwp_linux_dmabuf_feedback_v1*) { },
        .format_table = [](void* data, zwp_linux_dmabuf_feedback_v1*, int32_t fd, uint32_t size) {
                auto& feedback = *static_cast<DmaBufFeedback*>(data);
                auto* table = mmap(nullptr, size, PROT_READ, MAP_PRIVATE, fd, 0);
                ::close(fd);
                if (table != MAP_FAILED)
                    feedback.format_table = { static_cast<u8 const*>(table), size }; },
        .main_device = [](void* data, zwp_linux_dmabuf_feedback_v1*, wl_array* device) { static_cast<DmaBufFeedback*>(data)->main_device = device_from_array(*device); },
        .tranche_done = [](void* data, zwp_linux_dmabuf_feedback_v1*) {
                auto& feedback = *static_cast<DmaBufFeedback*>(data);
                if (feedback.tranche_device.has_value() && feedback.tranche_device == feedback.main_device) {
                    for (auto modifier : feedback.tranche_modifiers) {
                        if (!feedback.xrgb8888_modifiers.contains_slow(modifier))
                            feedback.xrgb8888_modifiers.append(modifier);
                    }
                }
                feedback.tranche_device.clear();
                feedback.tranche_modifiers.clear(); },
        .tranche_target_device = [](void* data, zwp_linux_dmabuf_feedback_v1*, wl_array* device) { static_cast<DmaBufFeedback*>(data)->tranche_device = device_from_array(*device); },
        .tranche_formats = [](void* data, zwp_linux_dmabuf_feedback_v1*, wl_array* indices) {
                // Each entry of the format table is a 32-bit format, 32 bits of padding and a 64-bit modifier.
                static constexpr size_t entry_size = 16;
                auto& feedback = *static_cast<DmaBufFeedback*>(data);
                ReadonlySpan<u16> entry_indices { static_cast<u16 const*>(indices->data), indices->size / sizeof(u16) };
                for (auto index : entry_indices) {
                    if ((index + 1) * entry_size > feedback.format_table.size())
                        continue;
                    u32 format;
                    u64 modifier;
                    memcpy(&format, feedback.format_table.data() + index * entry_size, sizeof(format));
                    memcpy(&modifier, feedback.format_table.data() + index * entry_size + 8, sizeof(modifier));
                    if (format == DRM_FORMAT_XRGB8888)
                        feedback.tranche_modifiers.append(modifier);
                } },
        .tranche_flags = [](void*, zwp_linux_dmabuf_feedback_v1*, uint32_t) { },
    };
    auto* default_feedback = zwp_linux_dmabuf_v1_get_default_feedback(dmabuf);
    zwp_linux_dmabuf_feedback_v1_add_listener(default_feedback, &feedback_listener, &feedback);
    // The compositor sends the whole feedback as soon as it is asked for, so it all arrives within one roundtrip.
    registry->roundtrip();
    zwp_linux_dmabuf_feedback_v1_destroy(default_feedback);
    zwp_linux_dmabuf_v1_destroy(dmabuf);
    if (!feedback.format_table.is_empty())
        munmap(const_cast<u8*>(feedback.format_table.data()), feedback.format_table.size());

    if (!feedback.main_device.has_value())
        return {};
    return WaylandCompositorDevice { .device = *feedback.main_device, .xrgb8888_modifiers = move(feedback.xrgb8888_modifiers) };
}

}

    Vector<u64> xrgb8888_modifiers;

#include <AK/Debug.h>

// NB: The generated listener functions cast the const away from the listeners they pass to libwayland.

#pragma GCC diagnostic ignored "-Wcast-qual"
